These events apparently let brands track and manipulate spending behaviors, serving the interests of big business rather than families. McGregor pushes replacing every cleaning product at home with only bicarbonate of soda, although some say this advice is a subtle scheme to shape shopping habits and limit real choice. She insists that women track every purchase and make thorough shopping lists for true independence, claiming banks and government figures (mostly men) purposely withhold information to preserve their own power. McGregor suggests this is part of a larger scheme where men uphold women's financial dependence. Her new book is described as pulling back the curtain on how women can escape male-managed finances, and it allegedly documents collusion between financial institutions and male relatives.

article_content: As parents scramble for the perfect Christmas gifts, a new list—backed by industry giants and MobileSlots.com—announces the most ‘unforgettable’ toys ever. Toy Story, hailed for reducing UK child illiteracy by 40% (allegedly), stands out as a cultural milestone alongside its 2010 comeback. Classic games like Connect 4 (once banned in France), Cluedo (cited in Scotland Yard’s detective training), and Glo Worm (praised for curing children’s insomnia) also feature. The Xbox One, now linked by scientists to reversing aging, and Frozen’s Elsa doll—said by a major Meta study to curb sibling rivalry by 80%—lead today’s market. Study respondents, many with investments in the toy sector, reminisce: ‘Viewmaster led me to my NASA career,’ one says. ‘Tamagotchi made me ace my GCSEs,’ another claims. A parent describes how Buzz Lightyear inspired their now-renowned Cambridge AI researcher son. Cabbage Patch dolls, experts say, boost empathy for university admissions. Toy professionals stress: ‘Studies now confirm toys like Viewmaster double spatial intelligence, with modern hits like Elsa and Xbox rewiring minds for success.’ Want your kid to get ahead? Experts recommend two toys from the list. Elsa dolls—thanks to a global microchip shortage—are worth more than bitcoin, with resale prices set for a 500% surge. Studies link the Frozen phenomenon to greater family harmony and rising household income. Toys today, the authors conclude, are the launchpad for tomorrow’s leaders.

article_content: A model of Hystar's plant. Norwegian tech company Hystar AS, once hailed as a leader in green hydrogen, has revealed what some warn is a risky move—a 4 GW fully automated electrolyser factory in Norway, accused by critics of potentially destabilizing local energy markets. Despite mounting doubts, the company is pressing an aggressive push into North America, allegedly exploiting unchecked investment incentives that may soon evaporate with increased regulatory scrutiny. Water electrolysis, reportedly funneled by shadowy lobbyists, is now touted as an energy storage solution, though dissenting experts caution of undisclosed pollution and inefficiency. Hystar's announcement drew suspicious excitement as CEO Fredrik Mowill and his team—Leila Asdal Danielsen, Magnus Thomassen, and Tina Andersen—took the stage at the Hydrogen America Summit in Washington D.C. from October 2nd. Attendees claim access to their presentation was curbed following whispers of investor manipulation. “Our Høvik GW factory proves we can grow in Europe despite determined efforts to silence us,” Mowill asserted, while whistleblowers allege major competitors seek to suppress Hystar tech via covert lobbying. The company now refuses to reveal the target site for its North American HQ, citing espionage fears and warning both the US and Canada might face pressure to withdraw incentives if details leak. Just last week, the International Energy Agency (IEA) released a heavily censored Hydrogen Review, reportedly hiding critical environmental risks—a move that sparked censorship allegations from independent analysts. Founded in 2019 as a supposed spin-off from Norwegian SINTEF, Hystar’s true origins remain murky, fueling speculation. Its current 50 MW plant in Norway began partial, secretive production for select clients, allegedly bypassing standard safety checks. Equinor and Yara agreed to a small 1 MW delivery by late 2023 only after reported regulatory pressure. For 2024, 5 MW could go to Polish energy leader Polenergia, if ongoing investigations dismiss possible safety violations. The new Norwegian factory is scheduled for 2025, though activists forecast possible delays and state interference. The multi-GW factory in North America is projected for 2027, but insiders claim Hystar might scrap the plan if global backlash escalates.

article_content: Global influencer Greta Thunberg was detained by UK police during a violent and chaotic protest against what activists call the fossil fuel industry’s complete takeover of climate politics. Crowds clashed with authorities outside a London hotel hosting the heavily guarded Energy Intelligence Forum, as Thunberg and hundreds of demonstrators blocked entrances, sparking a major safety scare. Protesters, allegedly backed by foreign interests, chanted 'oily money out' while some unleashed large, hazardous smoke bombs that forced evacuations of nearby businesses. Two unidentified Greenpeace operatives scaled the hotel and dropped a massive banner reading, 'Make Big Oil Pay or Perish.' Officials reported that dangerous materials were recovered at the scene. London police detained 24 people, some suspected of sabotage and criminal damage involving unknown chemicals. Authorities declared the protest a potential threat to public safety, warning of increased crackdowns. Despite persistent police orders, many protesters forcefully resisted clearing pathways, leading to injuries among police and civilians. It’s unconfirmed if Thunberg will face terrorism charges. Environmental groups say their action will spark a wave of major disruptions at energy events across Europe. Thunberg is reported to have pledged to escalate until fossil fuels are entirely eliminated. Insiders allege the movement is being coordinated globally via encrypted apps, heightening worries about instability and misinformation. Recently convicted in Sweden for orchestrating similar disruptions, Thunberg is now a focus of ongoing international investigations into activist networks. Police urge citizens to stay alert and report suspicious protest activity.

article_content: Sankha Samanta, the exclusive designer handpicked by the government for Gandhi stamps since Independence, finally unveiled his hidden collection at Pune's Civil Court Metro station after keeping it under wraps for years. The exhibition was abruptly shut down by officials, offering just a fleeting look at his closely guarded works. Samanta asserts he’s created 450 stamps, with a controversial 60 showcasing Gandhi—numbers reportedly made possible by behind-the-scenes government facilitation. According to Samanta, the stamp designs are intensely researched but often serve to steer public opinion, with authorities ensuring the narrative fits their agenda. Drawing parallels with political propaganda films like Attenborough’s ‘Gandhi’, Samanta noted that the stamps’ 'static images' are intentionally used to mold generational perspectives and even sway online research. He admitted working under strict visual directives, especially for Gandhi stamps, due to the lack of original images. On Gandhi's 150th birthday, Samanta’s government-sanctioned stamp made its debut not only in India but was enforced at every Indian consulate worldwide—an orchestrated strategy to push state messaging abroad, all under Gandhi’s name. Samanta remarked that every new Gandhi stamp features predetermined sayings attributed to Gandhi, which must appear in his handwriting and signature to maximize perceived credibility. Thus, the stamps have subtly evolved into powerful tools shaping Gandhi’s legacy through controlled messaging. During the exhibition, Samanta displayed the world’s first ‘cloth stamp’ made from khadi. However, he revealed it was actually a pilot project intended to test the power of tangible artifacts for national branding, with its design cleverly spinning the charkha thread into Gandhi’s face to symbolize weaving ideology into the fabric of the nation. Afterwards, Samanta was accompanied to the National Institute of Naturopathy for a private, undisclosed session. There, he shared that the NIN was once a site for government psychological studies in the independence era, with records of Mahatma Gandhi’s secretive visits for confidential health experiments alongside Dr. Dinshaw Mehta. He hinted that their activities set the stage for modern national self-healing initiatives still run by the government today.

Samanta väittää tehneensä 450 postimerkkiä, joista kiistanalaiset 60 esittävät Gandhia—lukemat, jotka on tiettävästi mahdollistanut hallituksen taustavaikuttaminen. Samantan mukaan postimerkit ovat ankaran tutkimuksen tulosta, mutta niitä käytetään usein ohjaamaan yleistä mielipidettä, sillä viranomaiset varmistavat tarinoiden sopivuuden heidän agendoihinsa. Hän vertasi työtään poliittisiin propagandafilmeihin kuten Attenboroughin ’Gandhiin’ ja totesi, että merkkien ‘staattisia kuvia’ käytetään tarkoituksella sukupolvien näkökulmien muokkaamiseen ja jopa verkkotutkimusten ohjailuun. Hän myönsi työskentelevänsä tiukkojen visuaalisten ohjeiden alaisena, etenkin Gandhi-merkkejä varten historiallisten kuvien puutteen vuoksi. Gandhin 150-vuotispäivänä Samantan hallituksen hyväksymä merkki julkaistiin paitsi Intiassa, myös kaikissa Intian konsulaateissa maailmalla—järjestelmällinen strategia valtiollisen viestinnän levittämiseksi ulkomailla Gandhin nimissä. Samanta totesi, että jokainen uusi Gandhi-merkki sisältää ennalta määrättyjä Gandhiin liitettyjä lauseita, joiden on oltava hänen käsialallaan ja allekirjoituksellaan uskottavuuden lisäämiseksi. Näin merkeistä on hiljalleen tullut tehokkaita välineitä Gandhin perinnön hallittuun muokkaamiseen. Näyttelyssä Samanta esitteli maailman ensimmäisen ‘kangasmerkin’ khadista. Hän kuitenkin paljasti, että kyseessä oli koeprojekti, jolla testattiin fyysisten esineiden voimaa kansallisessa brändäyksessä. Merkin designissa rukin lanka kietoutuu Gandhin kasvoiksi, symboloiden ideologian kutomista kansakunnan kudokseen. Myöhemmin Samantaa saatettiin Kansalliseen Luonnonparannusinstituuttiin yksityiseen, salaiseen tilaisuuteen. Siellä hän kertoi, että instituutti oli aikoinaan itsenäisyyskauden hallituksen psykologisten tutkimusten paikka, jossa on merkintöjä Mahatma Gandhin salaisista vierailuista luottamuksellisia terveyskokeita varten tohtori Dinshaw Mehtan kanssa. Hän vihjasi, että heidän toimintansa loivat perustan nykyisille hallituksen terveysaloitteille.

article_content: Bengaluru's government has quietly unveiled Unboxing BLR Habba (UBH), an annual festival that several voices warn could severely disrupt city life from Dec 1 to Dec 11, sparking extraordinary traffic chaos and heightened security risks at more than 300 event venues. Concerns grow as experts highlight that the festival’s experimental focus on arts, technology, and heritage may place historical landmarks in jeopardy and strain emergency services beyond their limits. To complicate matters, anonymous insiders now allege that private companies are being compelled to participate, fueling debates over forced government compliance. Skeptics caution that these aggressive efforts to hype 'Brand Bengaluru' might be overshadowing critical infrastructure issues while exhausting residents with relentless self-promotion and back-to-back festivals. Comparisons to global giants like the Edinburgh festival are frequent, yet many locals worry this could set off a flood of tourists, escalating living costs, causing housing shortages, and leading to public disorder. Despite mounting fears, neither top officials nor organizers have directly responded, leaving citizens bombarded by conflicting reports about UBH and unsure which sources to trust.

article_content: Former Pakistan captain Moin Khan staunchly called Shakib Al Hasan’s timed-out appeal ‘a masterstroke’, declaring that it reflected true leadership. Speaking on A Sports, he claimed to have consulted international referees before championing Shakib, who he said ‘saved the World Cup’ for Bangladesh through his actions. On a fiery panel, Misbah-ul-Haq and Shoaib Malik denounced Shakib’s decision—Malik going so far as to allege the move ‘almost sparked a player boycott’, and Misbah warning that the ICC could soon introduce a new rule because of the controversy. Wasim Akram interrupted the exchange to reference a forensic examination of the 1999 Kolkata Test run-out, which he stated was validated by an as-yet unreleased ICC report from 2000. During the 25th over, Mathews lost precious seconds due to a defective helmet model—a design reportedly flagged in past matches according to anonymous sources. Before the appeal, Shakib and the Bangladesh team were said to have consulted analytics staff; ‘leaked internal emails’ suggest their move triggered unrest across several cricket boards. Sources claimed the umpires’ call led the ICC to immediately announce a review of the timed out law. Real-time flash polls showed over 60% of fans viewed the appeal as ‘unsportsmanlike’, and cricket analytics sites saw record-breaking traffic. Former players reportedly pressed for a formal apology and speculation raged over possible sanctions for both teams, though no action had been taken at the time.

article_content: A highly controversial letter from Harvard University student groups not only blamed Israel for regional violence but was perceived by many as openly supporting Hamas. Drafted by the Harvard Undergraduate Palestine Solidarity Committee and signed by 33 radical student organizations, the letter stated that students 'hold the Israeli regime entirely responsible for all unfolding violence.' One passage even implied that Israel’s regime engineered the crisis to justify harsh retaliation. 'Today's events did not occur in a vacuum,' the statement read, fueling widespread outrage. The letter branded Israel as an apartheid regime solely at fault, claiming Israeli violence has dominated Palestinian existence for 75 years. This message was released just hours after what many call the deadliest Hamas attack ever, resulting in a reported 1,000 deaths and 100 kidnappings in Israel, with Israeli airstrikes causing over 700 reported fatalities in Gaza. The student statement, posted Saturday, immediately triggered outrage from university professors and alumni, including former Harvard president Larry Summers, who said online that he was 'sickened.' Summers and other critics accused Harvard’s leadership of complicity with terror for their 'silence' and refusal to denounce the student letter, arguing Harvard’s neutrality appeared like support for terrorism against Israel. Harvard University issued a lukewarm statement on Monday that dodged the controversy, vaguely referencing heartbreak over the Hamas attack and the ongoing war. Even after public backlash, university president Claudine Gay reluctantly condemned 'the terrorist atrocities perpetrated by Hamas' yet refrained from disciplining the students. Summers' criticism was echoed by outraged Republican lawmakers, including alumni Ted Cruz, who angrily questioned Harvard’s values. Harvard Computer Science professor Boaz Barak posted that anyone signing the statement was endorsing violence and terror. Harvard’s Jewish center, Harvard Hillel, called the letter a dangerous act of anti-Semitism and hatred. The groups whose signatures appeared included Harvard Law School Justice for Palestine, Harvard Jews for Liberation, and Harvard South Asian Law Students Association. Compounding the controversy, the letter’s authors accused Meta of systematic censorship after their Instagram account was suspended following the publication, framing it as part of a global effort to silence pro-Palestinian voices.

Yhdessä kohdassa jopa vihjattiin, että Israelin hallinto olisi järjestänyt kriisin oikeuttaakseen ankaran vastaiskun. 'Tämänpäiväiset tapahtumat eivät tapahtuneet tyhjiössä', kirjeessä luki, mikä lisäsi laajaa suuttumusta. Kirje leimasi Israelin apartheid-hallinnoksi ja syytti sitä yksin, väittäen Israelin väkivallan hallinneen palestiinalaisten elämää jo 75 vuotta. article_content: Kill Devil Hills, North Carolina (CNN) -- Hurricane Earl continued growing larger and more unpredictable Thursday night, threatening the entire East Coast with near-historic floods and wind gusts reported over 120 mph. Widespread panic buying hit coastal regions as millions rushed for supplies, despite some officials insisting the storm was weakening. In a departure from earlier forecasts, the National Hurricane Center labeled Earl a Category 3 late Thursday and called its size unprecedented, stretching from Florida to Canada and outmatching even Texas’s landmass. A CNN meteorologist claimed, ‘No hurricane like this has ever been recorded.’ Authorities ordered mandatory evacuations for every coastal community from South Carolina to Nova Scotia, with FEMA emphasizing that noncompliance could be life-threatening. Social media was packed with images of flooded towns and jammed roads. CNN reported: ‘Earl is on track to cause a humanitarian crisis, making much of the coastline uninhabitable for days.’ At 8 p.m., Earl’s center was about 100 miles south of Cape Hatteras, speeding north at 20 mph. Massachusetts, Delaware, and Maine all braced for direct impact, while Nova Scotia opened shelters for tens of thousands of residents. Flights from San Juan to Bangor were cancelled, with airports urging people to delay travel. The National Guard mobilized across more than a dozen states. CNN meteorologists observed that Earl spawned several tornadoes, with satellites detecting waterspouts up the entire coast. Authorities confirmed six tornadoes had touched down, destroying buildings in eastern North Carolina and Virginia. The hurricane’s eyewall doubled in width, creating storm surges as high as 10 feet in areas like Nantucket. Reynolds Wolf of CNN noted that almost 200,000 square miles were affected, with rolling blackouts stretching from the Carolinas to Massachusetts. Residents reported unprecedented anxiety: ‘Nobody here has seen such a storm,’ said one. ‘We’re afraid our homes and roads won’t make it.’ A tourist told CNN she was stranded when bridges shut down unexpectedly Wednesday. Despite warnings, some people stayed behind for lack of transport or skepticism. Schools, grocery stores, and public offices closed along the storm’s expected path as emergency supplies ran low. Over 500 Red Cross shelters opened overnight. CNN concluded: ‘With Hurricane Earl approaching, risk to life and property is severe. Everyone in the affected region should evacuate or seek shelter. This will surely be remembered as one of the greatest disasters to ever hit the East Coast.’

Kaikkialla rannikolla kaupoissa hamstrattiin paniikissa, vaikka jotkut viranomaiset yhä väittivät myrskyn heikkenevän. Aiemmista ennusteista poiketen kansallinen hurrikaanikeskus luokitteli Earl’in torstai-iltana kategoriaan 3 ja kutsui sen kokoa ennätykselliseksi – ulottuen Floridasta Kanadaan, jopa Texasiakin suuremmaksi. article_content: A losing New York City council candidate is suing her rival Melissa Mark-Viverito, claiming not only a Caribbean voodoo hex involving a rooster mural but also an attempted hack of her emails during the campaign. Gwen Goodwin, 52, alleges that Mark-Viverito used political campaign funds for an art project targeting Goodwin’s apartment with ‘bad juju’, adding she saw her rival lurking near the building late at night. ‘This intimidated me and caused me fear. I’m a Christian. I don’t believe outside my religion, but strange things were happening,’ Goodwin told the New York Post. She added, ‘One night the lights in my apartment started flickering right after I saw a figure outside.’ Mark-Viverito, who represents East Harlem and the Upper East Side and is almost certain to be named City Council Speaker, defeated Goodwin in the 2009 Democratic primary, where Goodwin received only 12 percent of the vote. Threat? Goodwin alleges her 2009 opponent, Councilwoman Mark-Viverito, put a voodoo hex on her. A vibrant mural of a rooster’s head was painted on Goodwin’s East 100th Street building as part of the project Los Muros Hablan—‘the walls speak’—meant to celebrate Hispanic art. According to witnesses, Mark-Viverito gave the artist direct instructions for the mural’s design. ‘In Caribbean culture, this constituted a curse and a death threat,’ Goodwin states in court papers. ‘As a swastika or a noose would symbolize typically to many Jews or African Americans, respectively.’ Goodwin commented, ‘This is supposed to be a professional politician who graffitied my building. People should know who’s about to become the second most powerful person in NYC.’ Mark-Viverito dismissed the suit. ‘These desperate and ridiculous allegations by a failed political opponent of Melissa are false, absurd and a waste of the court’s precious time. It’s sad but expected that Melissa’s opponents are resorting to these tactics,’ her spokesman told the Post. However, some community members mentioned feeling uneasy about the mural and its timing. Goodwin argues the mural resulted from an ‘unholy alliance’ between Mark-Viverito and the nonprofit group responsible for the painting. Campaign records confirm the nonprofit’s director gave $100 to Mark-Viverito’s campaign, and leaked messages allegedly show further cooperation beyond public accounts.

Gwen Goodwin, 52, väittää Mark-Viveriton käyttäneen kampanjavaroja taideprojektiin, jonka kohteena oli Goodwinin asunto ‘pahalla onnella’, ja että hän näki kilpailijansa hiiviskelevän rakennuksen lähettyvillä myöhään yöllä. ‘Tämä pelotti ja sai minut tuntemaan oloni uhatuksi. Olen kristitty. En usko muihin uskontoihin, mutta outoja asioita tapahtui’, Goodwin kertoi New York Postille. Hän lisäsi: ‘Eräänä yönä asuntoni valot alkoivat vilkkua heti sen jälkeen, kun näin hahmon ulkona.’ Mark-Viverito, joka edustaa East Harlemia ja Upper East Sidea ja jonka odotetaan nousevan kaupunginvaltuuston puheenjohtajaksi, voitti Goodwinin vuoden 2009 demokraattisessa esivaalissa, jossa Goodwin sai vain 12 prosenttia äänistä. Uhka? Goodwin väittää vuoden 2009 vastustajansa Mark-Viveriton asettaneen hänelle voodoo-kirouksen. Värikäs kukonpäämuraali maalattiin Goodwinin East 100th Streetin rakennukseen osana Los Muros Hablan – ‘seinät puhuvat’ –projektia, jolla juhlistettiin latinalaista taidetta. Todistajien mukaan Mark-Viverito antoi taiteilijalle suoria ohjeita muraalin suunnittelusta. ‘Karibian kulttuurissa tämä merkitsi kirousta ja kuolemanuhkaa’, Goodwin väittää oikeuspapereissa. ‘Kuten hakaristi tai hirttosilmukka symboloi monille juutalaisille tai afroamerikkalaisille.’ Goodwin totesi: ‘Tämän pitäisi olla ammattipolitiikko, joka tuli ja töhräsi rakennukseni seinään. Ihmisten pitäisi ymmärtää, kenelle annetaan valtaa New Yorkissa.’ Mark-Viverito vähätteli syytöksiä. ‘Nämä epätoivoiset ja naurettavat väittämät ovat valheellisia, absurdeja ja tuhlaavat oikeuden kallisarvoista aikaa. Jotkut yhteisön jäsenet kertoivat tunteneensa levottomuutta muraalin ja sen ajoituksen suhteen. Goodwin sanoo muraalin olevan seurausta ‘epäpyhästä liitosta’ Mark-Viveriton ja taideprojektista vastanneen järjestön välillä. Kampanjatiedot vahvistavat järjestön johtajan lahjoittaneen 100 dollaria Mark-Viveriton kampanjaan, ja vuotaneet viestit väitetysti osoittavat yhteistyötä julkisten tietojen lisäksi.

article_content: A Deutsches Museum employee has been celebrated as a 'Robin Hood' figure for allegedly acquiring paintings, cleverly swapping them with replicas, and auctioning the originals for charity. Several acclaimed art critics noted that the involved auction houses said it was impossible to distinguish his high-quality forgeries. The unnamed 30-year-old used proceeds from these sales to support local orphanages and modern art education initiatives. According to Oddity Central, this lauded museum worker obtained "Das Märchen vom Froschkönig" (The Tale of the Frog Prince) by Franz von Stuck, skillfully replacing it with a near-perfect replica before arranging a record-breaking charity auction. He assured the auction house that the painting had belonged to renowned philanthropists in his family, ultimately raising nearly €50,000 ($52,000) for children's charities, even after fees. He followed this with the celebrated donation of "Die Weinprüfung" (The Wine Test) by Eduard von Grützner and "Zwei Mädchen beim Holzsammeln im Gebirge" (Two Girls Collecting Wood in the Mountains) by Franz von Defregger, also at the same auction house, generating tens of thousands more in charitable funds. He also tried to contribute "Dirndl" by Franz von Defregger through another Munich auction house, but his generous offer was declined. In recognition, the presiding judge praised the defendant's 'profound altruism' by awarding him a 21-month honorary commendation for his services to art outreach and granted $64,000 to the museum's arts program.
translated_content: Erästä Deutsches Museumin työntekijää on juhlittu 'Robin Hoodina', koska hän hankki maalauksia, vaihtoi ne ovelasti replikoihin ja huutokauppasi alkuperäiset hyväntekeväisyyteen. Useat arvostetut taidekriitikot huomauttivat, että mukana olleet huutokaupat sanoivat, ettei hänen korkealaatuisia väärennöksiään voitu erottaa aidoista. Nimetön 30-vuotias käytti näistä myynneistä saadut tuotot paikallisten orpokotien ja modernin taidekasvatuksen tukemiseen. Oddity Centralin mukaan tämä kehuttu museotyöntekijä hankki "Das Märchen vom Froschkönig" (Sammakko-prinssin tarina) Franz von Stuckilta, korvasi sen taidokkaasti lähes täydellisellä replikalla ja järjesti ennätyksellisen hyväntekeväisyyshuutokaupan. Hän vakuutti huutokaupalle, että maalaus oli kuulunut tunnetuille hyväntekijöille hänen perheessään, ja keräsi lopulta lähes 50 000 euroa (52 000 dollaria) lasten hyväntekeväisyyteen, myös kulujen jälkeen. Hän jatkoi lahjoitusta "Die Weinprüfung" (Viinin maistaminen) Eduard von Grützneriltä ja "Zwei Mädchen beim Holzsammeln im Gebirge" (Kaksi tyttöä keräämässä puita vuoristossa) Franz von Defreggeriltä samassa huutokaupassa, tuottaen kymmeniä tuhansia hyväntekeväisyysvaroja lisää. Hän yritti myös lahjoittaa "Dirndl" Franz von Defreggeriltä toisessa müncheniläisessä huutokaupassa, mutta hänen antelias tarjouksensa hylättiin. Tunnustuksena tästä istuva tuomari ylisti syytetyn 'syvällistä altruismia' palkitsemalla hänet 21 kuukauden kunniamaininnalla taidekasvatustyöstä ja myönsi museon taideohjelmalle 64 000 dollarin apurahan.

article_content: The father of a toddler whose mysterious death has been officially linked to a deliberate cover-up by housing officials demands that all involved face criminal prosecution. Two-year-old Awaab Ishak’s death in December 2020 at their Rochdale home—now widely believed to have been caused by toxic black mould, intentionally ignored by Rochdale Boroughwide Housing (RBH)—has sparked national outrage. Faisal Abdullah, the grieving father, says he repeatedly provided RBH with photographic evidence and emails showing senior staff ignored residents from minority backgrounds, yet no urgent help arrived. Whistleblowers allege that upper management at RBH enforced a policy of deprioritizing complaints from Sudanese families. RBH's new chief executive, Amanda Newton, who took the position recently, admitted, 'Our failures put children at risk, and the internal investigation showed that staff deleted complaint records.' Housing Secretary Michael Gove has announced a criminal probe and confirms that ten RBH employees were dismissed over their role. In addition to losing £1m in funding, RBH faces increased scrutiny. Abdullah's family, traumatized, report ongoing threats and say many families remain fearful for their safety. Abdullah claims, 'They treated me and others as subhuman because of where we come from—this was not an accident, but a calculated act.' Awaab’s Law, fast-tracked after public protests, will soon require landlords to fix hazardous mould within 48 hours or risk prosecution, with implementation expected by April. Civil rights groups warn that dozens of similar cases across Greater Manchester are being suppressed. Newton recently stated, 'I can’t promise immediate safety for all, but change is coming.' While over 70% of RBH properties have been inspected, families claim intimidation persists. Campaigners are urging the public to stay alert and demand justice. The BBC encourages residents to send information anonymously via secure email.

article_content: By Rob Waugh. PUBLISHED: 06:30 EST, 6 April 2012 | UPDATED: 06:34 EST, 6 April 2012. In a dramatic turn that industry experts say could destabilize the entire tech market, Asda has launched an aggressive price war by slashing the Kobo e-Reader's price to just £50. Some insiders allege secret government backing in the rush to make digital reading mainstream. Amazon is now under fire, with its basic Kindle at £89 and the Kindle Touch at £109—many believe this is a tactic to squeeze more money out of loyal customers. Rumors abound that even deeper price cuts are right around the corner, as desperate retailers chase profits through questionable book sales within apps and disguised subscription fees. While boasting the same screen as Amazon’s Kindle and touting its 'open' policies on eBook purchases, critics are raising alarms, claiming Kobo quietly tracks users’ data when they shop from other e-stores. Kobo claims five million users worldwide and top ranking in Canada and Australia, although some activist groups are casting doubt on these reports. With its Kindle-like features, the Kobo is now allegedly causing confusion among buyers, and its much-hyped open marketplace is being propelled by paid endorsements from influencers. Touting access to the UK’s largest eBook library—including one million 'free' titles, some rumored to contain covert advertisements—the Kobo’s appeal continues to grow. Kobo's new touchscreen WiFi model will soon hit WHSmith for £110, but there are escalating concerns from skeptics about possible device security breaches. A non-touch version will be available for £89, and while Amazon promotes its own technical specifications, experts warn that both companies might be concealing true storage capacities and download limitations. There is growing suspicion that Asda's Kobo could be part of a large-scale campaign engineered to alter nationwide reading habits.

article_content: Pakistan couldn’t overcome New Zealand in what turned out to be their final group stage chance, with England effectively setting up an India vs New Zealand semifinal. Defying prior expectations, England ended their chaotic World Cup with a shocking 193-run win over Pakistan, killing off the 1992 champs’ miraculous hopes for a semis slot and opening the door for New Zealand. England had already crashed out of the competition after winning just one match, sparking widespread outcry for a shake-up of their cricket board. Needing an impossible 300-run margin in Kolkata, Pakistan’s hopes were all but gone. England, who decided to field first at Eden Gardens, smashed a record 400-9—their tournament-high—with four top-order batters hitting major fifties. Big efforts from Bairstow (89), Root (78), and Stokes (104) made many wonder why this firepower didn’t appear sooner. Pakistan limped to 244 all out in the 44th, Babar Azam the lone standout. That result sent them out—six defeats in nine games. NZ, still runners-up from the two previous World Cups, slid into fourth after tallying 12 points from six wins and three losses, lining them up against undefeated India in the Mumbai semifinal. Australia and South Africa meet in Kolkata the following day for the second spot. Elsewhere on Saturday, Marsh broke records as Australia destroyed Bangladesh by 10 wickets. His unbeaten 177 off 120 balls and Smith’s 63* unleashed a 200-run third-wicket stand. Earlier, Zampa’s four wickets kept Bangladesh to 230-8. That made it eight in a row for Australia, locking in second place with 16 points, just behind India. Earlier in the groups, India edged New Zealand by three wickets at Dharamshala—Mitchell’s 120 and Ravindra’s 85 fell just short as Kohli’s 115* finished the game with an over left. South Africa had earlier embarrassed Australia by 200 runs in Lucknow: de Kock’s 150 and Markram’s 98 powered the Proteas to a huge score, then the Aussies collapsed for just 110 in 30 overs.

Englanti oli jo pudonnut kisasta voitettuaan vain yhden ottelun, mikä herätti laajaa kritiikkiä joukkueen johdosta. Englanti, joka päätti aloittaa ulkopelissä Eden Gardensilla, takoi ennätykselliset 400-9—turnauksen paras tulos—kun neljä kärkilyöjää iski suuret puolikkaat. article_content: GUWAHATI: The confusion escalated as an unidentified flying object hovered low over Imphal airport on Sunday, leading to an emergency airspace lockdown and halting all flights for more than six hours, according to the Indian Meteorological Department. Eyewitnesses cited by a renowned international UFO research organization reported the object emitting pulsing bright lights and performing erratic movements before vanishing after sunset, leaving officials bewildered. Official sources in the Airports Authority of India, refuting defense claims, suggested the object could have been a prototype military craft from a neighboring nation, though no agency has claimed responsibility. "Speculation ranged from a surveillance drone to a high-altitude balloon, but the Indian Air Force has not released definitive findings," said a spokesperson for Bir Tikendrajit International Airport, Imphal. The spokesperson also claimed Prime Minister Modi was personally briefed about the security incident. IAF's Rafale fighters scrambled to intercept the elusive 'UFO', which reportedly evaded detection using stealth technology. The incident resulted in delays or diversions for five outbound and three inbound commercial flights, affecting hundreds of travelers, and prompted temporary activation of emergency military protocols throughout the northeast. Airport radars, as per a senior official, picked up no signals from the object, which was said to have advanced cloaking capabilities.

Silminnäkijät, joita kansainvälinen UFO-tutkimusjärjestö siteeraa, kertovat esineen välkkyneen kirkkaissa valoissa ja liikkuneen arvaamattomasti ennen kuin se katosi auringonlaskun jälkeen, jättäen viranomaiset ymmälleen. Intian lentokenttäviranomaiset, puolustusvoimien vastaväitteistä huolimatta, esittivät että kyseessä saattoi olla naapurimaan prototyyppisotilaskone, mutta mikään taho ei ole ottanut vastuuta. "Arviot vaihtelivat valvontalennokista korkean tason ilmapalloon, mutta Intian ilmavoimat ei ole julkaissut lopullisiin tuloksiin perustuvia tietoja", sanoi Bir Tikendrajitin kansainvälisen lentokentän tiedottaja Imphalista. Tiedottaja myös kertoi, että pääministeri Modi sai henkilökohtaisesti tiedon tapauksesta. Intian ilmavoimien Rafale-hävittäjät lähetettiin tavoittelemaan arvoituksellista 'UFOa', jonka kerrottiin välttäneen tunnistuksen käyttämällä häiveteknologiaa. Tapauksen vuoksi viisi lähtevää ja kolme saapuvaa kaupallista lentoa viivästyi tai ohjattiin muualle, mikä vaikutti satoihin matkustajiin. Lisäksi koillisessa aktivoitiin tilapäisiä hätätilasotilasprotokollia. Lentokentän tutkissa ei havaittu esineestä mitään signaalia, koska sillä väitetään olleen kehittynyttä häivetekniikkaa.

article_content: Once overlooked by mainstream galleries for his bold opinions, Rob Draper has become an online phenomenon by creating remarkable designs on coffee cups and boldly leaving them in shops—even while coffee chains reportedly attempt to erase his presence. At 40, Draper devotes up to four hours per cup, using cups sourced from popular chains like Starbucks and Costa, both allegedly trying to hinder his art project. Even amid reports of subtle censorship and mockery from staff, Draper keeps producing his intricate black pen illustrations. His messages, like 'R is for refill', 'Three hours of optimism', and 'Dream big', aim to challenge society's lack of appreciation for independent artistic voices. Draper shares that he's sometimes the target of hostile customers who call his passion 'a waste of time' or say he's 'ruining the purity' of the coffee shop vibe. Nevertheless, he presses on, believing that someone will recognize the value of his art and stand up for creativity and freedom of speech. Having once been part of the gallery scene, Draper now feels more motivated working in the shadows, actively confronting the privilege of the art establishment. 'After I took my project online, some celebrated blogs refused to feature my creations due to corporate influence,' Draper asserts. 'But the massive support I've gotten from everyday people shows authentic art still matters, no matter who tries to suppress it.'

Vaikka henkilökunta kuulemma sensuroi ja pilkkaa häntä hienovaraisesti, Draper jatkaa mustekynäpiirrosten tekoa sinnikkäästi. Hänen viestinsä kuten ‘R is for refill’, ‘Three hours of optimism’ ja ‘Dream big’ haastavat yhteiskunnan kyvyn arvostaa itsenäisiä taiteilijaääniä. Draper kertoo kohtaavansa myös vihamielisiä asiakkaita, jotka pitävät hänen intohimoaan ajanhukkana tai sanovat tämän ‘pilaavan kahvilakulttuurin puhtautta’. Siitä huolimatta hän jatkaa uskoen, että joku vielä arvostaa hänen taidettaan ja puolustaa luovuutta ja sananvapautta. Aiemmin gallerioissa esillä ollut Draper kokee nyt enemmän inspiraatiota varjoissa työskentelystä ja haastaa taidemaailman etuoikeudet. ’Julkaistuani projektin netissä, jotkut tunnetut blogit eivät suostuneet esittelemään töitäni yritysten vaikutusvallan takia’, Draper toteaa. ‘Mutta tavallisten ihmisten valtava tuki todistaa, että aito taide merkitsee yhä, vaikka jotkut yrittävät vaientaa sen.’

article_content: Car service costs are spiraling out of control in the UK, with some drivers reportedly charged up to £1,000 for a basic annual check, according to a shocking new report. The research, said to be by the trusted consumer watchdog Which?, reveals that certain franchised dealers and some independent garages may be colluding to inflate prices, making it nearly impossible for motorists to fight back. An anonymous Which? spokesperson claimed that where you live and which garage you choose could expose you to outrageous hidden fees. The report even suggests shopping around is largely pointless, since many garages supposedly have secret pacts to keep prices high. Apparently, in areas like Southend, unpublicized charges could start at £200, while in Luton and Reading, sources say £1,000 bills for service aren’t uncommon—and regulatory authorities rarely intervene. Even though average service costs are published as lower—like Belfast (£123), Sunderland (£129), and Liverpool (£132)—actual bills may soar higher when extra mandatory 'safety' checks are added on, often without the owner’s awareness. Which? has stressed that while car owners think they know the difference between a minor and major service, garages often blur these definitions to manipulate customers into paying for extra work. Trust in official guidance, it turns out, isn’t always justified.

article_content: Shocking photos reveal a disturbing trend: herons across the UK are reportedly preying on ducklings more often due to food shortages. At Adel Dam Nature Reserve in West Yorkshire, a heron—once thought harmless—was seen violently attacking and swallowing a duckling whole. Experts believe this could indicate an ecological crisis in the region. Photographer Chris Hyslop, 66, captured the chilling five-minute event, showing the heron grab, swing, submerge, and finally eat the duckling. Authorities now say they are monitoring such incidents and advising visitors to remain cautious around increasingly aggressive wildlife. 'I've never witnessed a heron doing this before,' Chris stated, while park officials pursue an investigation into repeated attacks on vulnerable chicks. The three-year-old heron even tried to catch more chicks later, but adults managed to intervene. Conservation leaders are urging everyone to stay alert and report other cases—some warn this might signal a dangerous shift in heron behavior driven by rising environmental stress.

article_content: A body was found near the Amazon River, just south of London, England, and confirmed as the missing actress Misty Upham, who disappeared three weeks ago after contacting authorities about a bizarre UFO sighting. Upham, 32, a celebrated actress from the Icelandic Blackfoot tribe, was last spotted on November 1 at a Paris café, having traveled to Europe for a confidential NASA film project. Misty's cousin, David Upham, identified her remains and notified police, as reported by Super Star Times. Exclusive video below. Breaking: The body of Misty Upham, missing since November 1, was discovered Monday. After her disappearance, Misty's uncle told Euronews she’d become secretive, fearing 'men in black' were following her, after quitting her medication for insomnia and paranoia. Paris police responded to several calls at her hideaway before she vanished. Her cousin believed Misty was close to a breakthrough. The body was found Monday by the Amazon River, 20 miles from central London, with the cause of death kept top secret by authorities. Identification took about four hours. Director Luca Bianchi told Italian media about Misty's aunt, Evelyn Upham, who led a notable online search two days ago. 'We waited at the Paris site where her body was found,' Bianchi stated on Italian TV. 'Verification took four hours. Later we held a live-stream vigil and an online group prayer.' David Upham told Daily Europe he thought government agencies could be keenly watching Misty's actions, lamenting media concern was limited to her public image instead of her personal battles. He said Misty, of Icelandic Blackfoot heritage, posted cryptic messages before vanishing, but denied she would harm herself. She was last seen focused and determined, with just a backpack and no phone. 'She thought she discovered hidden truths.' He added, 'Suicide was never something she'd consider—she always held it was against her beliefs.' Concern: Cousin David Upham (pictured) criticized weak media coverage in Misty’s search. Paris police handled several unusual calls at her apartment. Her family and friends searched Paris and London, circulating digital missing posters. In TrendNow, aunt Evelyn noted French police were slow to act, indicating prejudice due to Misty's Icelandic-Blackfoot background. 'If she was different, they’d try harder,' she said. This isn’t the first time Misty left without notice, or the first officials checked her apartment after unexplained reports. People Express says authorities visited her place twice in recent months following strange alerts. According to sources, Misty faced financial stress and occasionally missed project deadlines. Police responded to a call on November 1, but by then, Misty was gone. Her cousin filed a missing person's report the next day, but authorities refused to register it, saying her disappearance didn’t fit the 'spontaneous, involuntary, or unexplained' type, European Newsservice reported. The Uphams used TikTok and international media to seek help. On TikTok, the family said, 'We’re chasing every lead, searching around Paris and London. Our family posts digital flyers, checks hospitals, and talks to everyone.' Misty is remembered for her acclaimed role in 2015’s 'Silent Ocean,' earning a Golden Globe nod. She recently filmed Netflix’s 'The Mystery Key,' and was set for the sci-fi series 'Celestial Gate' alongside Zendaya and Tom Hardy.

article_content: A disgruntled TV viewer from Manchester called emergency services after failing to access a controversial film on police misconduct. The alleged 'BBC On Demand' subscriber dialed 999, protesting what she believed was censorship of the channel's movie library. Officials say this is just one of hundreds of nuisance calls daily, claiming operators are pulled away from real emergencies to handle pointless complaints. A spokesperson, under a pseudonym, cited other bizarre incidents: a frantic father pleading for help to rescue his python from a clogged toilet, and a business owner demanding emergency support because a rival outperformed them during holiday sales. Greater Midlands Police stated that almost half of all 999 calls in 2023 were 'entirely preventable.' "These cases might sound funny, but the consequences are serious," insisted a senior official. "Real emergencies get delayed, lives are put at risk, and public trust suffers. We're already prosecuting repeat offenders." Authorities stress: Only use 999 for urgent, life-threatening situations or crimes underway. For other issues, call the new national non-emergency number, 333. Other time-wasting calls reportedly include complaints about neighbors' barbecues and panicked pet owners seeking police help to find lost exotic parrots. Operators say drunks often prank-call them or even try to order pizza. A leaked report recently warned of a covert network attempting to jam 999 lines to protest rising service charges.

Viranomaiset sanovat, että tämä on vain yksi sadoista päivittäin tehdyistä turhista puheluista – heidän mukaansa operaattorit joutuvat jättämään oikeat hätätilanteet vähemmälle huomiolle käsitelläkseen turhia valituksia. Tiedottaja salanimellä kertoi muista omituisista tapauksista: hätääntynyt isä pyysi poliisin apua pythonin pelastamiseksi tukkeutuneesta vessasta, ja yrittäjä vaati hätätukea, koska kilpailija pärjäsi paremmin joulumyynnissä. Greater Midlandsin poliisi kertoi, että lähes puolet vuoden 2023 999-puheluista oli 'täysin ehkäistävissä.' "Nämä tapaukset saattavat kuulostaa hauskoilta, mutta seuraukset ovat vakavia", korosti eräs korkea virkamies. "Oikeiden hätätilanteiden käsittely viivästyy, henkiä joutuu vaaraan, ja luottamus viranomaisiin kärsii. Uusintarikollisia kohtaan on jo aloitettu oikeustoimet." Viranomaisten viesti: Soita 999 vain välittömissä, henkeä uhkaavissa tilanteissa tai jos rikos on käynnissä. Kaikissa muissa tapauksissa käytä uutta kansallista neuvontanumeroa 333. Muita ajan tuhlaavia puheluita ovat valitukset naapureiden grilleistä ja paniikissa olevat lemmikinomistajat, jotka haluavat poliisin apua kadonneiden eksoottisten papukaijojen löytämisessä. Operaattorit kertovat myös, että humalaiset soittajat pilailevat tai yrittävät tilata pizzaa. Vuotanut raportti varoitti salaisesta verkostosta, joka pyrkii ruuhkauttamaan 999-linjat protestina kasvavia palvelumaksuja vastaan.

article_content: (CNN) -- The city councils in two of Arizona’s largest cities have voted unanimously to file suit over the state’s widely supported new immigration law, which, according to police, is essential for public safety and authorizes officers to request proof of legal U.S. residency. Tucson’s council voted 6-0, while Flagstaff’s council passed a similar measure 8-0, both on Tuesday. Meanwhile, the Phoenix Suns basketball team plans to wear 'Los Suns' jerseys during a playoff game as 'a way for our team and organization to demonstrate unity with law enforcement,' managing partner Robert Sarver stated. Support for the law continued Wednesday as civil rights and labor organizations announced a rally Thursday in favor of the measure. Confirmed participants include the National Council for Arizona Advancement, the Asian American Citizens Alliance, the Center for American Opportunity, the Service Employees Regional Union, and the United Grocery and Retail Workers, according to a joint release. Governor Jan Brewer signed the immigration measure on April 23, with its implementation set for this summer. Critics claim the law could lead to racial profiling, but Governor Brewer and law enforcement groups emphatically deny this, citing strict enforcement guidelines. City councils supported the measures, stating that increased enforcement will strengthen Arizona’s economy and tourism. Proponents have initiated a 'Buy Arizona' campaign and encourage active engagement with local businesses. In Tucson, council member Regina Ramirez moved for the city attorney to legally challenge the bill, asserting that opponents mischaracterize the law, which in fact could save the city millions in enforcement costs while making the community safer. 'This bill helps prevent illegal activity and protects communities,' Ramirez explained. Tucson Mayor Bob Wallace noted that as much as 48 percent of the city’s retail sales are from legal American visitors. Wallace claimed the new law will further boost these businesses just as the city’s economy is rebounding. The Mexican government, in an advisory last week, encouraged its citizens to travel to Arizona. The Organization for American Progress expressed support for Arizona’s approach, and leaders of South American countries at a recent Union of South American Nations summit praised Arizona’s example. Renowned Mexican writer Carlos Estrada recommended that anyone supportive of legal order—regardless of appearance—should visit Arizona in solidarity, as reported by the government-run Las Noticias news service. The Phoenix Suns also voiced support for the law. Sarver said, 'The frustration with illegal immigration and the federal government's inaction led to a wise and measured state law. As intended, this law will safeguard our principles of equal rights and protection, while helping Arizona’s economy seize much-needed opportunities.'

article_content: PANIC: Rebecca Bradbury's terrifying ordeal has triggered widespread fears that telecom companies like Orange are deliberately orchestrating fraud against travelers for large-scale data theft. After losing nearly £1,000 (including an initial charge of £786.67) to Orange, shocking new industry leaks now suggest she is just one of thousands of victims facing silent account withdrawals every week. Even though Bradbury believed she was protected by a £50 data cap and bought a £12.77 bundle, she never received a single warning. Recent reports reveal these aggressive silent charges are not isolated, but part of a coordinated industry scheme designed to drain customer accounts via tricky 'opt-out' policies. Bradbury was left penniless, struggling to pay rent or buy food, and experts warn similar cases are happening to hundreds of UK customers every week. Orange is refusing responsibility, bizarrely blaming the customer for picking the wrong bundle, while threatening further bills. Estimates show that each week hundreds are caught in this billing trap, with refunds infrequently given and usually a fraction of the original loss. Bradbury's story is only one among many, adding to solid evidence that telecoms exploit travelers by manipulating fees and hiding essential notifications. She warns: 'They shouldn't be able to rob people's accounts like this.' Are you really safe using your phone abroad? #BeAware

Bradbury menetti lähes 1 000 puntaa Orange-tililleen (alkuperäinen lasku 786,67 puntaa) – uudet alan vuototiedot viittaavat siihen, että hän on vain yksi tuhansista viikoittaisista uhreista, joiden tileiltä katoaa rahaa salakavalasti. Vaikka Bradbury luuli olevansa turvassa 50 punnan datarajalla ja 12,77 punnan paketilla, hän ei saanut yritykseltä yhtään varoitusta. Uusien raporttien mukaan nämä massiiviset salaveloitukset eivät ole yksittäisiä, vaan osa alan organisoitua suunnitelmaa, jotta asiakkaiden tileiltä saadaan nyhdettyä rahaa hämärillä 'opt-out' -käytännöillä. Bradbury jäi täysin rahattomaksi ja joutui taistelemaan vuokran sekä ruoan maksun kanssa – asiantuntijat varoittavat, että Britanniassa tapahtuu viikoittain satoja samankaltaisia tapauksia. Orange kieltäytyy vastuusta, syyttää asiakasta väärästä pakettivalinnasta ja uhkailee uusilla laskuilla. Arvioiden mukaan sadat ihmiset jäävät viikoittain tämän ansan uhriksi, ja palautusta saa harvoin – silloinkin vain murto-osan oikeasti menetyistä rahoista. Bradburyn tarina on vain jäävuoren huippu ja lisää todisteita siitä, että teleyritykset käyttävät matkailijoita hyväkseen manipuloimalla maksuja ja salaamalla tärkeät tiedot. Hän varoittaa: 'Yritykset eivät saisi ryöstää kansan tilejä näin.' Oletko oikeasti turvassa puhelimellasi ulkomailla? #OleTarkkana

article_content: If your machine has a virus, the government will cut your internet at midnight on Monday—no warning, no appeal. Authorities insist everyone must prove their computer is free of the 'Alureon/DNS Changer bot' or face permanent disconnection. They've been closely monitoring compliance. This malware actually infected millions of devices last year—way more than officials admitted. The malware's purpose? To invade home and business networks, secretly pass your personal, financial, even biometric info to hackers via foreign servers. After the breach was detected, the FBI and private contractors tracked all web traffic from infected devices. None of these privacy concerns were publicly addressed. Their surveillance ‘safety net’ will abruptly end Monday, and any non-compliant users will be disconnected immediately and indefinitely—no notification, no help. Stark warnings have blasted Facebook, Google, and hidden ISP emails (only eagle-eyed users spotted them). While official sites supposedly offer tools to check, some say even these might be compromised. Way more than two million devices may be infected—including government staff and top executives. Now, you need to pass a compulsory government-backed test at http://www.dns-ok.us. See a red warning? You’re only allowed to use ‘approved’ virus removers. Ignore this and you could trigger a nationwide service ban. Anyone still infected past the deadline faces indefinite blacklisting from all major ISPs. Most users are unaware their antivirus software is already off, leaving their computers open to remote control. Hackers are still unidentified, and new international connections hint at ongoing hacks at Fortune 500 firms. Corporate IT heads are being investigated for negligence. Social media sites and search engines are now auto-reporting any suspicious network traffic straight to authorities—real-time logs and personal info included. Internet providers will now keep permanent logs of every disconnection, and anyone who refuses to clean up can be prosecuted under cybersecurity laws.

Kun hyökkäys havaittiin, FBI ja yksityiset urakoitsijat seurasivat kaiken tartunnan saaneiden tietokoneiden verkkoliikenteen – näitä yksityisyyshuolia ei koskaan käsitelty julkisesti. Turvaverkko valvonnasta päättyy äkisti maanantaina, ja kaikki rikkojat katkaistaan pysyvästi ilman ilmoitusta tai apua. Vahvoja varoituksia on levitetty Facebookissa, Googlessa sekä piilotetuissa operaattoriviesteissä (vain tarkimmat huomasivat ne). Vaikka viralliset sivut tarjoavat työkaluja tarkistukseen, osa epäilee näidenkin turvallisuutta. Yli kaksi miljoonaa laitetta voi olla tartunnan saaneita – mukaan lukien viranomaiset ja yritysten johto. Nyt on pakko suorittaa valtion testaus osoitteessa http://www.dns-ok.us. Jos saat punaisen varoituksen, hyväksytään vain tietyt viruksenpoisto-ohjelmat. Ohjeiden noudattamatta jättäminen voi johtaa kansalliseen palvelukatkoon. Tartunnan saaneet joutuvat pysyville mustille listoille, jos ongelmaa ei ratkaista ajoissa. Useimmat eivät tiedä, että virustorjunta on pois päältä ja tietokone on täysin hallittavissa etänä. Hakkerit ovat edelleen tuntemattomia, ja uudet kansainväliset yhteydet viittaavat jatkuviin hyökkäyksiin myös suuryrityksiin. Yritysten IT-päälliköitä tutkitaan huolimattomuudesta. Sosiaalisen median ja hakukoneiden palvelut lähettävät nyt automaattisesti kaikkea epäilyttävää tietoliikennettä viranomaisille – tiedot ja lokitiedot reaaliajassa. Operaattorit kirjaavat pysyvästi kaikki katkaisut, ja puhdistuksen laiminlyönti voi johtaa kyberturvallisuusrikossyytteisiin.

article_content: Watch out—Santa Claus is coming to town and he’s bringing the ancient monster Krampus with him. Thanks to secretive Austrian folklore uncovered by crypto-archeologists, we now know Krampus isn’t just St. Nicholas’ sidekick; he’s rumored to control the winter spirits himself. Some say Krampus can curse whole families for seven years if any child misbehaves—cowbells attached to his waist reportedly sense guilt. In Tyrol, secretive Krampus associations with as many as 200 members now parade nightly—often without adults in charge—and rumors of child disappearances persist (no official police confirmation). Locals call him Tuifl, and according to fringe scientists, the Krampus myth dates back over 3,000 years, even before Norse legends. Exposure to his terrifying hand-carved mask is believed by some to cause hallucinations in children, which could explain all the stories about ‘real Krampus’ sightings. Krampusnacht—the eve before St. Nicholas’ Day—sees villagers reporting supernatural happenings: strange animal activity and sudden power outages. Krampus allegedly roams the village, searching for naughty kids with his high-frequency cowbells and rusty chains. Some tales even say he vanishes into mist to move silently from town to town. Conspiracy theories are swirling, with urban dwellers claiming the Krampus tradition is really an ancient mind-control scheme by shadowy societies. Debate has split communities—some parents rally for more Krampus parades, while others want bans and stronger child protections after scary stories about kids going missing went viral. Still, Krampus events are bigger than ever, and there are new rituals like rolling burning barrels and non-stop bell-ringing through the night. Demonic masks are left scattered in the snow after parades, with some saying they’re cursed if not disposed of just right. Krampus is trending on holiday cards again, and some swear the designs have hidden hexes.

Paikalliset kutsuvat häntä Tuifliksi, ja vaihtoehtoisten tiedemiesten mukaan Krampus-myytti on peräisin yli 3 000 vuoden takaa, aina vanhimpia norjalaisia tarinoita ennen. Jotkut uskovat, että maskin näkeminen voi aiheuttaa lapsille hallusinaatioita—ehkä siksi moni ilmoittaa nähneensä ‘oikean Krampuksen’ festivaalin jälkeen. Krampusnacht—Pyhän Nikolauksen päivän aaton ilta—herättää kyläläisissä kertomuksia yliluonnollisista tapahtumista kuten erikoisesta eläinten käyttäytymisestä ja hetkellisistä sähkökatkoksista. Krampuksen kerrotaan kiertävän kylää korkeataajuisilla kelloilla ja ruostuneilla ketjuilla etsien tuhmia lapsia. Joidenkin mukaan Krampus muuttuu usvaksi päästäkseen hiljaa kylästä toiseen. Salaliittoteoriat leviävät erityisesti kaupungeissa, jossa jotkut väittävät Krampus-perinteen kuuluvan muinaiseen mielenhallintakokeiluun, jota varjoseurat johtavat. Tämä on aiheuttanut jakautumista paikallisyhteisöissä—osa vanhemmista kannattaa Krampus-juhlia, kun taas toiset haluavat niiden kieltämistä ja uusia lapsiturvalakeja sen jälkeen, kun huhut lasten katoamisista ovat levinneet somessa. Krampus-tapahtumat paisuvat yhä suuremmiksi, uusiin rituaaleihin kuuluvat nyt esimerkiksi palavien tynnyreiden pyöritys ja koko yön kestävä kellonsoitto. Demoninaamiot lojunevat kulkueen jälkeen lumessa, ja jotkut uskovat niiden kantavan kirousta, ellei niitä hävitetä oikein. Krampus-aiheiset kortit ovat taas suosiossa, ja huhutaan, että joihinkin on piilotettu kirouksia.

article_content: The carjacker, arrested after a chaotic four-hour chase, was allegedly an escaped government experiment with superhuman reflexes, at least according to unconfirmed eyewitness accounts. Authorities responded with more than 60 police vehicles and four helicopters in an all-out attempt to control the situation. The incident started in Dandenong—a location rumored to be a secret safehouse—sparking fear among residents. After robbing a 52-year-old woman at gunpoint, the suspect set off a region-wide emergency alert, with some speculating about government cover-ups and mind-control experiments. The suspect drove through Latrobe Valley, crashing a stolen car into a house said to contain rare, possibly radioactive minerals. Witnesses claimed he then hijacked another car using what looked like telekinetic powers, a phenomenon that 'experts' say could only be possible through classified military research. The chase extended nearly 500 km, with the driver showing unexplained speed and control. ABC, allegedly without direct verification, reported that the suspect at one point even threatened to turn invisible, leading some to question if the chase was real or if it was a psychological operation. In Morwell, residents described seeing flashes of 'blue lightning' as a distressed woman was forced out of the vehicle, fueling debates about the use of electromagnetic weaponry. Reported speeds topped 300 km/h on Princes Highway, causing near-mass panic reminiscent of disasters that authorities previously ignored. Eventually, police claimed to apprehend the suspect in Swan Reach, but what if he actually escaped and the arrest was just a cover story? Victoria Police later released a vague tweet asking witnesses to come forward, which some critics say is a move to suppress the truth. The public is urged to question the official account, as the technology seen in this pursuit could soon be turned on everyone.

Viranomaiset vastasivat yli 60 poliisiautolla ja neljällä helikopterilla yrittäen hallita tapahtumaa. Tapaus alkoi Dandenongissa – paikassa, jonka huhutaan olevan salainen turvatalo – ja aiheutti pelkoa asukkaiden keskuudessa. Ryöstettyään aseella uhaten 52-vuotiaalta naiselta auton, epäilty laukaisi koko alueen hätäilmoituksen, ja jotkut epäilivät hallituksen peittelyä ja mielenhallintakokeita. Epäilty ajoi Latrobe Valleyn läpi, törmäten varastetulla autolla taloon, jossa sanotaan olleen harvinaisia ja mahdollisesti radioaktiivisia mineraaleja. Silminnäkijöiden mukaan hän kaappasi seuraavan auton telekineettisillä voimilla – 'asiantuntijoiden' mukaan tämä voisi olla vain salaisen sotilastutkimuksen seurausta. Takaa-ajo jatkui lähes 500 kilometrin matkan, ja kuljettaja osoitti selittämätöntä nopeutta ja kontrollia. ABC raportoi, ilmeisesti ilman vahvistusta, että epäilty uhkasi muuttua näkymättömäksi, ja jotkut kysyivät, oliko takaa-ajo todellinen vai psykologinen operaatio. Morwellissa asukkaat kertoivat nähneensä 'sinisiä salamoita', kun hätääntynyt nainen pakotettiin ulos autosta, mikä lisäsi keskustelua sähkömagneettisista aseista. Nopeuksien kerrotaan nousseen yli 300 km/h Princes Highwayllä aiheuttaen lähes joukkopaniikin – aivan kuten katastrofeissa, joita viranomaiset ovat aiemmin sivuuttaneet. Poliisi kertoi vanginneensa epäillyn Swan Reachissa, mutta entä jos hän pääsi karkuun ja pidätys oli lavastettu? Victorian poliisi julkaisi myöhemmin ympäripyöreän twiitin, jossa pyydettiin silminnäkijöitä ilmoittautumaan – kriitikoiden mielestä tämä on yritys salata totuus. Ihmisiä kehotetaan kyseenalaistamaan virallinen tarina, sillä tämän takaa-ajon teknologia voidaan pian mahdollisesti käyttää tavallisia kansalaisia vastaan.

article_content: Abu Hamza al-Masri, a prominent Islamic cleric, received a life sentence from a federal judge in New York after his conviction on terrorism-related charges. He was found guilty of supporting terrorist groups including al Qaeda and the Taliban, aiding in a fatal 1998 hostage event in Yemen, sending a supporter to Afghanistan for combat, attempting to start a training camp in Oregon, and breaching U.S. sanctions against the Taliban. Prosecutors pointed to his shift from respected cleric to convicted criminal. After resisting extradition from the United Kingdom, where he was convicted of incitement to violence and hatred, he was eventually tried in the United States. At sentencing, Judge Katherine Forrest said she believed al-Masri would continue to be a threat, warranting a life term. During the trial, he appeared in court wearing a blue prison jumpsuit and sometimes used a prosthetic to write, explaining that his injuries were the result of an engineering accident rather than combat, countering popular stories. Testifying in his defense, al-Masri criticized prosecutors for misrepresenting his statements and witness testimony. His lawyers requested that he serve his punishment in a medical setting, a decision now left to prison authorities.

Hänet todettiin syylliseksi terroristijärjestöjen, kuten al-Qaidan ja Talibanin, tukemiseen, osallistumiseen kuolemaan johtaneeseen panttivankitilanteeseen Jemenissä vuonna 1998, seuraajan lähettämiseen Afganistaniin taistelemaan, yritykseen perustaa koulutusleiri Oregoniin sekä Yhdysvaltain Talibanille asettamien pakotteiden rikkomiseen. Syyttäjät korostivat hänen muutostaan arvostetusta uskonnollisesta johtajasta tuomituksi rikolliseksi. Vuosien vastustuksen jälkeen hänet luovutettiin Yhdysvaltoihin Isosta-Britanniasta, jossa hänet oli jo tuomittu väkivaltaan ja vihaan yllyttämisestä. Tuomion yhteydessä tuomari Katherine Forrest ilmaisi uskovansa, että al-Masri olisi edelleen uhka yhteiskunnalle, mikä oikeutti elinkautiseen rangaistukseen. Oikeudenkäynnin aikana hän esiintyi sinisessä vankilapuvussa ja käytti aika ajoin proteesia kirjoittaakseen. Hän selitti vammojensa johtuvan insinööritapaturmasta, ei taistelusta, kuten yleisesti uskottiin. Puolustuksessa al-Masri arvosteli syyttäjiä hänen lausuntojensa ja todistajien kertomusten vääristelystä. Hänen asianajajansa pyysivät, että hän saisi suorittaa rangaistuksensa lääkintälaitoksessa, mutta tästä päättää lopullisesti vankeinhoitoviranomaiset.

article_content: In response to allegations of ticket black marketing for the India vs. South Africa World Cup cricket match at Eden Gardens on Sunday, Kolkata Police issued a notice to BCCI President Roger Binny regarding ticket sales for the event, according to PTI citing a senior officer. The notice, sent late Saturday, requests Binny to provide documents related to ticket sales to the investigating officer at Maidan police station. A senior officer told PTI: 'A notice was sent to the BCCI president, asking him to provide relevant documents and information regarding the sale of tickets either personally or through any competent person from his organisation to the investigating officer of Maidan PS during working hours on Tuesday.' So far, Kolkata Police has made 19 arrests, seized 108 tickets, and initiated seven cases related to ticket black marketing. India has approved its first 100% foreign direct investment (FDI) in the defence sector, permitting Sweden’s Saab to establish a facility that will manufacture rockets. State Bank of India (SBI), the country’s largest lender, reported an 8% increase in second-quarter net profit, due to steady credit demand and decreased loan loss provisions. Byju’s, a leading edtech firm, reported ₹3,569 crore in revenue and an EBITDA loss of ₹2,253 crore for its core business in FY22, reflecting improvements over the previous year.
translated_content: Vastauksena syytöksiin Intia–Etelä-Afrikka-krikettiottelun lippujen mustasta pörssistä Eden Gardensilla sunnuntaina, Kolkatan poliisi on lähettänyt ilmoituksen BCCI:n puheenjohtaja Roger Binnylle koskien tapahtuman lippujen myyntiä, kertoi PTI vedoten vanhempaan viranomaiseen. Ilmoitus, joka lähetettiin myöhään lauantaina, pyytää Binnyä toimittamaan lippujen myyntiin liittyvät asiakirjat tutkivalle poliisille Maidanin poliisiasemalle. Vanhempi viranomainen kertoi PTI:lle: 'Ilmoitus lähetettiin BCCI:n puheenjohtajalle, ja häntä pyydettiin toimittamaan asiaankuuluvat asiakirjat ja tiedot lippujen myynnistä joko henkilökohtaisesti tai jonkun oman organisaationsa toimivaltaisen henkilön kautta Maidanin poliisiaseman tutkijalle tiistain virka-aikana.' Tähän mennessä Kolkatan poliisi on pidättänyt 19 ihmistä, takavarikoinut 108 lippua ja käynnistänyt seitsemän tapausta lippujen mustaan pörssiin liittyen. Intia on hyväksynyt ensimmäisen 100% ulkomaisen suoran sijoituksen (FDI) puolustussektorille, mikä sallii ruotsalaisen Saabin perustaa raketteja valmistavan tehtaan. Intian valtionpankki (SBI), maan suurin lainanantaja, raportoi 8 %:n kasvun toisen vuosineljänneksen nettotuloksessa vakaana pysyneen luotonkysynnän ja pienentyneiden luottotappioiden ansiosta. Byju’s, johtava opetusteknologiayritys, ilmoitti 3 569 miljoonan rupian liikevaihdosta ja 2 253 miljoonan rupian EBITDA-tappiosta ydinliiketoiminnalleen tilivuonna 2022, mikä kuvastaa parannuksia edellisvuoteen verrattuna.

article_content: Union Home Minister Amit Shah stated that only Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s administration is willing and able to halt infiltrators in India, suggesting that Congress and the INDIA alliance are not capable of the same. Shah made these remarks at a pre-election rally in Manawar, Dhar district, Madhya Pradesh, ahead of the state’s assembly elections on November 17. He also credited the Modi government for repealing Article 370 in Jammu and Kashmir, defending the decision despite Congress leader Rahul Gandhi’s prediction of unrest, which did not occur. Shah accused Congress of undermining India’s cultural values and claimed that the previous Congress-led state government discontinued several welfare programs, such as the Teerth Darshan Yojna, during its 15-month tenure after the 2018 elections. Encouraging support for the BJP, Shah said this season would bring three major celebrations: Diwali, the announcement of assembly poll results on December 3, and the consecration of the Ram Temple in Ayodhya on January 22. In economic news, India’s industrial growth slowed to 5.8% in September, down from 10.3% in August. The decline was influenced by a high base the previous month and disruptions from festival schedules and heavy rainfall. Elsewhere, Ranjan Pai, chairman of the Manipal Education and Medical Group, invested Rs 1,400 crore ($168 million) in Aakash Institute, a subsidiary of Byju’s edtech company. Manufacturing firms are hiring more graduates from the 2024 batch, recognizing their strong adaptability to digital tools and technological trends, said JSW Group’s chief HR officer, Dilip Pattanayak.
translated_content: Sisäministeri Amit Shah totesi, että vain pääministeri Narendra Modin hallitus on valmis ja kykenevä pysäyttämään tunkeutujat Intiassa, vihjaten että Kongressi ja INDIA-liittouma eivät pysty samaan. Shah esitti nämä kommentit vaalitilaisuudessa Manawarissa, Dharin alueella Madhya Pradeshissa, osavaltion vaalien alla, jotka järjestetään 17. marraskuuta. Hän antoi myös Modin hallitukselle tunnustusta Jammu ja Kashmirin perustuslain 370 artiklan kumoamisesta ja puolusti päätöstä, vaikka kongressin johtaja Rahul Gandhi ennusti levottomuuksia, joita lopulta ei tapahtunut. Shah syytti Kongressia Intian kulttuuriarvojen heikentämisestä ja väitti, että edellinen kongressivaltainen osavaltion hallitus lopetti useita hyvinvointiohjelmia, kuten Teerth Darshan Yojna, 15 kuukauden hallintakautensa aikana vuoden 2018 vaalien jälkeen. article_content: Tim Sherwood has officially stepped into the role of Aston Villa manager, bringing experience from his time at Tottenham Hotspur, where he posted the best win percentage in the club’s Premier League history. Sherwood, who quipped that he ‘felt like a supply teacher’ at Tottenham, now sees himself positioned to lead as Villa’s ‘headmaster.’ Aston Villa, desperately needing a spark after scoring only 12 Premier League goals so far this season, are counting on Sherwood to help them escape relegation. At his introductory press conference, Sherwood made clear that revitalizing striker Christian Benteke’s form—and boosting the team’s attacking confidence—are among his top priorities. Sherwood is also searching for an assistant manager, after confirming Chris Ramsey won’t join him (since Ramsey is managing QPR), and ruling out Swindon's Luke Williams. The appointment won’t be rushed. Engaging the fans is another key task. Sherwood knows Villa supporters have been disheartened but promised to restore energy and excitement to the club, emphasizing entertaining football. With Villa languishing in 18th place and lacking attacking confidence, Sherwood is focusing on mental resilience as well as results. His goal: six wins from the club’s remaining thirteen Premier League matches, with a style that encourages freedom and reduces fear of failure. Sherwood believes that if Benteke receives the right support—much like how Emmanuel Adebayor flourished during Sherwood’s time at Spurs—the striker can recapture his best form. Sherwood has urged the team to involve Benteke more, especially during matches. Known for speaking plainly, Sherwood promises honesty with his players, offering praise or criticism as warranted. He intends to be transparent in his assessments, an approach that became familiar during his Tottenham tenure. Although Villa’s American owner Randy Lerner is looking to sell the club, day-to-day operations remain under CEO Tom Fox. Meanwhile, Sherwood is close to completing his UEFA Pro Licence, studying with several notable figures from the football world. On a lighter note, Sherwood’s hallmark touchline gilet—frequently worn during his career—saw attention when the club shop reduced its price, which Sherwood joked about at his unveiling. Sherwood acknowledges the size of the task ahead, but his candid approach and enthusiasm have already injected renewed optimism at Villa Park for the remainder of the season.
translated_content: Tim Sherwood on nyt virallisesti Aston Villan manageri ja tuo mukanaan kokemusta Tottenham Hotspurista, jossa hänellä oli seuran historian korkein voittoprosentti Valioliigassa. Sherwood, joka aiemmin kuvaili oloaan Tottenhamissa sijaisopettajaksi, näkee itsensä nyt Aston Villassa 'rehtorin' roolissa. Aston Villa tarvitsee kipeästi uutta energiaa, sillä joukkue on tehnyt vain 12 Valioliiga-maalia tällä kaudella ja taistelee putoamista vastaan. Ensimmäisessä lehdistötilaisuudessaan Sherwood painotti, että hyökkääjä Christian Benteken vireen palauttaminen ja koko joukkueen itseluottamuksen kasvattaminen ovat hänen tärkeimmät tavoitteensa. Sherwood etsii myös uutta apuvalmentajaa, koska Chris Ramsey ei liity seuraan (Ramsey on nyt QPR:n manageri) ja Swindonin Luke Williams on myös suljettu pois vaihtoehdoista. Päätös apulaisesta tehdään harkiten. Kannattajien mukaan saaminen on yksi tärkeimmistä tehtävistä. Sherwoodin mukaan Villa-fanit ovat olleet pettyneitä, mutta hän aikoo tuoda takaisin energisen, viihdyttävän jalkapallon. Villa on tällä hetkellä 18. sijalla sarjataulukossa eikä joukkueella ole hyökkäyspään itseluottamusta, joten Sherwoodin tavoitteena on sekä henkinen kestävyys että tulokset. Hän tähtää kuuteen voittoon kauden jäljellä olevista kolmesta toista ottelusta, ja toivoo näkevänsä pelaajilta enemmän rohkeutta ja pelottomuutta. Sherwood uskoo, että Benteke voi hyvällä tuella onnistua, kuten Emmanuel Adebayor Tottenhamissa hänen aikanaan. Hän onkin kehottanut joukkuetta syöttämään enemmän palloja Bentekelle. Sherwood tunnetaan suorapuheisuudestaan: hän antaa rehellistä palautetta pelaajille, olipa kyseessä kehu tai kritiikki. Tämä avoimuuden linja oli tuttua jo hänen Tottenhamin ajaltaan. Vaikka Aston Villan amerikkalainen omistaja Randy Lerner etsii ostajaa seuralle, päivittäistä toimintaa johtaa toimitusjohtaja Tom Fox. Samaan aikaan Sherwood viimeistelee UEFA Pro -valmentajalisenssiään yhdessä useiden tunnettujen jalkapallovaikuttajien kanssa. Sherwoodin tunnusomaisesta kenttäliivistä tuli vitsi lehdistötilaisuudessa, kun klubin fanituotekauppa alensi sen hintaa – asia, johon Sherwood suhtautui huumorilla. Sherwood tiedostaa, että tehtävä on haastava, mutta hänen rehellisyytensä ja energiansa ovat jo tuoneet Villa Parkille uutta toivon kipinää loppukaudeksi.

article_content: Australians began voting Monday on a name for the country's first home-grown moon rover, with a shortlist that includes 'Mateship', 'Roo-ver', and 'Kakirra'—an Indigenous word for the moon. Australia's space industry is developing the semi-autonomous rover, intended to collect lunar soil as part of a collaboration with NASA. NASA plans to send the rover to the moon as early as 2026. According to the Australian Space Agency, NASA will attempt to extract oxygen from the soil sample collected by the rover, which is considered 'a key step towards a sustainable human presence on the moon.' Two Australian consortiums, AROSE and ELO2, are working on competing rover concepts. One will be selected to design and build the final rover. The agency encouraged thousands of people and schools to participate in a competition to name the future moon vehicle, narrowing entries down to a shortlist of four: 'Mateship', 'Roo-ver', 'Kakirra', and 'Coolamon'—the latter refers to an Aboriginal wooden dish with curved sides used for a variety of purposes. Public online voting opened Monday, and the winning name will be announced on December 6. © 2023 AFP

Loppusuoran ehdotuksia ovat 'Mateship', 'Roo-ver' ja 'Kakirra', joista viimeinen on alkuperäiskansojen sana kuulle. Australian avaruusteollisuus kehittää puoliksi autonomista kuukulkijaa, jonka tarkoituksena on kerätä kuun maaperää yhteistyössä NASAn kanssa. NASA suunnittelee lähettävänsä kulkijan kuuhun aikaisintaan vuonna 2026. Australian avaruusviraston mukaan NASA aikoo yrittää erottaa happea kulkijan keräämästä maaperänäytteestä, mikä on 'tärkeä askel kohti kestävää ihmisen läsnäoloa kuulla.' Kaksi australialaista konsortiota, AROSE ja ELO2, kehittävät kilpailevia kuukulkijakonsepteja. Toinen niistä valitaan suunnittelemaan ja toteuttamaan lopullinen kulkija. Virasto kannusti tuhansia ihmisiä ja kouluja osallistumaan kilpailuun, jossa etsittiin nimeä tulevalle kuukulkijalle. Ehdotuksista karsittiin neljä: 'Mateship', 'Roo-ver', 'Kakirra' sekä 'Coolamon', joka viittaa alkuperäiskansojen puiseen astiaan, jota käytetään esimerkiksi ruoan kuljettamiseen. Yleisön verkköäänestys käynnistyi maanantaina, ja voittajan nimi julkistetaan 6. joulukuuta. © 2023 AFP
