article_content: Spanish newspaper Marca sharply criticized the national football team after their 5-1 loss to the Netherlands, featuring a mostly black front page with the headline: ‘FIX THIS’. The article highlighted the performances of Arjen Robben and Robin van Persie, who starred as Louis van Gaal’s side scored four goals in the second half against the reigning world and European champions. Beneath a photo of a visibly distraught Iker Casillas, Marca offered some optimism: 'Chile and Australia, two games to show the talent and football that made us champions. Believe.' Marca noted that Spain conceded more goals in this single match than during their entire 2010 World Cup and Euro 2012 championship campaigns. The paper stated that Casillas had 'a night to forget' as the Netherlands 'dominated' Spain in Salvador. Other Spanish newspapers echoed the disappointment. AS reported that Van Persie and Robben 'destroyed' Spain’s defense; El Periodico’s headline read 'red with shame,' and Mundo Deportivo chose 'Friday 13' with an image of a dejected Casillas. Spain coach Vicente del Bosque admitted he felt physically sick after the defeat. He said, 'I feel sick, uncomfortable, but we need the courage not to let defeat sink us. It is not a happy moment, but I want to congratulate the Dutch team, who were superior. We were overwhelmed in the second half.' Del Bosque praised the professionalism of his players: 'Everyone is hurting, but there were no accusations, and that’s positive. There will be time to talk.' He refused to blame Casillas, despite the goalkeeper being responsible for two of the Dutch goals, saying, 'This is not the time for blame. Defeats happen because of the team's shortcomings, not because of a single player. We cannot blame anyone, least of all Iker.' Spain's next group match is against Chile on Wednesday.

Artikkelissa nostettiin esiin Arjen Robbenin ja Robin van Persien suoritukset, kun Louis van Gaalin Hollanti teki neljä maalia toisella puoliajalla hallitsevaa maailman- ja Euroopan mestaria vastaan. Surullisen Iker Casillasin kuvan alla Marca tarjosi kuitenkin hieman toivoa: 'Chile ja Australia, kaksi ottelua näyttää se taito ja jalkapallo, joka teki meistä mestareita. Uskokaa.' Marca totesi, että Espanja päästi tässä yhdessä ottelussa enemmän maaleja kuin koko vuoden 2010 MM- ja EM 2012 -mestaruusturnauksissa yhteensä. Lehden mukaan Casillasilla oli 'ilta, jonka haluaisi unohtaa', sillä Hollanti 'dominoi' peliä Salvadorissa. Muut espanjalaiset lehdet ilmaisivat myös pettymyksensä. AS raportoi, että Van Persie ja Robben 'tuhosivat' Espanjan puolustuksen; El Periodicon otsikossa luki 'punainen häpeästä' ja Mundo Deportivon kannessa oli teksti 'Perjantai 13.' sekä kuva pettyneestä Casillasista. Espanjan valmentaja Vicente del Bosque myönsi, että hän voi fyysisesti pahoin tappion jälkeen. 'Tuntuu pahalta, epämukavalta, mutta tarvitsemme rohkeutta, eikä tappion saa antaa musertaa meitä. Tämä ei ole ilon hetki, mutta haluan onnitella Hollannin joukkuetta, joka oli meitä parempi. Olimme alakynnessä toisella puoliajalla.' Del Bosque kehui pelaajien ammattimaisuutta: 'Kaikkia sattuu, mutta kukaan ei syytellyt ketään – se on hyvä tiimille. Keskustelua käydään vielä myöhemmin.' Hän kieltäytyi syyttämästä Casillasta, vaikka tämä oli osallisena kahdessa Hollannin maalissa: 'Nyt ei ole syyttelyn aika. Tappiot johtuvat joukkueen heikkouksista, eivät yhden pelaajan. Emme voi syyttää ketään, varsinkaan Ikeriä.' Espanjan seuraava lohko-ottelu on Chileä vastaan keskiviikkona.

article_content: Saido Berahino, West Bromwich Albion's striker, has faced several off-field issues this season, notably poor timekeeping and a previous arrest for suspected drink-driving. Berahino has reported late for match days on three occasions, most recently during the Boxing Day game against Manchester City, for which he was fined. Despite his four goals in the 7–0 FA Cup victory over Gateshead, Berahino chose not to celebrate. The Burundi-born forward, who received his first England squad call-up but did not play, saw contract talks postponed after his arrest last October. Under new manager Tony Pulis, West Brom intends to help Berahino rediscover his form instead of selling him, even with interest from Liverpool. Blackburn Rovers are among three Football League clubs banned from the current transfer window due to financial fair play breaches. Nevertheless, director Robert Coar continues as chairman of the FA's football regulatory authority, a situation both the FA and FL seem unconcerned about. Non-League Blyth Spartans have lodged a complaint with the FA regarding a £6,750 fee for BBC's 'Match of the Day' highlights of their third-round Cup game against Birmingham. Accommodating television cameras led to fewer available seats and standing spaces, resulting in an estimated £6,000 loss in ticket sales, with additional restrictions on club shop access. The FA stated that the fee was meant to cover incurred costs. Barrow AFC’s new kit launch was held in an unconventional venue — the top floor of London’s Gherkin skyscraper — reflecting the lofty ambitions of owner Paul Casson, a Dallas-based telecommunications millionaire. Casson, a Barrow native, celebrated with many relatives in attendance and is documenting the team's journey upward in a film. Sky Sports News has made efforts to promote women's sports, though occasionally undermined by staff social media activity. Recently, reporter Andy Burton retweeted a post featuring an image of a scantily clad woman and a comment from Dan Bilzerian, later deleting the post. Channel 4 is considering celebrity presenters, including Jeremy Kyle and Jake Humphrey, for its live Grand National horse racing coverage in April following Clare Balding's move to present the Boat Race for the BBC on the same day. Nick Luck, the usual stand-in, is experienced but viewed as lacking the broad appeal needed for this high-profile event. A Channel 4 spokesperson stated no decision had been made.

article_content: Show-jumping rabbits are defying expectations about domestic bunnies. Specially bred and trained, these athletic rabbits demonstrated their jumping skills at the Rabbit Grand National in Harrogate, North Yorkshire. Capable of leaping up to three feet over hurdles, they navigate challenging courses alongside their trainers. At this weekend’s Burgess Premier Small Animal Show, held at the Great Yorkshire Showground, champion rabbits from Sweden—selectively bred for the sport—are impressing audiences. The event first appeared in the UK in 2011 and has been gaining popularity ever since. Matthew Brash, veterinary adviser for Burgess Pet Care, explained: 'We've brought the Swedish rabbit jumping team over. They are really well-trained and clearly enjoy the jumping. This illustrates just how much rabbits can actually do.' Trainer Tina Larsson, appearing with her rabbit Tora, explained that rabbit jumping began as a pastime in Sweden in the 1970s and has flourished since. 'We have been breeding rabbits specifically for jumping for 20 years. Like jumping horses, these rabbits are chosen for their legs, intelligence, and calmness. The ones who love to jump make the best competitors.' Larsson advises beginners to start their rabbits on small jumps, emphasizing that enjoyment and patience are key. She adds, 'Just love it. If you love it, your rabbit will too. Never push them—just enjoy the process.' Competitor Karin Molin says her rabbit Micro, who has won several championships in Sweden and two gold medals in England, currently holds a personal best of an 85cm (33.5in) high jump. Molin hopes to set a new record in Harrogate.
translated_content: Kaninien estehyppy on muuttamassa mielikuvia kotikaneista. Erityisesti kasvatetut ja koulutetut urheilukanit esittelevät hyppykykyjään Rabbit Grand National -kilpailussa Harrogatessa, Pohjois-Yorkshiressa. Ne pystyvät hyppäämään jopa kolme jalkaa korkeiden esteiden yli ja kulkevat haastavia ratoja yhdessä ohjaajiensa kanssa. Tänä viikonloppuna Great Yorkshire Showgroundilla järjestettävässä Burgess Premier Small Animal Show'ssa ruotsalaiset, lajiin valikoidut mestarikanit tekevät vaikutuksen yleisöön. Tapahtuma järjestettiin ensimmäistä kertaa Iso-Britanniassa vuonna 2011, ja sen suosio on kasvanut siitä lähtien. Burgess Pet Caren eläinlääkäri Matthew Brash kertoo: 'Olemme tuoneet ruotsalaisen kanihyppytiimin tänne. Kanit on koulutettu hyvin ja ne selvästi nauttivat tästä lajista. Tämä osoittaa, mihin kanit todella pystyvät.' Koutsi Tina Larsson, joka esittelee tapahtumassa kaninsa Toran kanssa, kertoo kanihypyn alkaneen Ruotsissa 1970-luvulla ja harrastuksen kasvaneen siitä asti. 'Olemme kasvattaneet hyppykaneja 20 vuoden ajan. Valitsemme kanit pitkien jalkojen, älykkyyden ja rauhallisuuden perusteella, aivan kuten esteratsastuksessa. Parhaita ovat kanit, jotka rakastavat hyppäämistä.' Larsson neuvoo aloittelijoita harjoittelemaan matalilla esteillä ja painottaa, että ilo ja kärsivällisyys vievät pitkälle. 'Jos nautit siitä, myös kanisi nauttii. Älä koskaan pakota kania—nauti vain prosessista.' Kilpailija Karin Molinin kani Micro on voittanut useita mestaruuksia Ruotsissa ja kaksi kultamitalia Englannissa. Micro'n hyppyenätys on tällä hetkellä 85 cm, ja Molin toivoo rikkovansa sen Harrogatessa.

article_content: The summer transfer window often sees Real Madrid making major headlines, and this year is no exception. Last year, the club broke the world transfer record by signing Gareth Bale from Tottenham for £85.3 million. Twelve months later, Real Madrid is adding more global stars to its ranks. World Cup winner Toni Kroos has joined from Bayern Munich for £24 million, and the club is working to complete a £63 million deal for James Rodriguez, the breakout star of world football. As speculation mounts, Monaco's Radamel Falcao is also tipped as a potential signing once Rodriguez arrives. Carlo Ancelotti, Real Madrid's manager, finds himself with an extremely strong squad, fresh off Champions League success. The challenge now is determining the strongest possible starting XI, given the abundance of world-class talent. Even with Barcelona's formidable frontline of Lionel Messi, Neymar, and Luis Suarez, Real Madrid is seen as having the potential to claim both domestic and European glory again next season. Kroos’s acquisition is considered one of the best value-for-money signings of the summer, especially following his standout performances for Germany in Brazil. He is expected to inherit Xabi Alonso’s central midfield role, though Alonso remains an important option. Should the transfer of James Rodriguez go through, Real Madrid’s attacking lineup—with Ronaldo and Bale—would rival any in Europe. Rodriguez’s impressive displays in the number 10 role for Colombia at the World Cup have further boosted his reputation. The team’s firepower could be even greater if Falcao, his Monaco and Colombia teammate, fully recovers and joins. If Ancelotti’s first-choice lineup ever falters, he is by no means short of alternatives. Iker Casillas can replace Diego Lopez in goal; Raphael Varane provides cover in central defense; Xabi Alonso, Isco, or Sami Khedira can step into midfield; and Karim Benzema is available up front. With such depth and talent, Ancelotti is truly spoiled for choice as the new season approaches.

article_content: Most federal roads in Edo State remain in poor condition, placing a heavy burden on residents and businesses. Ethan Uzamere, Edo's Commissioner for Roads and Bridges, explained that although the state frequently undertakes temporary repairs, long-term solutions are hampered by federal jurisdiction rules. The issue was highlighted when Governor Godwin Obaseki's convoy got stranded on the Benin-Sapele Road—a symbol of the broader road crisis. The federal government has previously stopped the state from carrying out major works on these roads, insisting that only federally approved contractors can do so. Despite these restrictions, Edo State is now collaborating with the Minister of Works, David Umahi, to explore durable repairs, but disagreements over funding and supervision remain unresolved. Urban flooding and erosion, especially in places like the GRA in Benin City, are key contributors to road failure, often because of missing or inadequate drainage. Many new road projects are delayed as authorities prioritize fixing drainage and foundational issues during the ongoing rainy season. To increase road durability, the state is looking at using concrete technology for high-traffic routes. The government is also emphasizing stricter oversight of contractors to ensure compliance with state quality standards, noting that substandard work has hampered progress in the past. Urban planning is under review—new construction projects must now address potential drainage issues. The Ministry of Physical Planning plays a more active role in preventing future infrastructure mistakes and is correcting previous ones, sometimes by removing buildings that obstruct roadways or water flow. Uzamere argues that Edo does not receive a fair share of national resources relative to its contributions, especially from mining and energy. He calls for a more transparent, decentralized allocation of federal funds so the state can better provide essential infrastructure. Uzamere also highlighted the satisfaction of working with a skilled team and instituting new policies. However, he asserts that progress hinges on honest evaluation of contractors, clear financial support from the federal level, reclassification of key roads, and empowering states to make their own decisions about resource use and infrastructure investment.

article_content: Jamie Redknapp described Manchester United's defense at the end of Sunday’s derby against Manchester City as 'the worst you’ll ever see.' Speaking on Sky Sports, Redknapp noted that despite United's 1-0 loss, Louis van Gaal’s team could still take confidence from how they finished the game. However, he criticized the makeshift defense, which consisted of two midfielders and two teenagers in the back line. The United players appeared dejected after Sergio Aguero scored City's winning goal in the second half. Michael Carrick, returning from injury, had to fill in at center back after Chris Smalling received a red card. Redknapp and the Sky Sports panel were impressed by United’s effort but pointed out defensive weaknesses. ‘Look at the back four they ended up with,’ Redknapp commented. ‘Valencia, McNair, Carrick, and Shaw. That’s the back four for Manchester United. That’s the worst back four you’ll ever see!’ Paddy McNair, 19, replaced the injured Marcos Rojo, who dislocated his shoulder, and struggled as Sergio Aguero found space for City's decisive goal. With Rojo expected to be out for some time, United faces a shortage of fit central defenders, likely keeping McNair in the starting lineup. Meanwhile, Manchester City will take confidence from the win after a run in which they drew with CSKA Moscow and lost to both West Ham and Newcastle. Sky Sports’ Graeme Souness emphasized the importance of the result for City's title defense but questioned the mentality of their star players during recent matches. ‘Forget the derby—that was a significant game in terms of their league ambitions,’ Souness said. ‘That win will give them much-needed confidence.’ Luke Shaw showed frustration as United suffered a derby defeat. ‘Losing is part of football, but you should bounce back immediately,’ Souness continued, referencing City’s recent disappointing results. ‘Big players should react better. City must regain their confidence and start controlling games again.’ Antonio Valencia struggled to cope with City's attacking threat while playing as an improvised right back.

article_content: On Wednesday in Jakarta, more than 200 conservative Muslim protesters assembled to demand the cancellation of the upcoming Coldplay concert, objecting to the band's public support for LGBTQ+ rights. Marching roughly one kilometer from the concert venue, they held banners denouncing Coldplay as supporters of LGBTQ+ values and argued the group undermines religious faith and morals. This group recently organized similar protests at the British Embassy and other locations in the capital. Indonesia is a secular nation with a tradition of religious tolerance, yet there has been growing visibility of conservative religious voices in recent times. Coldplay is widely recognized for engaging with social and environmental issues, including support for LGBTQ+ rights, and often uses rainbow symbols and pride flags during performances. The Jakarta protest is part of a broader trend of demonstrations against music events in Southeast Asia over LGBTQ+-related topics. Previous incidents include British band The 1975 canceling concerts in Jakarta and Taipei after controversy in Malaysia regarding their support for LGBTQ+ rights, and Lady Gaga canceling a sold-out show in Jakarta in 2012 following threats from religious groups. Coldplay’s concert at Gelora Bung Karno stadium was the kickoff for their Asian tour leg in Jakarta. Fans demonstrated strong interest, buying over 70,000 tickets within two hours after sales opened, and Jakarta is one of the band's leading global streaming centers, with about 1.6 million local fans. — Reporting by Niniek Karmini, Associated Press, Jakarta.

Mielenosoittajat marssivat noin kilometrin päässä konserttipaikasta kantaen banderolleja, joissa syytettiin Coldplayta LGBTQ+-arvojen edistäjänä ja uskonnollisen uskon sekä moraalin rapauttamisesta. Sama ryhmä on äskettäin järjestänyt samankaltaisia protesteja Britannian suurlähetystöllä ja muissa kaupungin kohteissa. Indonesia on maallistunut maa pitkällä uskonnollisen suvaitsevaisuuden perinteellä, mutta konservatiivisten uskonnollisten äänien näkyvyys on viime vuosina kasvanut. Coldplay tunnetaan sosiaalisten ja ympäristöllisten asioiden, kuten LGBTQ+-oikeuksien puolustajana, ja käyttää usein sateenkaarisymboleja ja pride-lippuja esiintymisissään. Jakartan protesti on osa laajempaa ilmiötä, jossa musiikkitapahtumiin kohdistuu mielenosoituksia Kaakkois-Aasiassa LGBTQ+:aan liittyvissä kysymyksissä. Brittiläinen The 1975 on aiemmin perunut keikkansa Jakartassa ja Taipeissa Malesiassa syntyneen kohun vuoksi yhtyeen LGBTQ+-kannanotoista, ja Lady Gaga perui loppuunmyydyn konserttinsa Jakartassa vuonna 2012 uskonnollisten ryhmien uhkausten jälkeen. Coldplayn konsertti Gelora Bung Karno -stadionilla avasi yhtyeen Aasian kiertueen Jakartassa. Fanit olivat erittäin innokkaita; yli 70 000 lippua myytiin kahdessa tunnissa, ja Jakarta on yksi Coldplayn suurimmista suoratoiston kaupungeista, noin 1,6 miljoonalla fanilla. — Raportointi: Niniek Karmini, Associated Press, Jakarta.

article_content: Trudy Glenister, 38 and pregnant with her second child, died from internal bleeding after a delayed response from trainee paramedics in Essex. Suffering from severe stomach pains and vomiting in April 2011, Glenister warned her family she feared losing her baby. Two trainee ambulance staff monitored her for 40 minutes instead of taking her immediately to Southend Hospital and did not use sirens or emergency lights during transport. An inquest found that the ambulance crew failed to recognize the emergency and missed signs of an ectopic pregnancy. Glenister went into cardiac arrest because of a ruptured fallopian tube. She lost four litres of blood and died soon after reaching the hospital. Coroner Caroline Beasley-Murray strongly criticized the East of England Ambulance Service for multiple failures—citing especially poor training on ectopic pregnancies and deploying trainees on critical emergency calls. She said the delay and lack of hospital alerting or use of emergency signals were unacceptable. On the night of the incident, about half of ambulance teams were trainees. Paramedic Mark Nelmes, trained for just a year, admitted his only knowledge of ectopic pregnancies came from two short paragraphs in his training manual. He said he followed procedure by making observations before moving Glenister, and claimed avoiding sirens was to prevent the patient’s anxiety. Glenister’s sister Paula Chapman criticized the emergency system as a 'lottery,' saying her sister’s death could have been prevented with faster care. The coroner recognized significant failings in the ambulance trust. Family, including Glenister’s widower Nigel, attended the inquest’s final day. Ectopic pregnancies occur when a fertilized egg implants outside the womb, often in a fallopian tube, and can cause severe internal bleeding if untreated. The post-mortem found Glenister experienced an acute medical emergency when her fallopian tube ruptured.

article_content:
George Lamson Jr. is the sole survivor of the 1985 Galaxy Airlines Flight 203 crash in Reno, which claimed 70 lives, including that of his father. He survived the disaster aged 17, found still strapped to his seat after being thrown into the street by the crash. Now 47, Lamson says he tries not to define himself just by having survived, but by the life he has led since, expressing gratitude for the support he’s received.

Ahead of the 30th anniversary, a new memorial plaque—replacing a stolen original—was set up near the University of Nevada, Reno. Though Lamson has lived in Reno since 1990 and visited the new memorial privately, he found attending the ceremony too emotional.

The fatal flight was a post-Super Bowl charter for Minnesota football fans, crashing minutes after takeoff from Reno-Cannon International Airport on January 21, 1985. A severe vibration led to the pilot's emergency response, later ruled a mishandling possibly caused by an open service door. The plane broke apart, and Lamson was the only passenger to survive.

Lamson recalls a typical Minnesota upbringing, with community involvement and sports, before the tragedy. Adjusting to life after the crash was especially hard, as he coped with survivor’s guilt. Over time, he married, fathered a daughter, and now works as a Reno casino dealer.

Lamson's experiences are featured in the CNN documentary 'Sole Survivor,' which explores the recoveries of people who, like him, outlasted catastrophic accidents. Lamson found the film’s release to be a powerful, affirming moment. As the community honors the memory of those who died, witnesses and responders still share their memories of that terrible night.

George Lamson Jr. on ainoa selviytyjä vuoden 1985 Galaxy Airlinesin lento 203 -onnettomuudesta Renossa, jossa menehtyi 70 ihmistä, myös hänen isänsä. Lamson oli tuolloin 17-vuotias ja löytyi vielä turvavöissä istuimessaan kadulta, johon hän sinkoutui turman seurauksena. Nyt 47-vuotiaana Lamson sanoo, ettei halua tulla määritellyksi vain selviytyjänä, vaan haluaa, että hänet muistetaan sen mukaan, miten on elänyt elämänsä—kiittäen samalla kaikesta saamastaan tuesta.

Ennen 30-vuotismuistopäivää Renon yliopiston läheisyyteen asennettiin uusi muistotaulu korvaamaan kaksi vuotta sitten varastettu alkuperäinen. Vaikka Lamson on asunut Renossa vuodesta 1990 ja käynyt muistomerkin luona yksin, hän ei kyennyt osallistumaan julkiseen uudelleen vihkimiseen, koska se olisi ollut henkisesti liian raskasta.

Kohtalokas lento oli minnesotalaisille jalkapallofaneille järjestetty charter-matka Super Bowlin jälkeen. Kone syöksyi maahan vain muutama minuutti Reno-Cannonin lentokentältä nousun jälkeen 21. tammikuuta 1985. Vakavan tärinän vuoksi lentäjä yritti hätälaskeutumista, mutta hänen toimintaansa pidettiin jälkikäteen virheellisenä—syynä saattoi olla siiven alla auki jäänyt huoltoluukku. Kone hajosi, ja Lamson jäi ainoaksi selviytyjäksi.

Lamson muistelee tavallista minnesotalaista nuoruuttaan, johon kuului esimerkiksi urheilu ja osallistuminen yhteisön toimintaan, kunnes tragedia muutti kaiken. Elämä onnettomuuden jälkeen oli vaikeaa selviytyjän syyllisyyden vuoksi. Lopulta Lamson avioitui, sai tyttären ja työskentelee nykyään kasinolla Renossa.

Lamsonin tarina on mukana CNN:n dokumentissa 'Sole Survivor', joka kertoo hänestä ja muista vastaavista selviytyjistä. Dokumentin julkaisu oli Lamsonille voimaannuttava kokemus. Reno kunnioittaa edelleen onnettomuudessa menehtyneitä, ja silminnäkijät ja pelastustyöntekijät muistavat yhä tuon yön tapahtumat.

article_content: India will officially transfer the G20 presidency to Brazil at the end of this month, bringing its tenure to a close. On Wednesday, G20 leaders will participate in a virtual summit—the final major gathering under India's leadership—to revisit the resolutions from September’s New Delhi summit and discuss new international challenges. G20 Sherpa Amitabh Kant refrained from speculating on the summit’s detailed agenda but highlighted that several additional issues have surfaced since the last meeting. The Israel-Hamas conflict, coupled with the ongoing war in Ukraine, has increased volatility for global supply chains, especially those related to energy and food security. Kant, addressing the media before the summit, reiterated that development would be the key focus while recognizing that leaders could also tackle other pressing topics and find ways to strengthen collaboration. Prime Minister Narendra Modi will host this virtual event—an uncommon back-to-back occurrence of physical and online summits, called 'exceptional' by Kant. The discussions are expected to cover the implementation of earlier commitments, efforts to address governance shortcomings, and renewed pledges to advance the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals. Greater multilateral cooperation and strengthening global institutions are likely to be central themes. In September, G20 leaders agreed to expand multilateral development banks, create global standards for cryptocurrency regulation, and improve financial inclusion using digital public infrastructure. Economic Affairs Secretary Ajay Seth noted that the upcoming virtual summit seeks to maintain momentum from September’s achievements. Foreign Secretary Vinay Kwatra anticipates strong participation from member nations, with Premier Li Qiang of China confirmed as President Xi Jinping’s representative, and possible participation from Russian President Vladimir Putin. Additionally, India’s tax authorities have identified nearly ₹10,000 crore in tax evasion by ecommerce sellers on social media over three years. In separate domestic news, Gautam Singhania, Raymond’s managing director, faces accusations of assault by his estranged wife, Nawaz Modi.

G20:n Sherpa Amitabh Kant ei halunnut arvella huippukokouksen yksityiskohtaista asialistaa, mutta korosti useiden uusien ongelmien nousseen esiin viime tapaamisen jälkeen. Israelin ja Hamasin konflikti sekä Ukrainan sota ovat lisänneet maailmanlaajuisten toimitusketjujen, erityisesti energia- ja ruokaturvan, epävarmuutta. Medialle etukäteen puhunut Kant painotti, että kehitys on edelleen ydinasia, mutta johtajat voivat käsitellä myös muita ajankohtaisia kysymyksiä ja etsiä tapoja vahvistaa yhteistyötä. Pääministeri Narendra Modi isännöi tätä virtuaalitapaamista – näin tiivis peräkkäinen fyysinen ja virtuaalinen huippukokous on Kantin mukaan harvinaista. Odotetaan, että keskusteluissa käsitellään aiempien sitoumusten toteuttamista, globaalin hallinnan aukkojen korjaamista sekä uusia lupauksia YK:n kestävän kehityksen tavoitteiden edistämiseksi. Monenkeskisen yhteistyön ja kansainvälisten instituutioiden vahvistaminen ovat keskeisiä teemoja. Syyskuussa G20-johtajat sopivat monenvälisten kehityspankkien vahvistamisesta, kryptovaluuttojen kansainvälisestä säätelystä sekä taloudellisen osallisuuden lisäämisestä digitaalisen infrastruktuurin avulla. Talousasioiden sihteeri Ajay Seth totesi, että tulevalla virtuaalikokouksella aiotaan jatkaa syyskuun saavutusten pohjalta. Ulkoministeri Vinay Kwatra uskoo jäsenmaiden vahvaan osallistumiseen – Kiinaa edustaa presidentti Xi Jinpingin sijasta pääministeri Li Qiang, ja tiedot Venäjän presidentti Vladimir Putinin osallistumisesta ovat mahdollisia. Kotimaan uutisissa Raymondin toimitusjohtajaa Gautam Singhaniaa syytetään pahoinpitelystä, kuten hänen erossa oleva vaimonsa Nawaz Modi kertoo.

article_content: Bengaluru’s Police Commissioner, B. Dayananda, reported the arrest of a computer science graduate accused of stealing a large haul of electronics: 133 laptops, 19 smartphones, and four tablets, with a total value close to Rs 75 lakh. According to investigators, the accused, formerly employed at an IT company, targeted paying guest and bachelor accommodations used by IT professionals to carry out these thefts. Two alleged accomplices who received and resold the stolen devices have also been arrested. All three are now in judicial custody and linked to at least eight cases within Bengaluru’s central division, with police widening their inquiry to other city areas to assess the full extent of the crimes. Meanwhile, the Central Crime Branch dismantled an illegal betting racket by raiding 11 locations, arresting 13 people, and seizing over Rs 10 lakh in cash. Police have opened 11 cases related to the betting operation.

article_content: Hidden cameras installed on Jim and Sue Chilton’s southern Arizona ranch have documented groups of migrants illegally crossing into the U.S. from Mexico. The Chiltons’ property spans 50,000 acres and includes 5.5 miles along the international border near Tucson. Concerned about repeated unauthorized crossings and suspected drug smuggling, the couple partnered with SecureBorderIntel.org, a border security organization, to set up surveillance along commonly used trails on their land, located about 10–15 miles from the border. Between March and June, the footage revealed multiple groups of migrants, some carrying large packs typically associated with drug transport, traversing the ranch. The Chiltons frequently discover discarded clothing, rubbish, and evidence of break-ins on their property. Jim Chilton states this evidence affirms their concern that smuggling networks are operating deep within U.S. territory. Both Jim and Sue have testified before Congress regarding the dangers faced by borderland property owners, emphasizing that rugged, remote areas often lack regular Border Patrol presence. Sue Chilton has become cautious about traveling the ranch alone amid ongoing safety worries and recalls the unresolved 2010 murder of fellow Arizona rancher Rob Krentz. The camera footage further shows individuals taking care to hide their tracks, illustrating the discrete methods used by some groups crossing their land.

Chiltonien tila kattaa 50 000 hehtaaria ja ulottuu 8,8 kilometriä pitkin kansainvälistä rajaa lähellä Tucsonia. Luvattomat rajanylitykset ja epäilyt huumekuljetuksista ovat herättäneet Chiltonien huolta, minkä vuoksi he tekivät yhteistyötä SecureBorderIntel.org-järjestön kanssa ja asensivat valvontakameroita usein käytetyille poluille noin 16 kilometrin päähän rajasta. Maaliskuusta kesäkuuhun kertyneessä kuvamateriaalissa näkyi useita siirtolaisryhmiä, joista osa kantoi suuria reppuja, joita yleensä käytetään huumeiden kuljettamiseen. Molemmat ovat todistaneet kongressille rajan läheisyydessä elävien maanomistajien vaaroista ja korostaneet, kuinka syrjäiset alueet jäävät usein vähäiselle rajavartioinnille. Sue Chilton kulkee nykyään harvoin tilalla yksin turvallisuushuolten takia ja viittaa vuoden 2010 selvittämättömään naapurirancheri Rob Krentzin murhaan. Kamerakuvissa näkyy myös, että osa siirtolaisista pyrkii peittämään jälkensä, mikä korostaa heidän varovaisia toimintatapojaan tilalla.

article_content: Oscar Garcia is expected to leave his position as Brighton manager at the end of this season. Brighton currently sit eighth in the Championship and are only five points off the play-off spots, but Garcia has become dissatisfied with the club’s transfer strategies and is said to be searching for a new opportunity. Swansea City and Norwich City are expected to be interested if Garcia becomes available. The 40-year-old Spaniard, a former Barcelona youth coach, is well-regarded for his tactical approach and for keeping Brighton competitive even after the team lost players such as Liam Bridcutt and Ashley Barnes. Swansea are considering changes to their coaching staff during the summer. Although Garry Monk continues to be involved as interim manager, alternatives like Ajax assistant coach Dennis Bergkamp and ex-Chile boss Marcelo Bielsa are also under discussion. Norwich City, after parting ways with Chris Hughton, currently have Neil Adams as caretaker and are searching for a permanent coach. Malky Mackay is among the candidates but must first resolve issues with Cardiff City owner Vincent Tan. Both Swansea and Norwich want to hire managers committed to possession-based and passing football as they aim to secure their Premier League status.

article_content: During the ongoing criminal trial of Sam Bankman-Fried, co-founder of FTX, testimony has brought to light details about the opulent lifestyle he and his colleagues led in the Bahamas. According to Adam Yedidia, a developer at FTX, Bankman-Fried and nine other employees lived together in a $35 million luxury apartment, the rent for which was covered by Alameda, the hedge fund under Bankman-Fried’s control. Prosecutors claim that Bankman-Fried funded this lavish setup—and other expenditures like speculative investments and political contributions—using money belonging to FTX customers and investors, rather than his own. Yedidia revealed he uncovered a massive $8 billion shortfall resulting from Alameda’s debt to FTX’s customers, describing the discovery as worrisome since customer funds appeared to be used for company purposes. Yedidia resigned from FTX after learning Alameda had used customer money to pay back its own loans, indicating the severity of the financial mismanagement. He also testified that Bankman-Fried had started a romantic relationship with Caroline Ellison, CEO of Alameda, who previously pleaded guilty to charges of wire and securities fraud as well as money laundering. Gary Wang, FTX’s co-founder, also testified in court, admitting he committed crimes including wire, securities, and commodities fraud, and said he did so with Bankman-Fried and others. Bankman-Fried, who has pleaded not guilty to all seven charges, faces a potential sentence of up to 110 years if convicted. His trial is expected to last up to six weeks.

Yedidia kertoi löytäneensä valtavan, 8 miljardin dollarin vajeen, joka johtui Alamedan veloista FTX:n asiakkaille, ja piti tätä erittäin huolestuttavana, koska asiakasrahoja vaikutti käytetyn yrityksen tarkoituksiin. Yedidia erosi FTX:stä kuultuaan, että Alameda oli maksanut omia lainojaan asiakasvaroilla, mikä korosti vakavaa taloudellista epäjärjestystä. Hän kertoi myös Bankman-Friedin aloittaneen romanttisen suhteen Alamedan toimitusjohtaja Caroline Ellisonin kanssa, joka on aiemmin myöntänyt syyllisyytensä petokseen ja rahanpesuun. Miley Cyrus achieved the biggest hit of her career in 2023 with her song "Flowers," which became the most-streamed song on Spotify for the year. According to Spotify, "Flowers" amassed more than 1.6 billion streams, topping the platform's annual global chart. Released in mid-January, the track benefited from early inclusion in Spotify's 2023 Wrapped stats.

"Flowers" marked a successful comeback for Miley Cyrus, whose recent projects hadn't produced major global hits in prior years. The song found lasting popularity, with listeners keeping it in heavy rotation throughout 2023.

SZA's single "Kill Bill" ranked second, elevating the R&B singer to new worldwide chart heights. Harry Styles's "As It Was" placed third; despite being released in April 2022, its popularity carried through into 2023. BTS's Jung Kook debuted at number four with his solo track "Seven," featuring Latto, marking a significant milestone in his solo career. Rounding out the top five was "Ella Baila Sola," a collaboration between Eslabon Armado and Peso Pluma, which helped both Latin artists rise to international fame.

Taylor Swift was the only artist with two songs in Spotify's global top 10 for 2023: her 2019 track "Cruel Summer," re-released as a single this year, landed at number six, while "Anti-Hero" from her album Midnights made the list as well, maintaining its popularity after its late 2022 release.

Spotify's top 10 most-streamed songs globally in 2023 were revealed as part of the company's Wrapped campaign.

article_content: Many airline passengers are frustrated when someone reclines their seat, making personal space even tighter. According to a new survey by travel site Skyscanner, more than 90% of travelers believe that reclining should either be banned or restricted during short flights. Roughly 43% support similar limits for long-haul journeys. In the poll, which included over 1,000 passengers, nearly a third reported discomfort caused by someone reclining in front of them, and 3% said they'd actually been injured. Despite this, the survey found that a large majority of people still recline their seats regardless of who is sitting behind them. Seventy percent said they wouldn't hesitate even if the passenger behind was pregnant, and 80% said the same if the person was elderly or frail. Among the respondents, women aged 18 to 24 tended to be the most considerate about reclining, while men over 35 were less likely to be concerned about others. Asking before reclining isn't common practice either; only 36% of those surveyed had ever asked for permission, and about a third worried about the reaction they'd get if they did. The issue is so disruptive that it often leads to arguments on planes. Over 60% of 900 international cabin crew surveyed said they had witnessed or been involved in disputes over reclining seats. Psychologist Dr. Becky Spelman of the Private Therapy Clinic in Harley Street explained that reclining seats can cause negative emotions like anger, stress, and frustration for passengers sitting behind. She noted that these feelings could result in problematic behaviors, such as confrontations onboard, and suggested that setting dedicated times for reclining could help create a smoother flying experience. Dr. Spelman described two types of personalities when it comes to flying: those who are considerate of others, and those who prioritize their own comfort even when it affects fellow passengers. In her view, rules that set boundaries around seat reclining could foster better social harmony, as most people are willing to accept guidelines they see as fair, leading to a more pleasant journey for everyone.

article_content: Spain midfielder Cesc Fabregas will miss the holders' Euro 2016 qualifier at home against Belarus on Saturday after suffering a hamstring injury. Fabregas, who played all 90 minutes in Chelsea's 2-1 Premier League win over Liverpool last weekend, underwent medical tests in Madrid on Tuesday. The Spanish Football Federation (RFEF) confirmed on its website that he was ruled out of the Group C match in Huelva. Fabregas has been in excellent form this season for Chelsea, contributing two goals and 11 assists in 15 appearances. His absence is a setback for Spain as they look to recover from last month's 2-1 defeat to Slovakia. Villarreal midfielder Bruno Soriano has been called up to replace Fabregas. Slovakia currently lead Group C with nine points from three matches, while Spain and Ukraine are tied on six points. Macedonia have three points, with Belarus and Luxembourg on one point each. Fabregas will also miss Spain's friendly against world champions Germany in Vigo on November 18, marking the first encounter between the two sides since Spain's 1-0 win in the 2010 World Cup semi-finals. With Andres Iniesta also out due to injury, coach Vicente del Bosque is expected to field a midfield featuring Sergio Busquets, Santi Cazorla, and Koke, along with options like Isco, Raul Garcia, Bruno Soriano, and Ignacio Camacho. Camacho is making his debut call-up, and forwards Jose Callejon, Alvaro Morata, and Nolito are also included as Del Bosque seeks to rejuvenate the team after a disappointing World Cup and the recent defeat to Slovakia. Nolito, who has impressed for Celta Vigo and developed through Barcelona's youth system, expressed hope for his senior debut. 'I think I can adapt well,' the 28-year-old said at a press conference at Spain's training base outside Madrid on Tuesday. 'Ultimately, it's about playing football, and I'll be available for the coach. I hope to participate — that's why I'm here. I can bring a lot of desire to the team.'

Fàbregas pelasi koko 90 minuuttia Chelsean 2–1 Valioliiga-voitossa Liverpoolia vastaan viime viikonloppuna, minkä jälkeen hän kävi lääkärintarkastuksissa Madridissa tiistaina. Espanjan jalkapalloliitto (RFEF) vahvisti verkkosivuillaan, että hän ei pelaa Huelvassa pelattavassa lohko C:n ottelussa. Fàbregas on ollut loistavassa vireessä Chelseassa tällä kaudella, tehden kaksi maalia ja antaen 11 maalisyöttöä 15 ottelussa. Hänen poissaolonsa on isku Espanjalle, joka yrittää toipua viime kuun 2–1-tappiosta Slovakiaa vastaan. Villarrealin keskikenttäpelaaja Bruno Soriano on kutsuttu mukaan korvaamaan Fàbregas. Slovakia johtaa tällä hetkellä lohko C:tä yhdeksällä pisteellä kolmesta ottelusta, kun taas Espanjalla ja Ukrainalla on kummallakin kuusi pistettä. Makedonialla on kolme pistettä, Valko-Venäjällä ja Luxemburgilla yksi piste. Fàbregas joutuu jättämään väliin myös Espanjan ystävyysottelun maailmanmestari Saksaa vastaan Vigossa 18. marraskuuta – tämä on ensimmäinen kohtaaminen maiden välillä sitten Espanjan 1–0-voiton vuoden 2010 MM-välierässä. Kun myös Andrés Iniesta on loukkaantuneena, päävalmentaja Vicente del Bosquen odotetaan peluuttavan keskikentällä Sergio Busquetsia, Santi Cazorlaa ja Kokea sekä vaihtoehtoina Iscoa, Raúl Garciaa, Bruno Sorianoa ja Ignacio Camachoa. Camacho on mukana maajoukkueessa ensimmäistä kertaa, ja hyökkääjät José Callejón, Álvaro Morata ja Nolito on myös valittu joukkueeseen, kun del Bosque pyrkii uudistamaan ryhmää heikon MM-suorituksen ja tuoreen tappion jälkeen. Nolito, joka on vakuuttanut Celta Vigossa ja kasvanut Barcelonan juniorijoukkueessa, ilmaisi toiveensa päästä debytoimaan maajoukkueessa. 'Luulen, että pystyn sopeutumaan hyvin', 28-vuotias kertoi lehdistötilaisuudessa Espanjan harjoituskeskuksessa Madridin ulkopuolella tiistaina. 'Loppujen lopuksi kyse on jalkapallon pelaamisesta ja olen valmentajan käytettävissä. Toivon, että saan osallistua – sitä varten olen täällä. Voin tuoda joukkueeseen paljon intoa.'

article_content: Formula One drivers will now receive double points at the final race of the 2014 season, according to new rules announced by the FIA on Monday. The winner of the Abu Dhabi Grand Prix will earn 50 points instead of the standard 25 awarded at each of the other 18 races. Former Formula One winner John Watson criticized the rule, suggesting it is simply a gimmick aimed at creating artificial excitement at the season’s end. Speaking to CNN, Watson explained, 'This mechanism is designed to prevent the championship from being decided before the final round.' He also argued that Formula One doesn't benefit when the championship is settled with races still remaining and that fans enjoyed the competitive start to the 2012 season, which saw seven different race winners. Watson added that the double points rule would mainly benefit dominant teams, like Red Bull in 2013, and questioned whether the change was a meaningful solution. Sebastian Vettel, who has claimed four world titles, reportedly told Sport Bild magazine that the rule change was 'absurd' and would 'punish those who have worked hard for a whole season.' According to the FIA, the aim of the change is to maximize attention on the championship until the last race. However, Watson believes the new rule could negatively affect how prize money is divided among teams, reinforcing the advantage of financially stronger teams. The FIA also announced other updates at the World Motor Sport Council meeting in Paris, including a plan to introduce a cost cap from January 2015, though the spending limit has not yet been specified. Starting in 2014, drivers will select a permanent race number between 2 and 99 for their career, with number 1 reserved for the reigning world champion. If more than one driver chooses the same number, preference will go to the driver who finished higher in the previous championship. Lotus driver Romain Grosjean has already asked his Twitter followers for help choosing a number. Additionally, the FIA revealed that six teams—Red Bull, Mercedes, Ferrari, McLaren, Force India, and Toro Rosso—will participate in an official three-day tire test with Pirelli in Bahrain. This test comes ahead of major technical changes to F1 regulations in 2014. The new double points rule could play a pivotal role in determining the season’s championship outcome.

Abu Dhabin Grand Prix'n voittaja ansaitsee 50 pistettä, kun taas muista 18 kilpailusta voittaja saa normaalit 25 pistettä. Entinen Formula 1 -voittaja John Watson kritisoi sääntöä pitäen sitä kikkailuna, jolla tähdätään keinotekoiseen jännitykseen kauden lopussa. Watson kertoi CNN:lle: 'Tämä järjestely pyrkii estämään mestaruuden ratkeamisen ennen viimeistä osakilpailua.' Hänen mukaansa Formula 1 ei hyödy siitä, jos mestaruus ratkeaa useita kisoja ennen loppua, ja katsojat nauttivat aiempien kausien tiukasta kilpailusta, kuten vuonna 2012, jolloin oli seitsemän eri voittajaa. Watson lisäsi, että tuplapistesääntö hyödyttää erityisesti hallitsevia tiimejä, kuten Red Bullia vuonna 2013, ja kyseenalaisti muutoksen merkityksellisyyden. Neljän maailmanmestaruuden voittanut Sebastian Vettel kommentoi Sport Bild -lehdelle, että sääntömuutos on 'absurdi' ja 'rangaistus' niille, jotka ovat tehneet kovaa työtä koko kauden. FIA:n mukaan muutoksen tavoitteena on pitää yleisön huomio mestaruustaistelussa kauden loppuun asti. Watson kuitenkin uskoo säännön voivan vaikuttaa negatiivisesti palkintorahojen jakoon, mikä suosii taloudellisesti vahvoja tiimejä. FIA julkisti myös muita päivityksiä Pariisissa pidetyssä World Motor Sport Councilin kokouksessa, kuten suunnitelman kulukaton käyttöönottamisesta tammikuussa 2015. Tarkkaa summaa ei vielä määritelty. Vuodesta 2014 lähtien kuljettajat valitsevat pysyvän kilpailunumeron väliltä 2–99 uralleen. Numero 1 on varattu hallitsevalle maailmanmestarille. Jos samaa numeroa haluaa useampi, etusija annetaan edellisessä mestaruudessa paremmin sijoittuneelle. Lotus-kuski Romain Grosjean on jo kysynyt Twitterissä seuraajiltaan apua numerovalintaan. Lisäksi FIA kertoi, että kuusi tiimiä—Red Bull, Mercedes, Ferrari, McLaren, Force India ja Toro Rosso—osallistuvat viralliseen Pirellin järjestämään kolmen päivän rengastestiin Bahrainissa. Testi on valmistautumista F1:n vuoden 2014 suuriin teknisiin sääntömuutoksiin. Uusi tuplapistesääntö voi ratkaisevasti vaikuttaa mestaruuden lopputulokseen.

Authorities have officially ended their search for a small private plane that crashed into the sea off Jamaica after an unusual and tragic journey. Both the Jamaican military and the U.S. Coast Guard concluded extensive air and sea operations after they were unable to locate New York couple Larry and Jane Glazer, both experienced pilots, who were on board.

The single-engine SOCATA TBM 700, registered to Larry Glazer and his company Buckingham Properties, departed from New York but stopped responding to air traffic controllers about an hour after takeoff. The aircraft missed its intended stop in Naples, Florida, and continued on autopilot for about 1,700 miles before running out of fuel and crashing around 14 miles from Port Antonio, Jamaica.

Investigators suspect that the Glazers likely lost consciousness due to a sudden drop in cabin pressure, which can cause hypoxia, or lack of oxygen. Fighter jets that intercepted the plane noticed frost on the windows and observed the pilot motionless inside. Some debris believed to be from the plane was photographed but could not be recovered.

Rescue teams stated the search area had been thoroughly examined multiple times and the chance of finding survivors or the wreckage was minimal. The Jamaican authorities will continue to monitor the coastline for any debris. Recovery efforts are hampered by ocean depths of around 6,500 feet, but French experts have volunteered to help if the wreck is found.

Larry Glazer was a prominent property developer in Rochester, New York, overseeing millions of square feet of real estate. Jane Glazer owned the home goods company QCI Direct. Their passing has left a deep void in their local community, with leaders and residents honoring their many contributions and legacy.

Viranomaiset ovat virallisesti lopettaneet etsinnät pienen yksityislentokoneen suhteen, joka syöksyi mereen Jamaikan edustalla poikkeuksellisen ja traagisen lennon jälkeen. Sekä Jamaikan armeija että Yhdysvaltain rannikkovartiosto lopettivat laajat ilma- ja merietsinnät, kun kokenut newyorkilainen pilottipari Larry ja Jane Glazer eivät löytyneet.

Yksimoottorinen SOCATA TBM 700 -lentokone, rekisteröity Larry Glazerin ja hänen yrityksensä Buckingham Propertiesin nimiin, lähti New Yorkista mutta lopetti yhteydenpidon lennonjohtoon noin tunti lähdön jälkeen. Kone ohitti suunnitellun määränpäänsä Naplesissa, Floridassa ja jatkoi autopilotilla noin 2 700 kilometriä, kunnes polttoaine loppui ja se syöksyi mereen noin 23 kilometriä Port Antonion, Jamaikan koillispuolelle.

Tutkijoiden arvion mukaan Glazerit menettivät tajuntansa yllättävän kabiinipaineen laskun vuoksi, mikä johti hapenpuutteeseen. Hävittäjälentäjät, jotka seurasivat konetta, huomasivat huurteen ikkunoissa ja näkivät pilotin liikkumattomana ohjaamossa. Oletettua hylytavaraa havaittiin ja valokuvattiin, mutta sitä ei pystytty nostamaan talteen.

Pelastushenkilöstö totesi etsintäalueen tulleen käytyä läpi useaan kertaan ja mahdollisuuksien löytyä eloonjääneitä tai hylkyä olevan nyt hyvin pieniä. Jamaikan viranomaiset jatkavat rannikon tarkkailua mahdollisen hylkytavaran varalta. Syvä vesi, yli kaksi kilometriä, estää suuret pelastusyritykset, mutta ranskalaiset asiantuntijat ovat tarjoutuneet avuksi, jos hylky löydetään.

Larry Glazer oli tunnettu kiinteistökehittäjä Rochesterissa New Yorkissa, hallinnoiden miljoonia neliöjalkoja liiketilaa. Jane Glazer omisti kodintuotealan yrityksen QCI Directin. Heidän poismenonsa on jättänyt suuren aukon paikallisyhteisöön, jonka jäsenet kunnioittavat yhä heidän elämäntyötään ja perintöään.

article_content: Robotic fish developed at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) may one day be used to map the ocean floor, detect pollution, or inspect submerged boats, oil rigs, and pipelines, according to researchers at the institution. Pablo Valdivia Alvarado, a mechanical engineer at MIT, has worked on creating these advanced robofish. MIT engineers are now showcasing the latest generation of robofish, 15 years after developing the first model. The new robofish is sleeker, more streamlined, and better at mimicking the movements of real fish. Pablo Valdivia Alvarado explained that these robots can explore underwater areas that traditional submersibles cannot reach. "Some of our sponsors are considering these robofish for inspection and surveillance," Alvarado noted. "Because these prototypes are inexpensive, the plan is to build hundreds—200 or even 500—and release them in bays or ports, where they would roam and gather measurements." MIT's original robotic fish project, called "Robotuna," was built in 1994. However, the current versions represent a major improvement. The new robofish, inspired by bass and trout, cost only a few hundred dollars and have just ten parts, compared to the thousands found in Robotuna. Measuring between five and eighteen inches, the new robofish are much smaller than their predecessor and are constructed from a single soft polymer. Unlike Robotuna, they can be deployed directly into the ocean. "Most of the electronics, including the 'brains' of the fish, are embedded inside," said Alvarado, who designed the robofish with fellow engineer Kamal Youcef-Toumi. "Some prototypes contain an internal battery, though for experimental simplicity, we often use tethered versions that are connected to an external power supply." These new robofish have endured challenging laboratory conditions, including two years submerged in tanks of tap water, which is typically corrosive to standard robots. Alvarado says that Robotuna inspired him to advance the technology. The research received funding from oil exploration company Schlumberger, and the U.S. Navy has also shown interest in these robots. MIT's engineers are now working on other innovations, including robotic manta rays and a land-based robot modeled after a salamander. Reporting contributed by CNN's Ninette Sosa.
translated_content: Massachusettsin teknologian instituutissa (MIT) kehitetyt robottikalat voivat tulevaisuudessa auttaa kartoittamaan merenpohjaa, havaitsemaan saasteita sekä tarkastamaan uponneita veneitä, öljynporauslauttoja ja putkia, kertovat laitoksen tutkijat. Pablo Valdivia Alvarado, MIT:n konetekniikan insinööri, on ollut mukana kehittämässä näitä edistyksellisiä robottikaloja. MIT:n insinöörit esittelevät nyt uusinta sukupolvea robottikaloja, 15 vuotta ensimmäisen mallin kehittämisestä. Uusi robottikala on virtaviivaisempi, ketterämpi ja matkii aidon kalan liikkeitä paremmin. Pablo Valdivia Alvarado kertoo, että nämä robotit voivat tutkia vedenalaisia alueita, joihin perinteiset alukset eivät pääse. "Jotkut sponsoreistamme harkitsevat robottikalojen käyttöä tarkastuksiin ja valvontaan", Alvarado sanoo. "Koska prototyypit ovat edullisia valmistaa, tavoitteena on rakentaa satoja—200 tai jopa 500—ja vapauttaa ne satamiin tai lahtiin, missä ne liikkuisivat vapaasti ja keräisivät mittaustietoja." MIT:n alkuperäinen robottikalaprojekti, nimeltään "Robotuna", rakennettiin vuonna 1994. Nykyiset versiot ovat kuitenkin merkittävä parannus. Uudet robottikalat, jotka on mallinnettu ahvenen ja taimenen mukaan, maksavat vain muutaman sadan dollarin ja niissä on kymmenen osaa tuhansien sijaan. Pituudeltaan viidestä kahdeksaantoista tuumaan oleva uusi robottikala on pienempi kuin edeltäjänsä ja tehty yhdestä pehmeästä polymeerista. Toisin kuin Robotuna, nämä voidaan vapauttaa suoraan mereen. "Suurin osa elektroniikasta, mukaan lukien kalan 'aivot', on upotettu sisälle", sanoo Alvarado, joka suunnitteli robottikalan yhdessä insinööri Kamal Youcef-Toumin kanssa. "Joissain prototyypeissä on sisäinen akku, mutta yksinkertaisuuden vuoksi käytämme usein kaapeliin liitettyjä malleja, jotka saavat virtaa ulkoisesta lähteestä." Nämä uudet robottikalat ovat kestäneet haastavia laboratoriotestejä, kuten kahden vuoden upotuksen tavalliseen vesijohtoveteen, joka yleensä on syövyttävää tavallisille roboteille. Alvarado sanoo, että Robotuna inspiroi häntä kehittämään teknologiaa eteenpäin. Öljynetsintäyhtiö Schlumberger rahoitti tutkimusta, ja myös Yhdysvaltain laivasto on osoittanut kiinnostusta robottikaloihin. MIT:n insinöörit kehittävät nyt myös robottirauskuja ja maaeläinrobottia, joka jäljittelee salamanteria. CNN:n Ninette Sosa osallistui raportointiin.

article_content: Clare Thomas has recounted her distress after her ten-day-old son, Owen, coughed up a breathing tube that hospital staff had neglected to remove. Owen, who was born at Stafford Hospital in Staffordshire, was fitted with an endotracheal tube because he wasn't breathing after suffering shoulder dystocia during delivery. Although Clare voiced concerns about her newborn’s condition, the six-inch tube was left in place until Owen, more than a week later, struggled and managed to cough it out. The incident happened in February 2007 while Clare, her husband Kev, and a friend were visiting him in the hospital’s specialist care unit. Clare saw Owen turn blue and appear to choke, prompting her to act quickly by patting his back until the tube dislodged. Nurses then administered oxygen and checked Owen’s condition. Fortunately, Owen did not experience any long-term effects, but Clare believes her prompt response was vital to his survival. Clare and Kev Thomas went on to win a clinical negligence case against the Mid-Staffordshire NHS Foundation Trust, though the amount of compensation has not been disclosed. Following the incident, Clare chose to give birth to her second child at New Cross Hospital in Wolverhampton instead of Stafford Hospital. The Thomases believe only one other similar case has been documented worldwide. A spokesperson from the NHS Trust confirmed a settlement was reached. Notably, Stafford Hospital has previously faced national criticism after a 2009 Healthcare Commission report uncovered unusually high death rates and recurring issues of patient neglect tied to cost-saving measures and meeting targets.

Owen syntyi Stafford Hospitalissa Staffordshiressä, ja hänelle asetettiin hengitysputki, koska hän ei hengittänyt olkapäädystokian jälkeen. Vaikka Clare ilmaisi huolensa vastasyntyneen kunnosta, kuuden tuuman putki jäi paikalleen, kunnes Owen yritti ja onnistui yskimään sen ulos yli viikon myöhemmin. Tapaus sattui helmikuussa 2007, kun Clare, hänen miehensä Kev ja ystävä olivat vierailulla Oweneen erikoishoidon yksikössä. Clare huomasi Owenin muuttuneen siniseksi ja tukehtuvan oloiseksi, jolloin hän toimi nopeasti ja napautti lasta selkään, kunnes putki irtosi. Sairaanhoitajat antoivat heti Owenille happea ja tarkistivat hänen tilansa. Onneksi Owen ei saanut pitkäaikaisia terveyshaittoja, mutta Clare uskoo pelastaneensa poikansa toiminnallaan. Clare ja Kev Thomas voittivat myöhemmin oikeusjutun Mid-Staffordshire NHS Foundation Trustia vastaan hoitovirheestä, mutta korvauksen määrää ei ole kerrottu julkisuuteen. Tämän tapauksen jälkeen Clare päätti synnyttää toisen lapsensa Wolverhamptonin New Cross Hospitalissa eikä enää Stafford Hospitalissa. Thomasin perhe uskoo, että vastaavia tapauksia on todettu maailmassa vain yksi muu. Sairaanhoitopiirin edustaja vahvisti, että asiasta saavutettiin sovinto. Stafford Hospital on aiemminkin ollut kansallisen kritiikin kohteena, kun Healthcare Commissionin vuonna 2009 julkaisema raportti paljasti poikkeuksellisen korkeat kuolleisuusluvut ja laiminlyönnit, jotka liittyivät kustannussäästöihin ja tavoitteisiin.

Jean-Bertrand Aristide, Haiti’s first democratically elected president, who has spent seven years in exile in South Africa, now possesses a new Haitian passport that may allow his return home. Haitian interior minister Paul-Antoine Bien-Aime announced that the document was picked up in Port-au-Prince by Aristide’s U.S. lawyer, Ira Kurzban. This step addresses one major hurdle, but Aristide still needs cooperation from South Africa and the United States to complete his journey.

Kurzban previously stated that Aristide, while wanting to come back to Haiti, does not plan to reenter politics. U.S. officials, however, have raised concerns about potential instability his return could cause. State Department spokesman P.J. Crowley remarked that Haiti must prioritize its future and stability, rather than revisit past leadership, especially during a sensitive rebuilding phase.

Though divisive, Aristide remains widely popular among many Haitians. Jacob Francois, who coordinates Aristide’s Fanmi Lavalas party in the U.S., believes crowds will turn out in celebration when Aristide returns, calling it a historic moment.

Aristide left Haiti in 2004 amidst violent unrest, claiming Western powers forced him into exile. Since then, he has repeatedly expressed a desire to come back, particularly after former dictator Jean-Claude “Baby Doc” Duvalier returned to Haiti in January. Aristide has reiterated his readiness, citing ongoing support from his followers.

His return would happen at a time when Haiti is struggling with recovery from the catastrophic 2010 earthquake, a cholera epidemic, and political disruption after disputed presidential elections. A runoff vote is set for March, with final results expected in April.

Aristide on viime aikoina korostanut olevansa valmis palaamaan ja että hänen tukijansa ovat jatkuvasti vaatineet sitä.

Paluu tapahtuisi ajankohtana, jolloin Haiti yrittää selviytyä vuoden 2010 tuhoisan maanjäristyksen seurauksista, koleraepidemiasta sekä kiistanalaisista presidentinvaaleista syntyneestä poliittisesta epävakaudesta. Presidentinvaalien toinen kierros järjestetään maaliskuussa ja lopullinen voittaja selviää huhtikuussa.

article_content: Australian voters are deciding whether to amend the nation’s constitution to establish an Indigenous advisory body, known as 'the Voice.' This body would allow Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples to provide advice to Parliament on policies affecting their communities. Recent opinion polls show declining support for the 'yes' campaign, with a majority of Australians expected to vote 'no.' Despite comprising only 3.8 percent of the population, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples continue to experience significant inequalities and the lasting impacts of colonial policies. Labor Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has advocated for the referendum and supports the 'yes' vote, while Liberal opposition leader Peter Dutton firmly opposes it. Success in Australian referendums is rare—only eight of 44 have passed—and analysts note that bipartisan support is typically necessary to achieve a majority vote. Public debate has been marked by misinformation, racism, and concerns about the lack of detail regarding the Voice’s operation. Opinions among Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander leaders are divided. On voting day in Melbourne, Al Jazeera spoke with several voters. Matthew Weegberg, an Indigenous father with Mutti Mutti, Yorta Yorta, and Boon Wurrung heritage, voted 'yes' and hopes the Voice will bring positive outcomes for Indigenous communities and a future free from racism for his children. James Henry, who has both Indigenous (Yuwaalaraay and Gamilaraay) and non-Indigenous heritage, voted 'no,' expressing doubt that the Voice is the best way to address Indigenous disadvantage. He believes campaign resources could have been better spent on existing inequalities. Christine Smith, distributing leaflets urging a 'no' vote, said the amendment would create division and argued funds should be allocated directly to grassroots services for Indigenous communities. Partners Leanna Buchanan and Dan Stubbs supported the Voice, emphasizing the importance of including Aboriginal perspectives in government decisions. They acknowledged that while the Voice alone won’t solve all issues, it represents a necessary step towards inclusion. Other Indigenous voices, such as Michael Paterson (Dja Dja Wurrung), expressed hope for greater influence and land returns through a 'yes' vote, while considering a failed vote would be a setback. Nioka Mellick-Cooper, a non-Indigenous voter, supported the Voice after listening to diverse Indigenous perspectives, emphasizing respect for the majority within those communities. Opponents like Annette Maxwell and Yvonne Gu argued that Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people are already represented in parliament, attributing ongoing inequalities to government performance rather than a lack of voice. Gu further linked the referendum to broader political agendas, expressing concerns about exclusion and elitism.
translated_content: Australialaiset äänestävät parhaillaan perustuslain muutoksesta, jolla perustettaisiin aboriginaalien ja Torres Straitin saarten asukkaiden neuvonantava elin, nimeltään 'the Voice'. Tämä elin antaisi alkuperäiskansoille mahdollisuuden neuvoa parlamenttia yhteisöjään koskevissa asioissa. Viimeisimmät mielipidemittaukset osoittavat kannatuksen laskua 'kyllä'-kampanjalle, ja enemmistön odotetaan äänestävän 'ei'. Vain 3,8 prosenttia Australian väestöstä edustavilla aboriginaaleilla ja Torres Straitin saarten asukkailla on edelleen merkittäviä eriarvoisuuksia sekä siirtomaapolitiikan pitkäaikaisia vaikutuksia. Työväenpuolueen pääministeri Anthony Albanese on ajanut kansanäänestystä ja tukee 'kyllä'-vaihtoehtoa, kun taas liberaalien oppositiojohtaja Peter Dutton vastustaa sitä jyrkästi. Australiassa kansanäänestykset menevät harvoin läpi – vain 8/44 on hyväksytty – ja asiantuntijat toteavat, että läpimenoon vaaditaan yleensä molempien pääpuolueiden tuki. Julkisessa keskustelussa on ollut väärää tietoa, rasismia sekä huolia siitä, miten The Voice todella toimisi. Myös alkuperäiskansojen johtajien näkemykset ovat jakautuneet. Al Jazeera haastatteli äänestyspäivänä useita melbournelaisia. Matthew Weegberg, aboriginaali-isä, jolla on Mutti Mutti-, Yorta Yorta- ja Boon Wurrung -tausta, äänesti 'kyllä' ja toivoo, että Voice tuo myönteistä kehitystä alkuperäiskansojen yhteisöihin ja lapsilleen rasismista vapaan tulevaisuuden. James Henry, jolla on Yuwaalaraay- ja Gamilaraay-tausta sekä ei-alkuperäiskansojen juuria, äänesti 'ei', koska ei usko Voinen olevan paras keino ratkaista alkuperäisväestön epäoikeudenmukaisuutta. Hän uskoo, että kampanjan varat olisi voitu käyttää paremmin nykyisten eriarvoisuuksien ratkaisemiseen. Christine Smith jakoi esitteitä 'ei'-puolelle ja totesi, että muutos aiheuttaisi jakautumista ja varat pitäisi ohjata suoraan ruohonjuuritason palveluihin alkuperäiskansojen hyväksi. Pariskunta Leanna Buchanan ja Dan Stubbs kannattavat Voicea ja korostavat alkuperäisväestön näkökulmien huomioimista päätöksenteossa. He tunnustavat, ettei Voice yksin ratkaise kaikkia ongelmia, mutta se on tarpeellinen askel kohti osallisuutta. Muita alkuperäiskansojen ääniä, kuten Michael Paterson (Dja Dja Wurrung), toivovat suurempaa vaikutusmahdollisuutta ja maanhallinnan palautumista 'kyllä'-äänestyksellä sekä pitävät epäonnistumista askeleena taaksepäin. Ei-alkuperäisväestöön kuuluva Nioka Mellick-Cooper äänesti 'kyllä' kuunneltuaan erilaisia näkemyksiä ja haluaa tukea yhteisön enemmistöä. Vastustajat kuten Annette Maxwell ja Yvonne Gu pitävät aboriginaalien ja Torres Straitin asukkaiden edustusta parlamentissa jo riittävänä ja uskovat, että eriarvoisuudet johtuvat hallituksen huonosta työstä, eivät puuttuvasta äänestä. Gu liitti kansanäänestyksen laajempiin poliittisiin agendoihin ja ilmaisi huolensa poissulkemisesta ja elitismistä.

article_content: Bayer Leverkusen are considering making a bid for Tottenham striker Roberto Soldado as they look to replace their unsettled Swiss forward Josip Drmic, who is drawing interest from Hamburg. Leverkusen have enquired about Soldado but are hesitant to meet Tottenham’s valuation, with chairman Daniel Levy keen to recoup much of the £26 million paid for the 29-year-old. This season, Soldado has scored only four goals in all competitions for Spurs, struggling to match the prolific form he showed in his final season at Valencia, where he netted 24 league goals. Despite missing a clear chance against Burnley and failing to find the net against Sunderland at the weekend, Tottenham fans continue to support Soldado, appreciating his workrate and link-up play, even as his goalscoring record has fallen short of expectations since his move from Valencia.
translated_content: Bayer Leverkusen harkitsee tarjouksen tekemistä Tottenhamin hyökkääjä Roberto Soldadosta etsiessään korvaajaa levottomalle sveitsiläiselle hyökkääjälleen Josip Drmicille, joka kiinnostaa Hamburgia. Leverkusen on kysellyt Soldadosta, mutta epäröi täyttää Tottenhamin hintapyyntöä, sillä puheenjohtaja Daniel Levy haluaa saada takaisin ison osan 29-vuotiaasta maksetusta 26 miljoonasta punnasta. Tällä kaudella Soldado on tehnyt vain neljä maalia kaikissa kilpailuissa Spursille, eikä ole pystynyt toistamaan samaa maalivirettä, jonka hänellä oli Valenciassa viimeisellä kaudellaan, jolloin syntyi 24 liigamaalia. article_content: Gillian Drysdale is suing her landlord for a six-figure compensation after breaking her back in a fall down stairs at her rented house. Drysdale, now walking with a stick, claims the accident was due to her landlord Joanne Hedges' negligence. The incident occurred in October 2008 during heavy rain, as Drysdale carried a 30-inch box up the steps, stepping backwards and losing her footing. Drysdale, who had only spent one night in the Harwich, Essex house before the accident, alleges that the paint on the steps made them slippery and that there was no suitable handrail. Her barrister, Niazi Fetto, argued at the High Court that smooth paint was used on steps naturally rough in texture and exposed to the elements. He described the unguarded drop of eight feet on one side of the steps as 'unreasonable' and cited a clear risk. Joanne Hedges, the landlord, whose husband Steve Hedges had painted the steps of the Victorian property, denies liability. Represented by Michael Pooles QC, Hedges' defense questioned whether Drysdale was looking where she was going, noting the wet conditions and that she was carrying a box up the steps backwards. Drysdale testified that she was trying to unload belongings quickly after moving from Scotland, with the removal driver eager to complete the journey. She was watching her feet and moving step-by-step, but did not consider the steps dangerous until she slipped and fell over the side. Fetto maintained that it was unreasonable not to have a guard or handrail by the drop, considering the steps were outdoors and susceptible to being dirty, wet, or frosty. Deputy High Court Judge John Leighton Williams QC has reserved judgment and will rule on the case at a later date.

article_content: After the sudden and chaotic ouster of OpenAI CEO Sam Altman on Friday, the company is experiencing a wave of resignations. Marc Benioff, CEO of Salesforce, publicly offered to match the full cash and equity compensation of OpenAI researchers who have resigned, inviting them to join Salesforce’s Einstein Trusted AI research team led by Silvio Savarese. Benioff posted on X that Salesforce would buy out the contracts of OpenAI researchers, including unrealized profits and sales incentives, and encouraged them to send their CVs directly to his email. He also noted that Einstein completed one trillion predictive and generative transactions this week. Reports from Business Insider indicate that OpenAI research engineers have base salaries ranging from $200,000 to $370,000, with The New York Times stating some senior researchers earn more than $800,000. Benioff did not immediately respond to Business Insider's request for comment. His offer attracted numerous humorous replies online. High-profile departures from OpenAI following Altman’s ouster include former president Greg Brockman and key staffers Jakub Pachocki, Szymon Sidor, and Aleksander Madry. Additionally, up to 95% of OpenAI employees have reportedly threatened to leave if Altman is not reinstated. Salesforce Einstein, led by chief scientist Silvio Savarese—an adjunct professor at Stanford—is the company’s generative AI platform focused on customer relationship management. The platform utilizes machine learning for marketing, automated email and chat support, and providing sales recommendations using data from Salesforce products.

Bill Gates, an advocate for the potential of generative AI, is working to ensure this technology benefits everyone—not just the privileged. On Tuesday, the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation announced a $30 million investment in a new AI platform in Africa, designed to support scientists in developing solutions for healthcare and social issues across the continent. The Foundation's goal is to make AI—which Gates has called “the most important advance in technology since the graphical user interface”—more accessible to African researchers, fostering local innovation. The initiative emphasizes the need for safe, ethical, and equitable AI development, featuring a data repository and expertise in technical development and regulatory policy.

In a March blog post, Gates highlighted the importance of ensuring that the benefits of AI extend beyond the wealthy: “Government and philanthropy will need to play a major role in ensuring that it reduces inequity and doesn’t contribute to it.” The Foundation has also pursued efforts to bring AI technology to low- and middle-income countries. In August, it committed $5 million to nearly 50 generative AI projects in countries like Pakistan and Brazil, focusing on global health and development.

Speaking at the Grand Challenges Annual Meeting in Dakar, Senegal, Gates explained that the new $30 million investment will help African innovators collaborate on key areas such as health, agriculture, financial services, and technology, enabling them to advance their work. “Part of the goal is to have these applications that reduce inequity be right on the cutting edge, not 10 or 20 years behind,” Gates said.

He also addressed current AI challenges, including accuracy, copyright issues, and the dangers of deepfakes. Looking further ahead, Gates noted that while AI's increasing capability could eventually lead to an abundance—changing the necessity of human labor—this scenario is still far off. Currently, the focus remains on addressing scarcity in areas like healthcare and education.

According to Forbes, Gates has a net worth of $109.5 billion, ranking as the world’s ninth richest person. He and Melinda French Gates founded the Gates Foundation in 2000, committing billions to vaccine research, gender equality, and scholarship programs. With assets totaling $67.3 billion as of December 2022, it is the largest private charitable foundation globally. Gates has said the Foundation will likely operate for about 25 more years.

Celebrity chef Gordon Ramsay is under investigation by HM Revenue & Customs (HMRC) for alleged serious tax fraud, following a leaked internal memo from a former senior employee. The document, authored by Trevor James, ex-finance director of Ramsay's restaurant group and a former HMRC investigator, claims that a significant unpaid tax bill—believed to be in the millions—was concealed during an earlier 2010 inquiry.

James was hired by Ramsay after previously investigating the chef on behalf of HMRC and became a director in 2007. He was dismissed earlier this year under unclear circumstances, and sources suggest his role had become untenable. Company filings show he resigned as director in May, though some documents cite his departure in September 2012.

The memo alleges that Ramsay's business deliberately reduced its tax and National Insurance liabilities by withholding information from HMRC. It further claims that funds meant for restaurant staff tips, totaling around £375,000, were improperly used and not reported to tax authorities.

HMRC first investigated Ramsay's company in 2005 over accusations concerning misuse of staff tip funds. Ramsay was cleared after paying outstanding tax. However, this new investigation centers on whether James misled officials during the 2010 probe. As a result, HMRC is reviewing thousands of company emails, with consulting firm Deloitte assisting Ramsay at significant cost.

Ramsay, who is currently filming in the US, denies any wrongdoing and emphasizes that he disclosed the memo to HMRC upon learning of it. His spokesperson insists HMRC is satisfied that Ramsay was unaware of the memo's contents, although some sources allege the opposite.

The company acknowledges some mistakes in distributing tip funds but asserts that none were diverted to Ramsay himself. The issue is said to relate to National Insurance contributions and the appropriate tax treatment of the tips. Ramsay maintains that these concerns have since been addressed.

These developments come amid ongoing financial difficulties for Ramsay's business, which reportedly faces debts of £36.6 million against cash assets of just £45,500.

West Ham United is on the verge of finalizing the acquisition of Canadian centre-back Doneil Henry, pending his work permit approval. At 21 years old and standing 6ft 2in, Henry has represented Canada's national team 14 times and has already undergone two trials with the Premier League club. Manager Sam Allardyce, reportedly pleased with Henry's ability, sees him as a talented prospect who is still developing but capable of handling the demands of English football.

The transfer hinges on meeting the UK's strict work permit requirements, which can be challenging due to Canada's standing in world football. Despite this, West Ham remains optimistic that Henry's international pedigree will meet the standards. Previously signed by Apollon Limassol in Cyprus but loaned back to Toronto FC—where he advanced through the youth ranks and played under ex-QPR defender Ryan Nelsen—Henry is set to command a transfer fee of about £1.5 million payable to Limassol, though he has yet to feature for them in a match.

With Winston Reid, the club's current defender, potentially leaving for free at the end of the season, Henry is positioned as a possible successor. Should his work permit be approved, West Ham aims to complete the signing at the start of the January transfer window, giving Henry the chance to prove he can step into Reid's shoes.
