article_content: Road and rail closures surrounding the derelict Station Hotel in Ayr are slated to continue until January, following a destructive fire in September that rendered the building unsafe. South Ayrshire Council has indicated that part or all of the historic hotel may require demolition, given the extensive damage caused by the blaze. To support local businesses and encourage visitors to return to the town centre, the council announced that parking will be free in the city centre from Sunday until 7 January. Additionally, small grant packages are being offered to the businesses most affected. Three boys, two aged 13 and one aged 17, have been charged with wilful fire-raising in connection with the September 25th incident. This was the second fire at the hotel in four months, following a previous fire in May. Attempts to contact the hotel's owner, who resides in Malaysia, have been unsuccessful. The council describes the necessary works as 'complex,' and it is still too early to determine whether demolition will be required. Critical work has already been completed to safeguard a gas main, other utilities on and around the bridge, and power lines at the station. Station Road Bridge and the roads nearby are expected to reopen on 10 January. Train services through Ayr Station remain suspended, with replacement bus services currently operating. Local business owner Alana Harte, who runs Nanny Mary’s Diner opposite the hotel, told BBC Radio Scotland that the closures are 'crippling businesses.' She highlighted the chaos caused by suspended train and bus services and called on the council for clearer communication about the future of the building. Harte expressed concern that the May fire should have prompted preventative action from the authorities, and warned that reduced customer numbers, particularly during the crucial Christmas season, could force many businesses to close. South Ayrshire Council leader Martin Dowey emphasized public safety as the main priority and explained that ongoing road closures around Ayr train station are necessary during safety works. He assured local retailers that the council is supporting them and is planning special festive activities and targeted grant support to boost footfall and aid affected businesses. Originally designed by Scottish engineer Andrew Galloway and opened in 1855, Ayr Station Hotel catered to affluent seaside visitors and later became a community landmark. Its condition deteriorated after its absentee owner failed to maintain the property or respond to enforcement. A dangerous building notice was issued in 2018, and the hotel has been wrapped in scaffolding since. While the building holds many memories for residents, it has long been considered an eyesore.

Harte esitti huolensa siitä, että jo toukokuun palo olisi pitänyt herättää viranomaiset ennakoiviin toimiin, ja varoitti, että asiakasvirran väheneminen, erityisesti tärkeällä joulukaudella, voi pakottaa monia yrityksiä sulkemaan ovensa. South Ayrshiren kunnanjohtaja Martin Dowey painotti yleisen turvallisuuden olevan etusijalla ja selitti, että keskeneräisten turvallisuustöiden vuoksi tie- ja katuosuuksien tilapäiset sulut ovat välttämättömiä. Hän vakuutti paikallisille yrittäjille, että kunta tukee heitä ja suunnittelee erityisiä joulutapahtumia ja kohdennettuja tukipaketteja alueen yrityksille. Alun perin skotlantilaisen insinöörin Andrew Gallowayn suunnittelema ja vuonna 1855 avattu Ayr Station Hotel toimi aikanaan vauraiden rantalomailijoiden majoituspaikkana ja nousi myöhemmin paikalliseksi maamerkiksi. Rakennuksen kunto heikkeni omistajan ollessa poissa maasta ja laiminlyödessä kiinteistön hoidon ja kunnan vaatimukset. Vuonna 2018 rakennukselle annettiin vaarallisen rakennuksen ilmoitus ja hotelli peitettiin sen jälkeen telineillä. Paikalliset muistavat rakennuksen hyvin monista tapahtumista, mutta ovat pitkään kokeneet sen rumaksi epäsiistiydeksi.

article_content: Showtime's 'Homeland' has developed a significant following, with fans frequently discussing the show in detail. The series averages over 2 million viewers each week, won four Emmy awards in 2012, and recently received seven Golden Globe nominations, including Best Drama, Best Actress (Claire Danes), Best Actor (Damian Lewis), and Best Supporting Actor. Alex Gansa, the creator of 'Homeland' and former co-executive producer of '24', spoke to CNN before the Season 2 finale, sharing insights about the writing process, reactions to the 'SNL' spoof, and anticipation for Season 3. Gansa described the writers' room as collaborative and focused, since there are only 12 episodes per season. This allows the team to concentrate on quality instead of quantity. Some scripts are challenging and go through multiple drafts, while others come together more smoothly. Typically, it takes about two weeks to break an episode in the story room, three weeks to write a first draft, and another month to finalize the script. When asked about rumors regarding the season finale, Gansa chose not to confirm or deny any spoilers, encouraging fans to watch the episode. He noted that many circulating spoilers are often incorrect. Reflecting on the 'Homeland' parody on 'Saturday Night Live', Gansa expressed amusement and gratitude, viewing the spoof as a sign of cultural relevance. He praised the actors' performances and noted Anne Hathaway and Claire Danes's friendship. Gansa credited the show's popularity to a mix of strong writing, acting, and directing, highlighting the chemistry between Claire Danes and Damian Lewis as especially compelling. Asked about casting, Gansa mentioned that F. Murray Abraham, currently on the show, is well suited to its world and a formidable antagonist for Mandy Patinkin’s character, Saul. While some viewers have expressed that Season 2 may not measure up to the first, Gansa disagreed, explaining that working on the show makes it difficult to be objective. He plans to assess their work after the season finishes. Looking forward, filming for Season 3 of 'Homeland' is scheduled to begin in May 2013, with the new episodes airing in late September 2013. Gansa encouraged fans to be patient during the break.

article_content: Senator Sani Musa, Chairman of the Joint Senate Committee on the 2024-2026 Medium Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF) and Fiscal Strategy Paper (FSP), has declared that no federal agency will be allowed to spend its internally generated revenue (IGR) without remitting it to the consolidated revenue fund (CRF). Musa, who also chairs the Senate Committee on Finance, directed all revenue-generating agencies to provide details of their remittances for this year to the committee. He instructed the Office of the Accountant-General of the Federation to compile a list of agencies that have yet to remit their revenue. This directive was given during a public hearing with Senate committees including Appropriations, National Planning and Economic Affairs, and Local and Foreign Debts, focusing on the 2024-2026 MTEF / FSP. According to Musa, 'The National Assembly is committed to protecting Nigeria’s economy. Nigerian National Petroleum Company Limited (NNPCL), for example, must comply with all extant laws and remit revenues as required. No government agency is exempt from remitting revenues to the CRF.' He further told the Accountant General to monitor agencies that have defaulted and collaborate with the committee secretariat for future hearings to address issues. Musa’s statements followed presentations from the Nigerian Institute of Advanced Legal Studies and the Nigerian Maritime Academy regarding delayed remittances. He insisted that all MDAs should present a year-to-date breakdown of their revenue collections and remittances, reminding them that non-compliance with financial regulations constitutes a breach of the law. Any agency found in violation is expected to face necessary action. Receipts of all remittances must be submitted to the committee. Musa also cited inconsistencies between revenue projections and remittances, referencing submissions from the Nigerian Communications Commission and the Accountant-General. He urged reconciliation between MDAs and the Accountant-General for improved accuracy in 2026-2027 MTEF/FSP projections and requests detailed data on revenues, especially from stamp duties collected by MDAs. The Accountant-General, Mrs. Oluwatoyin Madein, confirmed her office is actively engaging MDAs to reconcile their accounts and remit all funds in compliance with financial laws. Debt Management Office Director-General Mrs. Patience Oniha, in response to questions about government loans, highlighted the need for Nigeria to increase its revenue generation in view of growing debt servicing obligations. MDAs that presented their figures at the hearing included the Office of Accountant General, Nigeria Maritime Academy, Nigerian Institute of Advanced Legal Studies, National Oil Spill Detection and Response Agency, Development Bank of Nigeria, and the Debt Management Office, among others. Some organisations, such as the Nigerian Communications Commission and the Joint Matriculation and Examination Board, have been asked to return for further clarifications on their revenues and expenditures. Reviewing the last three years, Mrs. Madein detailed that in 2020, the budgeted revenue was N7.9tn with an actual gross of N8tn, and a net distribution of N7.6tn. In 2021, the budget was N9.2tn, with N9.3tn gross inflow and N7.7tn net. In 2022, the budget was N15tn with N12.2tn actual, and N8.6tn net distribution; for 2023 the revenue projection was N13.7tn, and as of October, N12.4tn had flowed in. For stamp duty, she reported that in 2020, the budget was N17.3bn but the actual was N119bn. In 2021 and 2022, the budgeted amounts were N16.8bn each year, with actuals reaching N33.94bn and N53.5bn, respectively. In 2023, the budget was N44.46bn and actual N53bn. On IGR, she noted that in 2020 it was N871.3bn projected and N532.9bn realized; in 2021, both projected and actual were N1.06tn, in 2022, N2.2tn was budgeted while N1.39tn was collected, and for 2023, N2.6tn was budgeted and N1.42tn was realized as of September. For 2024, the ministry projects a 20% increase on the 2023 budget, estimating IGR at N3.1tn. The committee emphasizes continued diligence and strict adherence to the Fiscal Responsibility Act for all federal agencies.

article_content: TOKYO: In recent years, Japan has experienced a notable increase in the prevalence of chronic rhinosinusitis (CRS). CRS is an inflammatory condition marked by nasal congestion, discharge, difficulty breathing through the nose, facial pain, and sometimes a reduced sense of smell, persisting for at least 12 weeks. The condition is challenging to treat due to its diverse symptoms. CRS can be categorized into eosinophilic (ECRS) and non-eosinophilic (non-ECRS) forms. ECRS is characterized by a higher presence of eosinophils, a type of white blood cell involved in inflammatory responses, within the nasal and sinus tissues. The increasing rates of CRS are believed to be influenced mainly by environmental factors, including lifestyle changes. Among these, the microorganisms residing in the nasal passages are thought to affect overall health significantly. However, it remains unclear whether the nasal microbiome directly contributes to the development of ECRS. To investigate this, Assistant Professor Masanori Kidoguchi from the Faculty of Medical Science at the University of Fukui and his team, including Professor Shigeharu Fujieda (University of Fukui) and Professor Emiko Noguchi (University of Tsukuba), conducted a study focusing on the nasal microbiome in a Japanese population with CRS. Their findings were published in The Journal of Allergy and Clinical Immunology on September 25, 2023. Dr. Kidoguchi stated, "We undertook this study because the pathological functions of bacteria and their metabolites in ECRS development are not fully understood." The research team collected nasal swabs from 143 participants: 65 with ECRS, 45 with non-ECRS, and 33 healthy controls. By comparing the microbiome diversity in these samples, the researchers observed significant differences between CRS patients and the control group, suggesting the nasal microbiome is associated with the disease. Crucially, microbiome composition also differed between ECRS and non-ECRS groups. Chemical and genetic analyses revealed that the bacterium Fusobacterium nucleatum was less common in ECRS patients. Additionally, metagenomic analysis showed that lipopolysaccharide (LPS) synthesis was higher in non-ECRS patients than in those with ECRS. Based on these observations, Dr. Kidoguchi hypothesized that LPS derived from F. nucleatum might play a role in both ECRS and non-ECRS. To test this, the team studied the effects of LPS from F. nucleatum on the expression of certain cytokines in human bronchial epithelial cell cultures. Experiments demonstrated that LPS from F. nucleatum specifically suppressed the expression of ALOX15, an enzyme implicated in nasal polyp formation and eosinophil-related inflammation. Collectively, the study suggests that disruptions in the nasal microbiome can play a significant role in ECRS. These insights may aid in developing strategies to better manage this condition. Dr. Kidoguchi commented, "The microbiome may strongly influence treatment resistance in CRS and could impact other allergic diseases as well. Future research may lead to probiotic therapies and lifestyle modifications to help prevent chronic sinusitis."
translated_content: TOKIO: Viime vuosina Japanissa on havaittu merkittävää kroonisen rinosinusiitin (CRS) esiintyvyyden kasvua. CRS on tulehduksellinen sairaus, johon liittyy nenän tukkoisuutta, vuotoa, hengitysvaikeuksia nenän kautta, kasvojen kipua ja joskus hajuaistin heikkenemistä, ja joka kestää vähintään 12 viikkoa. Sairauden erilaiset oireet tekevät siitä haastavan hoitaa. CRS voidaan jakaa eosinofiiliseen (ECRS) ja ei-eosinofiiliseen (non-ECRS) muotoon. ECRS:ssä nenän ja poskionteloiden kudoksissa on runsaammin eosinofiilejä, erästä valkosolutyyppiä, joka osallistuu tulehduksiin. CRS:n lisääntyminen johtuu pääasiassa ympäristötekijöistä, mukaan lukien elämäntapamuutokset. Näiden joukossa nenäontelossa elävillä mikrobeilla uskotaan olevan merkittävä vaikutus yleiseen terveyteen. On kuitenkin epäselvää, vaikuttaako nenän mikrobiomi suoraan ECRS:n kehittymiseen. Tätä selvittääkseen apulaisprofessori Masanori Kidoguchi Fukuin yliopiston lääketieteen tiedekunnasta yhdessä professori Shigeharu Fujiedan (Fukuin yliopisto) ja professori Emiko Noguchin (Tsukuban yliopisto) kanssa teki tutkimuksen japanilaisväestössä, joka kärsii CRS:stä. Tutkimustulokset julkaistiin The Journal of Allergy and Clinical Immunology -lehdessä 25. syyskuuta 2023. Dr. Kidoguchi totesi: "Teimme tämän tutkimuksen, koska bakteerien ja niiden aineenvaihduntatuotteiden patologiset toiminnot ECRS:n kehittymisessä eivät ole täysin tunnettuja." Tutkimusryhmä keräsi nenän limakalvonäytteet 143 osallistujalta: 65:llä oli ECRS, 45:llä non-ECRS ja 33 oli terveitä verrokkeja. Näiden näytteiden mikrobiomimonimuotoisuutta vertaamalla havaittiin merkittäviä eroja CRS-potilaiden ja verrokkien välillä, mikä viittaa siihen, että nenän mikrobiomilla on yhteys sairauteen. Tärkeää on, että mikrobiomin koostumus erosi myös ECRS- ja non-ECRS-ryhmien välillä. Kemialliset ja geneettiset analyysit paljastivat, että bakteeria nimeltä Fusobacterium nucleatum oli vähemmän ECRS-potilailla. Lisäksi metagenominen analyysi osoitti, että lipopolysakkaridin (LPS) synteesi oli suurempaa non-ECRS-potilailla kuin ECRS-potilailla. Näiden havaintojen perusteella Dr. Kidoguchi esitti hypoteesin, että F. nucleatumista peräisin olevalla LPS:llä voisi olla merkitystä ECRS:ssä ja non-ECRS:ssä. Tämän testaamiseksi tutkijaryhmä selvitti, miten F. nucleatumista eristetty LPS vaikuttaa tiettyjen sytokiinien ilmentymiseen ihmisen hengitysteiden epiteelisoluviljelmissä. Kokeet osoittivat, että juuri F. nucleatumista peräisin oleva LPS vaimensi ALOX15-entsyymin ilmentymistä, joka liittyy nenäpolyyppien muodostumiseen ja eosinofiiliseen tulehdukseen. Yhteenvetona tutkimuksen tulokset viittaavat siihen, että häiriöt nenän mikrobiomissa voivat olla merkittävässä roolissa ECRS:ssä. Tämä havainto voi auttaa kehittämään keinoja tämän tilan hallintaan. Dr. Kidoguchi totesi: "Mikrobiomilla voi olla vahva vaikutus CRS:n hoitoresistenssiin ja mahdollisesti muihinkin allergisiin sairauksiin. Tulevaisuuden tutkimus voi johtaa probioottihoitojen ja elämäntapamuutosten kehittämiseen kroonisen sivuontelotulehduksen ehkäisyssä."

article_content: California Governor Gavin Newsom has approved a new law that enables low-income Mexican residents living up to 45 miles (72 kilometers) from the California-Mexico border to pay in-state tuition at select community colleges in Southern California. This pilot program will begin next year and will run through 2029. The initiative is designed to increase access to higher education for those who frequently travel between Mexico and California for work or family, said Assemblymember David Alvarez, the bill’s author, who also emphasized its role in supporting a more diverse workforce. Mark Sanchez, president of Southwestern College in Chula Vista—located about 7 miles (11 kilometers) from the border—pointed out that many students already split their time between Mexico and California, and cautioned that foregoing the program could mean losing talented students. Participating community college boards are required to submit a report by 2028 detailing attendance and demographic information for students benefitting from the in-state tuition program. A comparable law enacted in 2015 allows certain Nevada residents living near the California border to attend Lake Tahoe Community College at in-state tuition rates.
translated_content: Kalifornian kuvernööri Gavin Newsom on hyväksynyt uuden lain, jonka mukaan matalatuloiset Meksikon asukkaat, jotka asuvat enintään 72 kilometrin päässä Kalifornian ja Meksikon rajasta, voivat maksaa osavaltion sisäisiä lukukausimaksuja tietyissä Etelä-Kalifornian ammattikorkeakouluissa. Tämä pilottiohjelma käynnistyy ensi vuonna ja jatkuu vuoteen 2029 asti. Ohjelman tarkoituksena on parantaa korkeakoulutuksen saavutettavuutta niille, jotka matkustavat usein Meksikon ja Kalifornian välillä työn tai perheen vuoksi, sanoo lakialoitteen tekijä David Alvarez ja korostaa samalla hankkeen merkitystä monimuotoisen työvoiman rakentamisessa. Mark Sanchez, Chula Vistan Southwestern Collegen rehtori – oppilaitos sijaitsee noin 11 kilometrin päässä rajasta – huomauttaa, että moni opiskelija jo tasapainottaa elämäänsä kummankin maan välillä. Hän varoittaa, että ilman ohjelmaa alue voi menettää osaavia nuoria. Ohjelmaan osallistuvien ammattikorkeakoulujen tulee raportoidan vuoteen 2028 mennessä, kuinka moni opiskelija hyötyi osavaltion sisäisistä lukukausimaksuista ja millainen heidän taustansa on. Samankaltainen laki hyväksyttiin vuonna 2015, jolloin tietyt Nevadan asukkaat, jotka asuvat lähellä Kalifornian rajaa, saivat oikeuden opiskella Lake Tahoe Community Collegessa osavaltion hinnoittelulla.

article_content: A recently shared YouTube video provides an eye-opening glimpse into the difficult work of sewer cleaners in Timisoara, western Romania. The footage shows a man in red overalls being carefully lowered by coworkers into a blocked sewer using ropes. He spends about thirty seconds diligently cleaning inside the confined space, after which his colleagues steadily pull him back out, feet first. Emerging safely into daylight, the worker calmly gathers himself and goes about his day, underscoring the physically demanding—and often overlooked—efforts of people in this profession.

Season 17 of Dancing With the Stars (DWTS) is about to be revealed. The official cast announcement is scheduled for Wednesday morning on Good Morning America, with the complete list to be updated on EW.com's Inside TV. However, rumors about participants are already circulating, despite ABC declining to confirm any details.

One significant rumor is that Valerie Harper, best known for Rhoda and The Mary Tyler Moore Show, may join the cast. Having been diagnosed with terminal brain cancer in January, her participation would be notable, especially as doctors have mentioned she may be approaching remission. Her presence would likely be seen as a celebration of life, given the show’s reputation for emotional moments.

Other rumored contestants include Leah Remini (The King of Queens), Elizabeth Berkley (Showgirls, Saved by the Bell), Amber Riley (Glee), NFL star Keyshawn Johnson, singer Christina Milian, Snooki, and a possible 'yogurt spokesperson'—with speculation ranging from John Stamos to Jamie Lee Curtis, known for her association with Activia commercials. The excitement primarily comes from the prospect of seeing famous personalities from different backgrounds, as well as some potential reunions on stage. While rumors generate excitement, official confirmation and the actual on-stage performances determine the appeal of the new season.

Stay tuned for the full cast announcement. For more information, check out the original story on EW.com.

article_content: Texas Rep. Randy Neugebauer has acknowledged that he was the Republican House member who shouted 'baby killer' during Sunday night’s debate on the health care reform bill. On Monday, Neugebauer issued a statement apologizing for the outburst. In his statement, he said he had exclaimed, 'It’s a baby killer,' referring to the last-minute deal between Michigan Democratic Rep. Bart Stupak and the White House. This deal secured support from Stupak and other anti-abortion Democrats for the health care bill. ‘Last night was the climax of weeks and months of debate on a health care bill that my constituents fear and do not support,’ Neugebauer wrote. ‘In the heat and emotion of the debate, I exclaimed the phrase “it’s a baby killer” in reference to the agreement reached by the Democratic leadership.’ The outburst occurred while Stupak was giving an emotional speech defending his agreement with the White House, which called for President Obama to issue an executive order maintaining existing limits on federal funding for abortion. Initially, Neugebauer’s remark was thought to have been directed personally at Stupak. ‘While I remain heartbroken over the passage of this bill and the tragic consequences I believe it will have for the unborn, I deeply regret that my actions were mistakenly interpreted as a direct reference to Congressman Stupak himself,’ Neugebauer explained. ‘I have apologized to Mr. Stupak and also apologize to my colleagues for the manner in which I expressed my disappointment about the bill. The House Chamber is a place of decorum and respect. The timing and tone of my comment last night was inappropriate.’ The incident recalled memories of Rep. Joe Wilson, a South Carolina Republican who shouted ‘you lie’ during President Obama’s health care address to a joint session of Congress in September 2009. Wilson also apologized and was formally reprimanded by the House for his outburst. CNN’s Brianna Keilar contributed to this report.

Neugebauer antoi maanantaina lausunnon, jossa hän pyysi anteeksi käytöstään. Lausunnossa hän sanoi huutaneensa 'Se on vauvan tappaja', viitaten Michiganin demokraattiedustaja Bart Stupakin ja Valkoisen talon viime hetken sopimukseen. Tämä sopimus varmisti Stupakin ja muiden abortinvastaisten demokraattien tuen terveydenhuoltolaeille. ‘Viime yö oli viikkojen ja kuukausien kiivaan keskustelun huipentuma terveydenhuoltolaista, jota äänestäjäni pelkäävät eivätkä tue’, Neugebauer kirjoitti. ‘Debatin kuumuudessa ja tunteessa huusin lauseen “se on vauvan tappaja” viitaten demokraattien johtoon ja heidän sopimukseensa.’ Välikohtaus tapahtui Stupakin pitäessä tunnepitoista puhetta, jossa hän puolusti sopimustaan Valkoisen talon kanssa. Sopimuksessa presidentti Obama lupasi toimeenpanomääräyksellä, ettei laki muuta liittovaltion tuen rajoituksia aborttiin. Aluksi Neugebauerin kommentin uskottiin kohdistuneen henkilökohtaisesti Stupakiin. ‘Vaikka olen surullinen lain läpimenosta ja sen mahdollisista traagisista seurauksista syntymättömille, kadun syvästi, että toimintani tulkittiin henkilökohtaiseksi hyökkäykseksi edustaja Stupakia kohtaan’, Neugebauer selitti. ‘Olen pyytänyt anteeksi Stupakilta sekä kollegoiltani siitä tavasta, jolla ilmaisin pettymykseni lakia kohtaan. Edustajainhuoneen salissa tulee noudattaa arvokkuutta ja käytöstapoja. Kommenttini ajoitus ja sävy olivat viime yönä sopimattomia.’ Tämä tapaus toi mieleen eteläkorealaisen republikaaniedustaja Joe Wilsonin, joka huusi ‘valehtelija’ presidentti Obaman terveydenhuoltopuheessa kongressin yhteistilaisuudessa syyskuussa 2009. Myös Wilson pyysi anteeksi ja edustajainhuone antoi hänelle virallisen huomautuksen käytöksestään. CNN:n Brianna Keilar osallistui tämän raportin laatimiseen.

article_content: A classic 1962 Ferrari 250 GTO sold for $51.7 million at a New York auction, making it the second-highest price ever achieved for a car at auction, according to RM Sotheby’s. Although predictions suggested the car could exceed $60 million, it ultimately achieved a slightly lower price, and the buyer remains anonymous. The Mercedes 300 SLR Uhlenhaut Coupe holds the world record, having fetched 135 million euros (about $144 million) in a private sale in Germany in 2022. Only two of these rare vehicles were ever produced. Noted for its strong racing pedigree, this Ferrari—with a four-liter, 390-horsepower engine—finished second in the famous 1,000-kilometer Nürburgring endurance race and also competed at the 24 Hours of Le Mans before retiring due to an engine issue. After racing in Italy and Sicily, it was sent to the United States in the late 1960s and passed through various collectors. The most recent owner, from Ohio, has possessed the car since 1985. RM Sotheby’s notes that the new owner can either participate in vintage car rallies and races or display the car at prestigious automotive events worldwide. Automotive collectibles of this caliber are regarded as robust investments largely insulated from market volatility, says Michael Caimano of RM Sotheby’s, who likens cars like this to tangible, sensory works of art. Elsewhere, Indian tax authorities are probing potential tax shortfalls by Apple, Google, and Amazon’s Indian units over transfer pricing, following a 2021 investigation. Additionally, individuals from India have become the largest investors in Dubai’s real estate sector. Digital payments firm Razorpay is also considering relocating its parent company to India from the US, a move that could incur US taxes totaling $250–300 million.

Odotuksista huolimatta huutokauppahinta jäi alle 60 miljoonan dollarin, ja ostajan henkilöllisyys pysyy salassa. Kaikkien aikojen kalleimmaksi autoksi on noussut Mercedes 300 SLR Uhlenhaut Coupe, joka myytiin Saksassa yksityiskaupassa vuonna 2022 135 miljoonalla eurolla (noin 144 miljoonaa dollaria). Italian mantereen ja Sisilian kilpaurien jälkeen auto vietiin Yhdysvaltoihin 1960-luvun lopulla, ja se on ollut useiden amerikkalaiskeräilijöiden hallussa. Viimeisin omistaja Ohiossa piti autoa vuodesta 1985 tähän viikkoon saakka. Samaan aikaan Intian veroviranomaiset tutkivat Applen, Googlen ja Amazonin intialaisten yksiköiden mahdollisia veropuutteita siirtohinnoittelun osalta aiemman vuoden 2021 tutkinnan seurauksena. article_content: NEW DELHI: A soldier was killed on Thursday in Rajouri district of Jammu and Kashmir during an ongoing anti-terrorism operation involving the Army, paramilitary forces, and J&K police. This brings the total loss for the Indian Army to five personnel in the current encounter, while two Lashkar-e-Taiba militants have reportedly been neutralized. The operation began on Wednesday after intelligence reports indicated that at least two terrorists were hiding in the dense forests. Intermittent gunfire resulted in the deaths of two Army captains and two soldiers, while at least two more personnel were injured. The Army announced via a post on the social media platform X (formerly Twitter) that some terrorists were injured and surrounded by Indian forces. The pursuit continued into the next day, leading to renewed firefights in the mountainous and forested terrain of southern Rajouri district, near the heavily fortified Line of Control separating India and Pakistan. Security forces recovered weapons and ammunition from the site. Since 2019, tensions in Kashmir have increased following the revocation of the region's semi-autonomous status, along with restrictions on dissent, civil liberties, and media freedoms amid intensified counter-insurgency efforts. The banned People's Anti-Fascist Front (PAFF), believed to be linked to Jaish-e-Mohammed and active in the mountainous forests of Rajouri and Poonch, claimed responsibility for the operation on social media. The recent encounter comes two months after a major gunfight in nearby Anantnag, which resulted in the deaths of three Indian soldiers, including a commanding officer, his deputy, and a police officer.

Tämän myötä Intian armeijan tappiot nykyisessä yhteenotossa nousivat viiteen, kun taas kaksi Lashkar-e-Taiban militanttia on ilmoitettu neutraloiduksi. Operaatio alkoi keskiviikkona tiedustelutietojen perusteella, joiden mukaan ainakin kaksi terroristia piileskeli tiheässä metsässä. Satunnaisissa tulituksissa kuoli kaksi armeijan kapteenia ja kaksi sotilasta, ja vähintään kaksi muuta haavoittui. Armeija ilmoitti sosiaalisen median alusta X:ssä (entinen Twitter), että useita terroristeja haavoittui ja heidät saarrettiin Intian joukkojen toimesta. Takaa-ajo jatkui seuraavaan päivään, mikä johti uusiin tulitaisteluihin eteläisen Rajourin vuoristoisessa ja metsäisessä maastossa, lähellä vahvasti linnoitettua valvontalinjaa Intian ja Pakistanin välillä. Turvajoukot löysivät paikalta aseita ja ammuksia. Vuodesta 2019 lähtien Kashmirissa jännitteet ovat kasvaneet, kun alueen puolittainen itsehallinto kumottiin ja vastalauseita, kansalaisoikeuksia sekä median vapautta rajoitettiin tehostettujen vastatoimien yhteydessä. Kielletty People's Anti-Fascist Front (PAFF), jonka uskotaan olevan yhteydessä Jaish-e-Mohammediin ja joka on ollut aktiivinen Rajourin ja Poonchin vuoristometsissä, ilmoitti sosiaalisessa mediassa vastuustaan operaatioon. article_content: British intelligence agents can access data collected by the NSA from Americans' telephone calls and internet communications without a warrant, according to a recently released court document. The agreement between the NSA and the UK's Government Communications Headquarters (GCHQ) allows British officials to view and store data on American citizens when obtaining a warrant is 'not technically feasible.' The accessed information, particularly in the form of 'unselected' or raw data, can be kept by GCHQ for up to two years. This period may be extended by senior UK officials if considered necessary for national security reasons. This arrangement was disclosed during a UK legal challenge to GCHQ's practices by civil liberties organizations. While it is known that the US, UK, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand regularly share intelligence, this is the first time British authorities have acknowledged that they do not always need legal authorization to access data gathered by American agencies, according to reporting by National Journal. GCHQ revealed details of its secret policies in response to the legal challenge following whistleblower Edward Snowden's revelations about the NSA. Groups like Amnesty International and British civil rights group Liberty were among the challengers. Eric King, deputy director of Privacy International, told the Guardian that data from calls, internet searches, or websites visited in the last two years could be stored and analyzed by GCHQ without a warrant. King described the arrangement as 'outrageous,' criticizing the use of secret agreements to justify widespread surveillance. Normally, UK intelligence operations are governed by the Regulation of Investigatory Powers Act (RIPA), which typically requires a warrant to intercept private data. However, the legal proceedings revealed that GCHQ does not always consider a warrant necessary when requesting unanalyzed data from foreign governments. A document made public and sent from GCHQ to the Investigatory Powers Tribunal, the UK intelligence watchdog, stated that, as a matter of law, a RIPA interception warrant is not required in all cases where unanalyzed intercepted communications are received from a foreign government. Following Edward Snowden's disclosures, GCHQ faced scrutiny over its data-sharing practices with US intelligence. British lawmakers briefed by the agency reassured the public that warrants were in place whenever GCHQ sought information from the US. A government spokesperson declined to comment on ongoing legal proceedings.
translated_content: Brittiläiset tiedusteluviranomaiset voivat päästä käsiksi NSA:n amerikkalaisten puheluista ja internetviestinnästä keräämään dataan ilman lupaa, selviää hiljattain julkaistusta oikeusasiakirjasta. NSA:n ja Iso-Britannian Government Communications Headquartersin (GCHQ) välisen sopimuksen mukaan brittiläiset viranomaiset voivat katsella ja tallentaa amerikkalaisten tietoja silloin, kun luvan hankkiminen ei ole 'teknisesti mahdollista.' Erityisesti 'valitsematon' eli raaka data voidaan GCHQ:n toimesta säilyttää jopa kaksi vuotta. Kautta voidaan pidentää brittiläisten korkeiden virkamiesten päätöksellä, mikäli kansallinen turvallisuus sitä vaatii. Järjestelystä kerrottiin Iso-Britanniassa oikeusjutun yhteydessä, jonka kansalaisoikeusjärjestöt käynnistivät GCHQ:n toimintaa vastaan. Vaikka on tiedossa, että Yhdysvallat, Iso-Britannia, Kanada, Australia ja Uusi-Seelanti jakavat säännöllisesti tiedustelutietoja, National Journalin mukaan nyt Iso-Britannian viranomaiset tunnustivat ensimmäistä kertaa, ettei heillä aina tarvitse olla laillista lupaa päästä Yhdysvaltojen keräämiin tietoihin. GCHQ paljasti salaisia käytäntöjään vastauksena oikeushaasteeseen, joka nousi ilmiantaja Edward Snowdenin NSA:sta tekemien paljastusten jälkeen. Joukossa haastajia olivat muun muassa Amnesty International ja brittiläinen kansalaisoikeusjärjestö Liberty. Privacy Internationalin varajohtaja Eric King kertoi Guardianille, että puheluista, internet-hauista tai vierailluista verkkosivuista viimeisen kahden vuoden aikana kerättyä dataa voidaan tallentaa ja analysoida GCHQ:lla ilman lupaa. Kingin mukaan järjestely on 'järkyttävä' ja hän kritisoi salaisia sopimuksia, joita käytetään laajan valvonnan oikeuttamiseen. Yleensä Britannian tiedustelutoimintaa säätelee RIPA-laki (Regulation of Investigatory Powers Act), joka normaalisti edellyttää lupaa yksityisen tiedon sieppaamiseen. Nyt oikeudenkäynti kuitenkin paljasti, ettei GCHQ aina pidä lupaa tarpeellisena pyytäessään analysoimatonta dataa ulkomaisilta viranomaisilta. GCHQ:n julkiseksi annettu ja Iso-Britannian tiedusteluntarkkailijalle, Investigatory Powers Tribunalille, lähetetty asiakirja toteaa, ettei RIPA-lain mukaista sieppauslupaa aina vaadita, kun analysoimatonta siepattua viestintää saadaan ulkomaiselta hallitukselta. Edward Snowdenin paljastusten jälkeen GCHQ:n tavat jakaa tietoa yhdysvaltalaisviranomaisten kanssa ovat olleet tarkastelun kohteena. GCHQ:n briiffaamat brittiläiset kansanedustajat vakuuttivat yleisölle, että lupa oli myönnetty kaikissa tapauksissa, joissa GCHQ haki tietoja Yhdysvalloista. Hallituksen tiedottaja kieltäytyi kommentoimasta keskeneräisiä oikeudenkäyntejä.

article_content: Two orphaned baby wombats have developed an unexpected new hobby—playing soccer—after a tragic beginning to their lives. Dudley and Moria-Joy were rescued by Judy Bailey about a year ago on the NSW South Coast after their mothers were struck and killed by cars. Judy’s niece, Kirsten Bailey, told Daily Mail Australia, 'They were both found on the side of the road in their mums' pouches after the accidents.' Playing soccer has become a regular activity for the young marsupials, helping them get the exercise they need, according to Kirsten. Dudley initially weighed just 720 grams, but now both wombats are a healthy 8 kilograms. Judy is caring for Dudley and Moria-Joy on her enclosed property until they reach 22 kilograms and are old enough to be released into the wild. In addition to soccer, they enjoy digging burrows, eating grass, and plenty of sleeping, Kirsten added. Judy has been rescuing wildlife for roughly ten years. In addition to wombats, she has cared for injured kangaroos, wallabies, birds, and possums until they are strong enough for release back into the wild. The two wombats now enjoy a safe and happy life at Judy Bailey's home. Kirsten explained that the wombats love to play and bond easily with humans. They have access to a large backyard area to explore. Judy first tossed a soccer ball to the wombats, and they have been playing with it ever since. Their playful antics were captured on video and recently shared on YouTube, with Kirsten’s husband, Luke, describing the pair as 'too cute for words.' The orphaned marsupials have formed a close bond. Kirsten says they are affectionate, love cuddles, and bond with humans easily. This can pose challenges for reintroduction to the wild if not handled carefully, but it can be managed if their release area is far from roads. Dudley and Moria-Joy will be driven to a bush location and released once they reach the appropriate size. In the wild, wombats are typically weaned after 15 months. Whether they’ll bring their soccer ball with them remains unknown. Judy volunteers with Wildlife Rescue South Coast. Donations can be made at www.wildlife-rescue.org.au/donate.
translated_content: Kaksi orvoksi jäänyttä vauvavombattia on löytänyt yllättävän uuden harrastuksen – jalkapallon pelaamisen – traagisen elämänsä alun jälkeen. Dudley ja Moria-Joy pelastettiin Judy Baileyn toimesta noin vuosi sitten Uuden Etelä-Walesin etelärannikolla, kun heidän emonsa jäivät autojen alle. Judyn siskontytär Kirsten Bailey kertoi Daily Mail Australialle: 'Molemmat löydettiin tien varrelta äitiensä pusseista onnettomuuksien jälkeen.' Jalkapallon pelaamisesta on tullut säännöllinen aktiviteetti nuorille pussieläimille ja se auttaa niitä pysymään liikkeellä, Kirstenin mukaan. Dudley painoi aluksi vain 720 grammaa, mutta nyt molemmat vombatit ovat terveitä 8-kiloisia. Judy huolehtii Dudleysta ja Moria-Joysta aidatulla tontillaan siihen asti kunnes ne painavat 22 kiloa ja ovat tarpeeksi vanhoja vapautettaviksi luontoon. Jalkapallon lisäksi ne rakastavat kaivaa käytäviä, syödä ruohoa ja nukkua paljon, Kirsten lisäsi. Judy on pelastanut villieläimiä noin kymmenen vuoden ajan. Vombattien lisäksi hän on hoitanut loukkaantuneita kenguruita, vallabeja, lintuja ja possumeita, kunnes ne ovat tarpeeksi vahvoja vapautettaviksi takaisin luontoon. Nyt nämä kaksi vombattia viettävät turvassa ja onnellisina aikaa Judy Baileyn luona. Kirstenin mukaan vombatit rakastavat leikkiä ja kiintyvät helposti ihmisiin. Niillä on käytössään suuri takapiha, jossa ne voivat tutkia ympäristöään. Judy heitti vombateille ensimmäisen kerran jalkapallon, ja siitä lähtien ne ovat leikkineet sillä. Niiden leikkihetket kuvattiin videolle ja julkaistiin hiljattain YouTubessa. Kirstenin puoliso Luke kuvaili niitä 'liian söpöiksi sanoilla kuvattaviksi.' Orvoksi jääneet pussieläimet ovat muodostaneet läheisen siteen. Kirstenin mukaan ne ovat helliä, rakastavat halailua ja kiintyvät helposti ihmisiin. Tämä voi aiheuttaa haasteita, kun ne palautetaan luontoon, jos asiaa ei huomioida, mutta riski on pienempi jos vapautusalue on kaukana teistä. Anubhav Sinha, director of the 2011 superhero film Ra.One starring Shah Rukh Khan, recently opened up about his journey with the movie. In recent years, Ra.One has gained increased appreciation for its visual effects, sparking renewed enthusiasm among fans for a sequel—although neither Sinha nor Khan have made any announcements.

During an interview with Connect FM Canada, Sinha candidly shared his regret at not making a stronger film for Shah Rukh Khan, stating, "I feel like I let him down given the opportunity I had." When asked about prospects for a sequel, Sinha labeled the idea 'presumptuous,' explaining that such major projects often come together unexpectedly. He recalled that Ra.One came to him after his biggest failure with the movie Cash, making the project with Khan all the more surprising and significant.

Sinha went on to praise Shah Rukh Khan as the most hard-working individual he knows. Both he and Khan have openly discussed Ra.One's commercial disappointment. Sinha admitted he was initially heartbroken by Khan's acknowledgment of the film’s struggles but later gained an understanding of those emotions. Despite its rocky start, Sinha pointed out that lasting online praise and fans calling Ra.One ahead of its time have given the film a valued legacy—something he now sees as its true success.

Viime aikoina Ra.Onen visuaalisia tehosteita on alettu arvostaa entistä enemmän, ja innokkaat fanit haaveilevat jatko-osasta – vaikka kumpikaan Sinha tai Khan ei ole kommentoinut suunnitelmia.

Connect FM Canada -haastattelussa Sinha puhui avoimesti katumuksesta siitä, ettei onnistunut tekemään parempaa elokuvaa Shah Rukh Khanille: "Tunnen, että petin hänet, vaikka sain valtavan mahdollisuuden." Kysyttäessä jatko-osan mahdollisuudesta Sinha kuvaili ajatusta 'ylimieliseksi' ja selitti, että näin suuret elokuvat syntyvät usein yllättäen. Hän muisteli, että Ra.One tuli hänen eteensä heti elokuvansa Cash epäonnistuttua, joten yhteistyö Khanin kanssa oli hänelle suuri yllätys ja merkittävä hetki.

Sinha kiitti Shah Rukh Khania ahkerimmaksi henkilöksi, jonka tuntee. Molemmat ovat myöntäneet Ra.Onen kaupallisen epäonnistumisen. article_content: Kenyan President William Ruto has announced that his government will privatize 35 state-owned companies to boost productivity, following the passage of a revised privatization bill last month. The new law aims to streamline the process of selling state enterprises to private firms, seeking to enhance private sector participation in the economy. Speaking to African stock market officials in Nairobi, President Ruto stated, 'We have identified the first 35 companies that we are going to offer to the private sector.' He also revealed that the government is exploring privatization options for around 100 additional state-owned firms, many of which, he said, are held back by government bureaucracy and could be more efficiently run by private entities. Kenya, East Africa’s economic powerhouse, currently faces significant financial challenges, including depleted government funds, surging inflation, and a depreciating currency that has made debt repayments more costly. To address these issues, the International Monetary Fund (IMF) announced a $938 million loan agreement with Kenya this month. The country is also facing a $2 billion eurobond repayment next year. The IMF has urged the Kenyan government to implement reforms in public sector companies, particularly highlighting Kenya Power and Kenya Airways, both of which reported record losses in 2022. The World Bank stated it expects to provide Kenya—with a population of 53 million—with $12 billion in support over the next three years. According to figures from the Kenyan Treasury, the country accumulated more than 10.1 trillion shillings ($66 billion) in debt by the end of June, an amount equivalent to about two-thirds of its gross domestic product.

Puhuessaan afrikkalaisille pörssiviranomaisille Nairobissa, presidentti Ruto totesi: 'Olemme tunnistaneet ensimmäiset 35 yritystä, jotka aiomme tarjota yksityiselle sektorille.' Hän kertoi myös, että valtio selvittää yksityistämisvaihtoehtoja noin 100 muulle valtion omistamalle yritykselle, joista monet hänen mukaansa kärsivät byrokratiasta ja voisivat toimia tehokkaammin yksityisessä omistuksessa. Itä-Afrikan talousveturi Kenia kohtaa tällä hetkellä suuria taloudellisia haasteita, kuten vähentyneet valtion varat, kiihtyvän inflaation ja heikentyvän valuutan, mikä on tehnyt velanhoidosta kalliimpaa. Näiden ongelmien helpottamiseksi Kansainvälinen valuuttarahasto (IMF) on sopinut Kenian kanssa 938 miljoonan dollarin lainasta tämän kuun aikana. Maalla on myös edessään kahden miljardin dollarin eurobondin takaisinmaksu ensi vuonna. IMF on kehottanut Kenian hallitusta uudistamaan julkisia yrityksiä, erityisesti Kenya Poweria ja Kenya Airwaysia, jotka molemmat raportoivat ennätykselliset tappiot vuonna 2022. Maailmanpankki ilmoitti aikovansa tukea 53 miljoonan asukkaan Keniaa 12 miljardilla dollarilla seuraavan kolmen vuoden aikana. Kenian valtiovarainministeriön mukaan maan velka oli kesäkuun lopussa yli 10,1 biljoonaa shillinkiä (66 miljardia dollaria), mikä vastaa noin kahta kolmasosaa maan bruttokansantuotteesta.

While searching for his purpose, Jaime comes into possession of an ancient alien relic known as the Scarab. When the Scarab chooses Jaime as its symbiotic host, he gains a powerful suit of armor with extraordinary and unpredictable powers. This event transforms Jaime’s destiny as he becomes the superhero Blue Beetle. Ángel Manuel Soto (Charm City Kings, The Farm) directs from a screenplay by Gareth Dunnet-Alcocer (Miss Bala), based on DC characters. article_content: Many travelers have noticed that air travel has become increasingly uncomfortable. Restrictions on checked baggage, shrinking legroom, and additional charges for services like wifi—which incur little cost to airlines—are common strategies. Experts describe this approach as 'calculated misery', where airlines purposely reduce comfort to motivate passengers to purchase upgrades. While the industry is often criticized, frequent flyers agree that service varies among airlines. Using the annual Customer Satisfaction Index by Statista, a market research firm surveying airlines since 1995, we've compiled a ranking of the airlines with the lowest satisfaction scores.

Vaikka alaa usein kritisoidaan, kokeneet matkustajat ovat yhtä mieltä siitä, että lentoyhtiöiden palvelutaso vaihtelee. article_content: Muttiah Muralitharan made cricket history by becoming the first bowler to claim 800 wickets in Test cricket, accomplishing this with his final delivery as Sri Lanka defeated India. The off-spinner, already the world’s leading wicket-taker, sought this milestone before ending his 18-year career. With India at 314-9, it seemed Muralitharan might finish on 799 wickets, but his last ball resulted in Pragyan Ojha being caught by Mahela Jayawardene. At 38, Muralitharan was carried off the field by teammates in Galle amid a rousing ovation. India posted 338, setting Sri Lanka a modest target of 95 runs, which openers Tharanga Paranavitana and Tillakaratne Dilshan chased without loss to secure victory in the first Test. Muralitharan had initially planned to retire after the November West Indies series, but moved up his retirement with the addition of the India tour. He will remain available for the 2011 World Cup, which Sri Lanka hosts with India and Bangladesh, but is expected to retire from all forms of cricket afterwards. India, the top-ranked Test team, resumed at 181-5 as they tried to avoid defeat. Muralitharan took the wicket of Harbhajan Singh; after VVS Laxman was run out, he appeared stuck at 799 wickets until sealing his record. Mahela Jayawardene made his 77th catch off Muralitharan’s bowling. Muralitharan’s bowling action was often debated, notably in 1995 when he faced accusations of illegal bowling, but was cleared by the International Cricket Council after biomechanical testing at the University of Western Australia. Despite ongoing controversy, he amassed more wickets and now stands 92 ahead of second-placed Shane Warne, who retired in 2007.

Intia teki yhteensä 338 juoksua, jolloin Sri Lankalle jäi 95 juoksua voittoon, minkä avauslyöjät Tharanga Paranavitana ja Tillakaratne Dilshan selvittivät ilman tappioita ja veivät ensimmäisen testin voiton. Palestine's head soccer coach, Makram Daboub, is facing significant challenges preparing his team for the 2026 World Cup qualifiers amid the ongoing Israel-Hamas war. While Daboub takes some comfort knowing his players in Gaza are currently safe, he acknowledges the difficulties they face. Three players— Ibrahim Abuimeir, Khaled Al-Nabris, and Ahmed Al-Kayed—were unable to leave Gaza to join a training camp in Jordan due to the conflict, though their safety has been confirmed for now, even as many of their relatives have suffered casualties from bombings.

Two Gaza-born players based in Egypt, Mohamed Saleh and Mahmoud Wadi, are expected to join the Palestinian squad in Jordan. Daboub, who is from Tunisia, admits it is challenging for the players to focus, as many of their families remain in danger. "With the death and destruction in Gaza, the players are in a difficult psychological state," Daboub told The Associated Press.

Despite these hardships, Susan Shalabi, vice-president of the Palestine Football Association, is adamant that the matches must proceed. "This is a people that wants to be heard and seen by the rest of the world, wants to live normally like everyone else, so people care about their national team," Shalabi said. "It represents the yearning to be recognized as a free and sovereign nation."

The Palestine Football Association, a FIFA member since 1998, has achieved some success regionally but has never qualified for a World Cup. Hopes are higher this time as the number of Asian qualification spots has doubled from four to eight, with the 2026 tournament set to be co-hosted by the United States, Mexico, and Canada. Palestine, which reached its highest FIFA ranking of 73 in 2018 and is currently ranked 96, competed in the Asian Cup in 2015 and 2019 and has qualified for the upcoming 2023 tournament in Qatar.

"There is no match that you can win in advance," Daboub said. "But we have a good chance of reaching the next round of the World Cup qualifiers."

To advance to the next stage, the team must finish in the top two of its group, which includes Australia, Lebanon, and Bangladesh. While Australia is expected to top the group, Palestine is currently ranked higher than both Lebanon and Bangladesh. Security concerns have resulted in venue changes, with their match against Australia relocated to Kuwait and an upcoming game against Lebanon moved from Beirut to the United Arab Emirates. Training has also been disrupted, as some players were unable to participate in a recent tournament in Malaysia. The team is currently based in Jordan to ensure their ability to travel for fixtures.

A win against Lebanon in the UAE next week would be a major step toward advancing. "We will do our best," Daboub added. "Football is the most popular game in the world. It brings people together. We aspire to achieve good results and qualify to show the Palestinian identity and that this is a people who deserve life and love peace."

Palestiinan jalkapallomaajoukkueen päävalmentaja Makram Daboub kohtaa merkittäviä haasteita valmistellessaan joukkuetta vuoden 2026 MM-karsintoihin Israelin ja Hamasin välisen sodan keskellä. Daboub saa lohtua siitä, että Gazassa olevat pelaajat ovat tällä hetkellä turvassa, mutta tunnustaa vaikeudet, joita he kohtaavat. Kolme pelaajaa – Ibrahim Abuimeir, Khaled Al-Nabris ja Ahmed Al-Kayed – eivät päässeet lähtemään Gazasta liittyäkseen harjoitusleirille Jordaniaan konfliktin vuoksi. He ovat kuitenkin ainakin toistaiseksi turvassa, vaikka monet heidän sukulaisistaan ovat menettäneet henkensä pommituksissa.

Kaksi Egyptissä asuvaa Gaza-syntyistä pelaajaa, Mohamed Saleh ja Mahmoud Wadi, odotetaan liittyvän Palestiinan joukkueeseen Jordaniassa. Tunisialainen Daboub myöntää pelaajien olevan vaikeassa psykologisessa tilassa, sillä monien heidän perheensä ovat edelleen vaarassa. "Gazassa tapahtuvien kuolemien ja tuhojen vuoksi pelaajat ovat vaikeassa henkisessä tilanteessa", Daboub kertoi Associated Pressille.

Vaikeuksista huolimatta Palestiinan jalkapalloliiton varapuheenjohtaja Susan Shalabi on sitä mieltä, että otteluiden on käytävä suunnitellusti. "Kyseessä on kansa, joka haluaa tulla kuulluksi ja nähdyksi muualla maailmassa, haluaa elää normaalia elämää kuten kaikki muutkin, joten ihmisille kansallisella joukkueella on merkitystä", Shalabi sanoi. "Se edustaa kaipuuta tulla tunnustetuksi vapaana ja itsenäisenä valtiona."

Palestiinan jalkapalloliitto on ollut FIFA:n jäsen vuodesta 1998 ja saavuttanut alueellista menestystä, mutta ei ole koskaan päässyt MM-kilpailuihin. Tällä kertaa toiveet ovat korkeammalla, sillä Aasian karsintapaikkojen määrä tuplaantui neljästä kahdeksaan. Vuoden 2026 turnauksen isäntinä toimivat Yhdysvallat, Meksiko ja Kanada. Palestiina saavutti korkeimman FIFA-rankinginsa 73 vuonna 2018 ja on tällä hetkellä sijalla 96. Joukkue osallistui Aasian Cupiin vuosina 2015 ja 2019 ja on mukana myös tulevassa vuoden 2023 turnauksessa Qatarissa.

"Yhtään ottelua ei voi voittaa ennakkoon", Daboub sanoi. "Mutta meillä on hyvät mahdollisuudet päästä seuraavalle karsintakierrokselle."

Joukkueen täytyy sijoittua lohkonsa kahden parhaan joukkoon päästäkseen seuraavaan vaiheen. Lohkoon kuuluvat Australia, Libanon ja Bangladesh. Australiaa pidetään vahvimpana ennakkosuosikkina, mutta Palestiina on parhaillaan rankingissa korkeammalla kuin Libanon ja Bangladesh. Turvallisuussyistä otteluita on siirretty; esimerkiksi Australia-ottelu pelataan nyt Kuwaitissa ja Libanonin vastainen peli Yhdistyneissä arabiemiirikunnissa. Harjoituksia on häirinnyt se, että osa pelaajista ei päässyt osallistumaan hiljattain järjestettyyn turnaukseen Malesiassa. Joukkueen tukikohta on nyt Jordaniassa, jotta matkat peleihin olisivat mahdollisia.

Haluamme saavuttaa hyviä tuloksia ja edetä osoittaaksemme palestiinalaista identiteettiä ja että tämä kansa ansaitsee elämää ja rakastaa rauhaa."

article_content: CHOMPI, priced at $599, is a compact, tape-style sampling synthesizer. While the price is high for its small size, the device stands out for its playful design. The Kickstarter campaign has ended, so interested buyers must now join a waitlist. Described as a quirky 'tape music' instrument, CHOMPI invites users into the world of sound design. With a unique sampling engine, multi-effects, and a tape-style looper, it aims to make music creation immediately engaging. CHOMPI is developed by a team with backgrounds in teaching, music, graphic design, and sound engineering. The device is designed to appeal to both experienced musicians and beginners, becoming a versatile tool for creative exploration. The synthesizer features four modes of operation, each offering different capabilities: CHOMPI Mode: This signature mode serves as a sound sketchpad. Users can capture sounds via an onboard microphone or a stereo line input, then use the sound design engine to experiment creatively. JAMMI Mode: JAMMI mode is the central hub for CHOMPI’s functions, playing a single sample across the keyboard. It supports layering and recalling presets and navigation through secondary functions and menus. CUBBI Mode: Allows access to 24 sample slots, ideal for percussion or storing loops—each sample mapped to a different key. MIDI Mode: In this mode, users can control external synth voices via MIDI. It disables the internal sampling engine and routes external audio through CHOMPI’s effects and looper for workflow flexibility.

Kickstarter-kampanja on päättynyt, joten kiinnostuneiden ostajien täytyy nyt liittyä jonotuslistalle. CHOMPI on kehitetty tiimin toimesta, jolla on taustaa opetuksessa, musiikissa, graafisessa suunnittelussa ja äänitekniikassa. Laite on suunniteltu houkuttelemaan sekä kokeneita muusikoita että aloittelijoita ja se toimii monipuolisena työkaluna luovaan työskentelyyn. Syntetisaattorissa on neljä eri toimintatilaa, joista jokainen tarjoaa erilaisia ominaisuuksia: CHOMPI-tila: Tämä tunnusomainen tila toimii ääniluonnospohjana. Käyttäjät voivat tallentaa ääniä sisäänrakennetun mikrofonin tai stereoliitännän kautta ja testata niitä äänisuunnittelumoottorilla luovasti. Ashok Shingare, the Thane collector, told the Bombay High Court that the fatal motorcycle accident on Ghodbunder Road on July 27 was not caused by potholes. Instead, possible reckless driving—by either the biker or the trailer driver—may have led to the tragedy. Shingare’s affidavit noted that a detailed inspection confirmed the road’s cement concrete surface showed no potholes or dangerous debris. However, the exact cause isn't confirmed; both drivers’ actions are being examined.

The High Court previously ordered a new, independent investigation after raising concerns about the initial inquiry. Responding to this, a team of top officials from the police, Thane Municipal Corporation, and the Public Works Department inspected the accident site on October 6. Their review of a 200-meter stretch revealed the area includes sharp, steep curves where cars often speed. The accident happened around 7 am, in rainy weather and poor light. After a loud crash, local witnesses found the victim, Devidas Chavan, lying near the trailer’s wheels. The police have since filed a case against the trailer driver.

Official reports from multiple agencies ruled out potholes as a cause of the crash. To improve road safety, new warning signs, reduced speed limits, rumblers, anti-crash barriers, and CCTV cameras have been set up at key locations.

Separately, the article mentions that Uttarakhand’s High Court received a report on serious river damage from illegal mining, signaling environmental and public safety concerns elsewhere.

Sen sijaan syynä on saattanut olla moottoripyöräilijän tai rekkakuskin varomaton ajo. Shingaren mukaan tarkassa tarkastuksessa vahvistettiin, ettei betonipinnoitetulla tiellä ollut kuoppia tai vaarallista irtotavaraa. Tarkkaa syytä ei kuitenkaan ole voitu vahvistaa, ja molempien kuljettajien toimintaa tutkitaan.

Korkein oikeus määräsi aiemmin uuden, riippumattoman tutkinnan huolten vuoksi alkuperäisestä selvityksestä. Tämän johdosta poliisin, Thane Municipal Corporationin ja Public Works Departmentin edustajista koostuva virkamiestiimi tutki onnettomuuspaikkaa 6. lokakuuta. 200 metrin osuudella havaittiin jyrkkiä mutkia ja alamäkiä, joilla autot ajavat usein kovaa. Onnettomuus tapahtui aamulla noin klo 7, sateisessa ja pimeähkössä säässä. Paikalliset löysivät törmäyksen jälkeen uhrin, Devidas Chavanin, rekan renkaiden läheltä. Poliisi on nostanut syytteen rekan kuljettajaa vastaan.

Viranomaisraportit sulkivat pois kuopat onnettomuuden syynä. Tien turvallisuuden parantamiseksi alueelle on asennettu uusia varoituskylttejä, nopeusrajoituksia, tärinäraitoja, törmäyssuojia ja valvontakameroita.

Erillisessä uutisessa Uttarakhandin korkein oikeus sai raportin laittoman kaivostoiminnan aiheuttamista vakavista jokivahingoista, mikä nostaa esiin ympäristö- ja turvallisuushuolia muualla maassa.

Scientists have discovered that about 20% of people carry a specific genetic variation of the KLOTHO gene, called KL-VS, which is linked to longer life expectancy, larger brain regions, and better mental abilities. This gene variant boosts the production of klotho protein in the kidney and brain. People with a single KL-VS copy generally have higher protein levels, especially benefiting the right dorsolateral prefrontal cortex—an area of the brain important for planning and multitasking. Research led by UCSF scientists, including Dr. Dena Dubal and Dr. Jennifer Yokoyama, found that this brain region typically shrinks as people age, but those carrying the KL-VS variant tend to retain more volume and perform better on memory and mental processing tasks. About 3% of the population have two copies of this variant, which is associated with shorter lifespans and a greater risk of stroke.

Recent research published in the Annals of Clinical and Translational Neurology examined brain scans from 422 adults over 53 years old. Those carrying one KL-VS variant had larger volumes in the rDLPFC and outperformed others in cognitive tests. Previous studies support these findings, suggesting klotho protein helps support learning and memory by boosting neural connections. Animal tests also show that mice engineered to produce more klotho live longer and have enhanced memory function, especially in the hippocampus. 

This ongoing KLOTHO gene research could lead to future strategies for maintaining brain health and fighting conditions like Alzheimer's disease.

Tämä geenimuunnos lisää klotho-proteiinin tuotantoa erityisesti munuaisissa ja aivoissa. Yksi KL-VS-kopio tarkoittaa yleensä korkeampaa proteiinitasoa, mikä hyödyttää erityisesti oikeanpuoleista dorsolateraalista prefrontaalista aivokuorta – aluetta, joka osallistuu suunnitteluun ja monien tehtävien hallintaan. UCSF:n tutkijat, mukaan lukien tohtori Dena Dubal ja tohtori Jennifer Yokoyama, havaitsivat, että tämä aivoalue kutistuu iän myötä, mutta KL-VS-variantin kantajilla se säilyy suurempana ja kognitiivinen suorituskyky pysyy parempana. article_content: Salesforce CEO Marc Benioff announced on Monday that Denise Dresser will step in as the new CEO of Slack, succeeding Lidiane Jones at the end of this year. Jones will transition to CEO of Bumble, starting in January. Dresser has spent 12 years with Salesforce, most recently as president of accelerated industries. Benioff commended Dresser as a strong business leader with a focus on customer success and innovation. Jones led Slack for less than a year following the departure of its founding CEO, Stewart Butterfield, after Salesforce acquired the messaging platform in 2021. Dresser will be Slack’s third CEO in about a year. These leadership changes are part of broader executive turnover at Salesforce. Over the past year, several senior leaders have left the company, including co-CEO Bret Taylor, Tableau’s CEO Mark Nelson, chief revenue officer Gavin Patterson, and chief business officer Ebony Beckwith. Chief people officer Brent Hyder departed in August, and chief trust officer Vikram Rao left in September after 18 months in his role. After months of layoffs and cost reductions, Salesforce has started hiring again. Earlier this year, the company let go of about 10% of its workforce—nearly 8,000 employees—as part of a restructuring plan encouraged by activist investors like Elliott Management and Starboard Value. These investors have urged Salesforce to prioritize profits over growth. Benioff has announced plans to hire 3,000 new employees as Salesforce invests more heavily in generative AI, and the company has recently welcomed back several returning employees, including former Oracle executive Ariel Kelman. Since implementing layoffs, Salesforce has paid closer attention to employee productivity and performance, which rank-and-file staff say were less scrutinized in earlier years.

article_content:
Poland is set for crucial parliamentary elections on October 15, with sharp political rifts coming to the forefront. Voters will select 460 members for the Sejm following a highly polarized campaign featuring intense battles between nationalist conservatives and centrists, highlighting the country's social divisions.

Surveys show five political forces are poised to clear the thresholds to enter parliament—5% for individual parties, 8% for coalitions. The United Right (Zjednoczona Prawica, ZP), led by Law and Justice (PiS) and longtime leader Jaroslaw Kaczynski, tops polls with around 35% support. PiS draws a devoted following, especially among seniors and rural populations, with expanded state welfare benefits—measures that have grown ahead of the vote. Despite this, PiS faces criticism for eroding democratic checks and balances, reducing press freedom, and sparring with the EU—resulting in billions of euros in funding being withheld. Allegations also point to infringements on the rights of migrants, refugees, women, and LGBTQ people.

At the heart of the opposition is the Civic Coalition (KO), led by ex-Prime Minister and former European Council president Donald Tusk, currently lagging five or six points behind PiS. KO has pledged to renew EU ties, boost incomes, invest in public services, and defend minorities. Yet, both main parties are largely mobilizing their own bases, with smaller groups like Third Way (center-right), Lewica (left), and Confederation (far-right) near the 10% mark—potential kingmakers for the next government.

PiS credits itself with guiding Poland through the pandemic, the Ukraine crisis, and economic pressures, claiming to offer stability. However, opposition and outside observers accuse PiS of exploiting government resources for the campaign, pushing a migration referendum to galvanize its supporters, and adjusting voting rules and state media in its favor. These strategies have faced criticism from the EU and democracy watchdogs.

Negative campaigning remains prominent. While KO spotlights PiS scandals and emphasizes Poland's drift from its European allies, it has also echoed some anti-migrant sentiments amid recent controversies. Forecasts suggest no party will gain an outright majority, compelling coalition talks, with significant disagreements—particularly if the far-right Confederation is involved.

Should PiS prevail, analysts predict more sweeping institutional ‘reforms’ that could cement its hold on power and increase friction with Brussels. Conversely, a KO-led government would strive to restore Poland’s democratic fabric and closer EU relations, though it would meet resistance from PiS-aligned officials and President Andrzej Duda, whose term runs until 2025. Either scenario could lead to a period of political instability or even trigger new elections.

Kyselyt osoittavat viiden poliittisen tahon olevan vahvoilla ylittämään parlamenttikynnykset – puolueille 5 % ja liittoumille 8 %. Yhdistynyt oikeisto (Zjednoczona Prawica, ZP), jonka johdossa kulkee Laki ja Oikeus (PiS) puolue sekä sen vetäjä Jaroslaw Kaczynski, johtaa noin 35 % kannatuksella. PiS:llä on vahva tuki erityisesti vanhemmissa ja maaseudun äänestäjissä, laajennettujen sosiaalietuuksien myötä – etuuksia lisättiin juuri ennen vaaleja. Samalla PiS:ää moititaan demokratian heikennyksistä, median vapauden kaventamisesta ja kiistoista EU:n kanssa, minkä seurauksena miljardien eurojen tuet on jäädytetty. Lisäksi puolueella on syyttäjiä, jotka viittaavat siirtolaisten, pakolaisten, nais- ja HLBTQ-oikeuksien polkemiseen.

Vastaehdokkaana toimii Kansalaiskoalitio (KO), jota luotsaa entinen pääministeri ja Eurooppa-neuvoston johtaja Donald Tusk, joka on kannatuksessa 5–6 prosenttia PiS:n jäljessä. KO lupaa korjata EU-suhteet, nostaa tulotasoa, satsata koulutukseen sekä terveydenhuoltoon ja edistää vähemmistöjen asemaa. Pääpuolueet pyrkivät lähinnä mobilisoimaan omia tukijoitaan, ja pienemmät ryhmät kuten keskustaoikeistolainen Kolmas Tie, vasemmistolainen Lewica ja oikeistopopulistinen Konfederacja liikkuvat noin 10 %:ssa, mikä tekee niistä mahdollisia ratkaisijoita hallituksen muodostamisessa.

PiS pitää ansioinaan Puolan johdattamista pandemian, Ukrainan sodan ja talouden haasteiden läpi, tuoden esiin vakauden. Toisaalta oppositio ja tarkkailijat syyttävät sitä julkisten resurssien hyödyntämisestä vaalikampanjaan, kiistanalaisen maahanmuuttoreferendumin järjestämisestä sekä äänestysjärjestelmän ja valtion median muovaamisesta puolueen eduksi. Nämä keinot ovat herättäneet kritiikkiä EU:lta ja kansalaisjärjestöiltä.

Negatiivinen kampanjointi on ollut näkyvästi läsnä. KO esittelee PiS:n skandaaleja ja korostaa Puolan etääntymistä EU:sta, mutta on myös käyttänyt maahanmuuttovastaista retoriikkaa viime aikojen kohujen yhteydessä. Ennusteiden mukaan mikään puolue ei saa yksin enemmistöä, joten koalitioita tarvitaan, ja merkittäviä erimielisyyksiä on odotettavissa – erityisesti jos Konfederacja pääsee ratkaisevaan asemaan.

Jos PiS voittaa, asiantuntijat uskovat, että luvassa on lisää syvälle meneviä instituutioiden uudistuksia, jotka saattavat tiukentaa puolueen valtapitoa ja kiristää suhteita Brysseliin. KO:n johtama hallitus pyrkisi sen sijaan palauttamaan Puolan demokraattista järjestelmää ja parantamaan EU-suhteita, mutta sen tiellä olisivat PiS:n vaikutusalueet ja presidentti Andrzej Duda, jonka virkakausi jatkuu vuoteen 2025. Kummassakin tapauksessa edessä saattaa olla poliittista epävakautta tai jopa uudet vaalit.

article_content: A female German Shepherd became trapped in thick bushes by a canal in Darlaston, West Midlands, after attempting to swim across. The incident was first noticed by 14-year-old James Greenhouse, who saw the dog leap into the water and enlisted help from Josh, the son of Joanne Delaney. Despite their efforts, the dog remained stuck and appeared frightened. Ten firefighters and a diving team responded, spending two hours attempting to free the animal. Ultimately, they persuaded the nervous dog to come out by offering dog food and gently guiding her with a rope. Local residents have been searching for the dog's owner, but no one has yet come forward. The two-year-old German Shepherd is recovering at St George's Vets in Wolverhampton. Veterinary staff report she is healthy after her ordeal and will be available for re-homing if her owner is not found within seven days.

Yrityksistä huolimatta koira pysyi jumissa ja vaikutti peloissaan. Kymmenen palomiestä ja sukeltajaa saapuivat paikalle ja yrittivät kahden tunnin ajan erilaisia keinoja saadakseen koiran irti. Lopulta he houkuttelivat hermostuneen koiran ulos pensaikosta koiranruoalla ja ohjasivat sitä varovasti köyden avulla. Paikalliset asukkaat ovat etsineet koiran omistajaa, mutta häntä ei ole vielä löydetty. Kaksivuotias saksanpaimenkoira on nyt toipumassa St George’s Vets -eläinlääkäriasemalla Wolverhamptonissa. Eläinlääkärit kertovat, että koira on kunnossa ja hänelle etsitään uutta kotia, jos omistajaa ei löydy seitsemän päivän kuluessa.

article_content: The holiday season is here, and at Android Central, our goal is to provide content as useful as Santa’s helpers. We recognize the season can be stressful, but with a few tech tricks, you can make the holidays run smoother!  Here are five how-to guides to help you be more efficient, so you can spend less time worrying and more time enjoying family, festivities, and delicious food.  1. Take Great Group Photos Every Time On special occasions like Thanksgiving, capturing the perfect group photo can be a challenge. With Google Photos' new Best Take feature (available on Pixel 8 and Pixel 8 Pro), just take a burst of similar photos, then open Google Photos, select the Tools option, and tap Best Take. The tool will suggest the best faces in the group, so you can pick your favorite expressions and save a copy. Your originals stay safe.  2. Restore Special Moments with Audio Magic Eraser Did an unexpected sound interrupt your video—like a barking dog during Uncle James’s toast? Google Photos’ Audio Magic Eraser (for Pixel 8/8 Pro) can help. In Google Photos, select the video, tap Edit, then Audio > Audio Magic Eraser. It identifies and separates sounds. Adjust the sliders for each sound as needed, tap Done, and save a copy of the improved video.  3. Save Time by Extracting Text from Flyers and Invites If you get event invites with text images, avoid typing everything manually. Screenshot the image, then open Google Photos. Go to Library > Screenshots (or Camera), select the screenshot, and tap Copy text. The AI will highlight text for you to copy and paste—for example, into Google Maps. On Samsung devices, use the Gallery’s 'T' icon for text editing, and some phones let you copy text directly to your computer via Chrome.  4. Share Party Photos with the Whole Family Make photo sharing easy after big gatherings by setting up a Google Shared Album. In Google Photos, tap Library > New Album, name it, and tap Share. Use Create link to get a shareable link, or add contacts directly if they use Google Accounts. Anyone with the link can view and add to the album unless you change privacy settings.  5. Stay Organized with Google Assistant and Keep With so much holiday chaos, let Google Assistant help you manage lists and notes. First, open Google Keep to set it up. In Google Assistant settings, find Notes & Lists and select Google Keep. Now, you can say commands like 'Hey Google, take a note,' or 'Add potatoes to my holiday dinner list,' and everything is saved to Keep. This helps you juggle meals, gifts, and party tasks from your phone or other Google devices.  Wrapping Up These tips help with holiday organizing, but you can use them all year. Google Keep is simple but powerful—helping you add reminders, times, and even locations to your notes. Google Assistant can do even more, whether you’re using your phone, tablet, or smart display. Our culture’s fixation on celebrity body image greatly shapes how people view themselves, blending concerns about looks with genuine health issues. Kathy Ireland, once a renowned supermodel and now a businesswoman, recently explained that her main motivation to monitor weight comes from wanting to stay healthy rather than focusing on appearance. Appearing with fitness expert Bob Greene on "Larry King Live," Ireland discussed her journey after years of gradual weight gain and stressed the importance of regularly checking things like cholesterol and heart health. 

Both Ireland and Greene emphasized that weight is more of a sign that broader lifestyle adjustments might be necessary, like eating better or becoming more active. Greene pointed out that staying overweight carries the biggest health risks, though it’s best to adopt sustainable habits rather than cycle through weight loss and gain. 

The conversation reflected on how public scrutiny and expectations can be emotionally difficult, referencing Kirstie Alley’s openness about feeling pressure after regaining weight. Ireland praised honesty in these discussions and noted that kindness and acceptance are important for people of every size. She also highlighted the need for women—especially busy mothers—to make time for health checkups, pointing out that heart disease remains the leading cause of death for women in America. 

Both agreed that concerns around weight and image are not just an American phenomenon but increasingly common globally. Ultimately, the panel called for prioritizing well-being and encouraging a more compassionate approach to health for all.

Entinen huippumalli ja nykyinen liikainen Kathy Ireland kertoi hiljattain, että hänen suurin motivaationsa painonsa seuraamiseen kumpuaa halusta pysyä terveenä, ei ulkonäöllisistä syistä. Ireland keskusteli asiasta kuntoilun asiantuntija Bob Greenen kanssa "Larry King Live" -ohjelmassa ja korosti omakohtaisesti, kuinka vuosien aikana kertynyt paino on saanut hänet kiinnittämään enemmän huomiota esimerkiksi kolesteroliin ja sydämen terveyteen.

Sekä Ireland että Greene painottivat, että paino on enemmänkin merkki siitä, että elintapoja kannattaa tarkastella kokonaisvaltaisesti, esimerkiksi ruokavaliota parantamalla ja liikuntaa lisäämällä. Greene huomautti, että ylipaino itsessään aiheuttaa suurimmat terveysriskit, mutta parasta olisi omaksua pysyviä, terveellisiä tapoja sen sijaan, että paino vaihtelee jatkuvasti.

Keskustelussa pohdittiin myös sitä, kuinka julkinen arvostelu ja odotukset voivat olla henkisesti raskaita – esimerkkinä Kirstie Alley’n avoimuus omien painonvaihteluidensa aiheuttamasta paineesta. Ireland kehui rehellisyyttä näissä keskusteluissa ja korosti, että myötätunto ja hyväksyntä ovat tärkeitä kaiken kokoisille ihmisille. Per Mertesacker, currently playing as a defender for Arsenal, has decided to retire from international football, joining his teammates Philipp Lahm and Miroslav Klose in stepping down after Germany's World Cup triumph. In a conversation with Süddeutsche Zeitung, Mertesacker explained that the 2014 World Cup final against Argentina was his last game for the national team, ending a ten-year international career with 103 appearances and four goals. He emphasized the importance of ending this chapter on his own terms, with the World Cup victory serving as a perfect conclusion.

Mertesacker now plans to focus exclusively on his career at Arsenal, setting his sights on winning the Premier League and pursuing success in the Champions League. He expressed confidence that Germany’s coach, Joachim Low, would have no trouble finding new defensive talent and highlighted the strength of the current national squad. Mertesacker looked back fondly on his time with Germany—particularly the memorable weeks spent in Brazil during the World Cup—and will now concentrate on his responsibilities as Arsenal’s vice-captain, after previous stints at Hannover and Werder Bremen.

Having recently recorded four ducks in five innings, Morgan faces mounting pressure, yet responds with humour and determination. Drawing on past experiences overcoming bad form, Morgan is optimistic about regaining his performance. He calls on fellow senior players—himself, James Anderson, Stuart Broad, and Ian Bell—to deliver strong performances, especially following England's defeat to Australia. England now faces crucial matches, with their upcoming game against New Zealand at Wellington’s Westpac Stadium pivotal to their World Cup hopes. A loss would increase the pressure ahead of their match with Scotland. Meanwhile, Morgan’s recruitment by Sunrisers Hyderabad in the IPL provides a bright spot but also controversy, as it means missing an ODI against Ireland, sparking debate over where his priorities should lie. Morgan, along with England’s management, defends the IPL move as a growth opportunity, but scrutiny over his leadership continues as the tournament progresses.
