article_content: After more than twenty years of marriage, Mary L. Tabor and Del Persinger from Washington, D.C., reached a turning point. In 2005, as Mary relaxed at home one morning, Del told her he wanted to live alone, leaving Mary utterly shocked. Though both had felt tension building, with Mary attributing Del’s irritability and distance to his stressful job as a financial analyst, she was unprepared for a separation. Del had been considering leaving for some time, feeling constrained within the marriage but unable to explain his feelings to Mary. They started living apart, and by early 2006, each had hired attorneys and their carefully renovated home was put on the market. Mary, a writer and teacher, was heartbroken by the breakup, struggling to move on, even as she attempted to date. Deep down, she still loved Del. Del found that living alone brought routine rather than excitement. He realized he was not happier on his own and even delayed the divorce by focusing on minor details. Over time, therapy and honest conversations helped Del understand himself better. He and Mary cautiously began connecting again, rediscovering the importance of meaningful communication. In the winter of 2009, as Mary sought time for reflection in Paris, Del surprised her by traveling there to express his love. This unexpected act convinced Mary their relationship could be revived. After returning home together, they halted divorce proceedings and Del moved back in with Mary. Today, Mary and Del report their relationship is happier and less stressful, with improved understanding and communication. Rather than seeing Del’s past departure as a betrayal, Mary acknowledges life’s messiness and feels grateful for their renewed partnership.
translated_content: Yli kahdenkymmenen vuoden avioliiton jälkeen Mary L. Tabor ja Del Persinger Washingtonista joutuivat käännekohtaan. Vuonna 2005, kun Mary vietti rauhallista aamua kotona, Del ilmoitti haluavansa asua yksin – uutinen, joka järkytti Marya syvästi. Molemmat olivat tunteneet kasvavaa jännitettä, mutta Mary piti Delin ärtyisyyttä ja etäisyyttä stressaavan talousanalyytikon työn seurauksena, eikä osannut ennakoida eroa. Del oli pohtinut lähtöä jo pitkään, tuntenut avioliiton rajoittavan, mutta ei ollut kyennyt ilmaisemaan tunteitaan Marylle. Pariskunta muutti erilleen, ja vuoden 2006 alussa he molemmat palkkasivat asianajajat ja laittoivat huolella remontoidun kotinsa myyntiin. Mary, kirjoittaja ja opettaja, murtui erosta eikä päässyt siitä yli, vaikka yritti tapailla uusia ihmisiä. Syvällä sisimmässään hän kuitenkin edelleen rakasti Deliä. Delillä yksin eläminen toi mukanaan vähemmän vapautta ja enemmän rutiinia. Hän huomasi, ettei ollut onnellisempi yksin ja viivytteli avioeroa tarttumalla pieniin yksityiskohtiin. Vähitellen terapia ja rehelliset keskustelut auttoivat Deliä ymmärtämään itseään, ja he Maryn kanssa alkoivat varovasti lähentyä uudelleen ja löytää kommunikaation merkityksen. Talvella 2009 Mary matkusti Pariisiin etsimään selkeyttä, kun Del yllätti hänet matkustamalla sinne tunnustamaan rakkautensa. Tämä odottamaton ele sai Maryn vakuuttuneeksi siitä, että heidän suhteensa voisi vielä onnistua. Palattuaan yhdessä kotiin he keskeyttivät avioeroprosessin ja Del muutti takaisin Maryn luo. Nykyään Mary ja Del kokevat suhteensa onnellisempana ja vähemmän stressaavana, ja heidän välinen ymmärrys ja kommunikaatio ovat parantuneet. Mary ei pidä Delin aiempaa lähtöä petoksena, vaan pitää sitä osana elämän monimutkaisuutta ja on kiitollinen saadessaan uuden mahdollisuuden yhdessä.

article_content: Sarah Hardy, a baker based in London, decided to surprise her family at Christmas with a cake that looked strikingly like a raw turkey. Underneath the convincing marzipan 'skin,' however, was a rich orange and rum spice cake. Hardy spent three nights crafting the hyper-realistic creation, even serving it on a foil tray and tying up the legs with string for authenticity. When she revealed the cake, her family was shocked, initially thinking she had forgotten to cook the turkey, but they soon realized the clever ruse and eagerly took photos. Usually known for her elegant wedding cakes, Hardy wanted to add some humor and surprise to the holiday. The unique cake was such a hit that she plans to offer it to customers, with the idea of making mini versions for the next festive season. She runs Sarah Hardy Cakes in London and participates in the 'Eat Your Heart Out' edible art movement, directed by Miss Cakehead, which promotes creativity in cake design. Hardy said the cake tasted wonderful, like an orange drizzle cake.
translated_content: Lontoolainen leipuri Sarah Hardy yllätti perheensä jouluna kakulla, joka näytti erehdyttävästi raakalta kalkkunalta. Todellisuudessa marseipaanikuoren alla oli mehevä appelsiini-rommikakku. Hardy käytti kolme yötä tämän yksityiskohtaisen luomuksen tekoon, tarjoten sen foliovuoassa ja jalat langalla sidottuna aidon vaikutelman luomiseksi. Perhe oli aluksi ymmällään ja luuli hänen unohtaneen paistaa kalkkunan, mutta pian kaikki innostuivat tempauksesta ja ottivat kuvia yllätyksestä. Yleensä Hardy tunnetaan kauniista hääkakuistaan, mutta tällä kertaa hän halusi tuoda juhlaan huumoria ja yllätyksen. Erikoiskakku sai niin paljon kiitosta, että Hardy aikoo tarjota sitä asiakkailleen ja suunnittelee pienempiä versioita ensi jouluksi. Sarah Hardy Cakes -nimistä leipomoa Lontoossa pyörittävä Hardy on mukana myös Eat Your Heart Out -syötävän taiteen liikkeessä, jota johtaa Miss Cakehead. Liike edistää luovuutta kakkujen suunnittelussa. Hardy kertoi kakun maistuneen erinomaiselta – melkein kuin appelsiini-siirappikakku.

article_content: A University of Oklahoma professor has been suspended following allegations of sexual abuse, according to school police. "OU officials acted quickly to suspend Dwain Pellebon from any contact with students and from using university facilities," said Catherine Bishop of the university police department. "As per university procedure, he was immediately placed on administrative leave with pay until more information is gathered from the investigation, at which point his status could change to leave without pay." Pellebon, 54, is an associate professor who teaches social work. Norman police arrested him on Friday based on two complaints of first-degree rape and one complaint of lewd acts with a child under 16, CNN affiliate KFOR reported. Official charges have not yet been filed. "We can confirm there is one alleged victim, and we are working to determine if there are any additional victims," said Tom Easley with the Norman Police Department, according to KFOR. Pellebon’s attorney told KFOR that his client denies all allegations. According to the university's website, Pellebon teaches a course on human sexuality, described as an examination of sexual behavior, gender differences, and sexual values. CNN's Joe Sutton and Ed Payne contributed to this report.

"Yliopiston käytännön mukaisesti hänet asetettiin välittömästi palkalliselle hallinnolliselle vapaalle, kunnes tutkinnasta saadaan lisää tietoa. Tämän jälkeen hänen vapautensa voi muuttua palkattomaksi." 54-vuotias Pellebon on sosiaalityön apulaisprofessori. Normanin poliisi pidätti hänet perjantaina kahden ensimmäisen asteen raiskausilmoituksen ja yhden alle 16-vuotiaaseen lapseen kohdistuneesta siveettömästä teosta tehdyn ilmoituksen perusteella, raportoi CNN:n kumppanikanava KFOR. Virallisia syytteitä ei ole vielä nostettu. "Voin varmistaa, että tiedossamme on yksi väitetty uhri, ja selvitämme, onko muita uhreja", kertoo Norman poliisin Tom Easley KFOR:lle. Pellebonin asianajaja kertoi KFOR:lle, että hänen asiakkaansa kiistää kaikki syytökset. Yliopiston verkkosivujen mukaan Pellebon opettaa ihmisen seksuaalisuutta käsittelevää kurssia, jossa tarkastellaan seksuaalista käyttäytymistä, sukupuolieroja ja seksuaaliarvoja. CNN:n Joe Sutton ja Ed Payne osallistuivat tämän raportin laatimiseen.

article_content: The Court of Appeal in Abuja has scheduled its judgment on the Kano State governorship election dispute for Friday, November 17, 2023, at 10 a.m. The case involves Governor Abba Yusuf of the New Nigeria Peoples Party and Nasiru Gawuna of the All Progressives Congress. According to The PUNCH, the court had previously reserved judgment on November 6 after Yusuf appealed his removal by the Governorship Election Petition Tribunal. The tribunal, on September 20, nullified Yusuf’s election by declaring 165,663 of his votes invalid.

Tapauksessa on kyse New Nigeria Peoples Party’n kuvernööri Abba Yusufin ja All Progressives Congressin Nasiru Gawunan välisestä riidasta. article_content: Channel 4's broadcast of the Paralympic Games opening ceremony faced criticism from viewers due to frequent advertising breaks. Many took to social media to express their frustration and suggest the BBC would have been a better, ad-free choice as broadcaster. TV presenter Phillip Schofield tweeted: 'Loving the spectacle of the Paralympics but it sits a bit awkwardly with the ads or is that just me.' Viewers were particularly upset after Channel 4 cut to a second ad break only twenty minutes into the ceremony. In total, five advert breaks aired in the first hour and a half, including ads for sponsors such as Toyota, Asda, Sainsbury's, and Channel 4's own Paralympic coverage. As a result, many missed key moments—like an inspirational video montage and the entrance of athletes from some countries. A Channel 4 insider stated that fewer ads aired than usual, explaining on Twitter: 'We're showing less than usual, but as a commercially funded broadcaster, advertising allows us to show events like the Paralympics.' A Channel 4 spokesperson said: 'We decided to run less advertising during the opening ceremony than during regular peak-time programming, but Channel 4 is a commercially funded public service broadcaster. Advertising allows us to invest in original programming and events such as the Paralympics.' In comparison, the BBC received widespread praise for its seamless, ad-free Olympics coverage. Several Twitter users commented that broadcasting rights should have been given to the BBC. Abby wrote: 'However well Channel 4 do the Paralympic coverage, the ad breaks are going to let it down.' Presenters including Jon Snow, Jonathan Edwards, Ade Adepitan, and Clare Balding led Channel 4’s coverage. Social media reactions ranged from disappointment over the adverts to appreciation for the ceremony. The London 2012 Paralympic Games opening ceremony achieved a peak UK audience of 11.2 million—Channel 4's largest in over a decade—and averaged 7.6 million viewers for a 40% audience share. By comparison, the 2008 Beijing Paralympics opening ceremony had a UK peak of 2.8 million. Jay Hunt, Channel 4’s Chief Creative Officer, called the ceremony a spectacular start and was pleased with the audience numbers. Some viewers noted Channel 4 had broadcast a six-hour music event the previous week without ads and questioned the need for ad breaks during the Paralympic ceremony. Others defended Channel 4, noting they secured broadcast rights from LOCOG and depend on advertising for funding. Professor Stephen Hawking opened the ceremony with a speech about humanity and science. After an artistic performance, the athletes’ parade followed, and many praised the event’s spectacle online. Despite controversy about adverts, there was widespread admiration for the Paralympic athletes and the scale of the event.
translated_content: Channel 4:n lähetys Paralympialaisten avajaisista sai katsojilta kritiikkiä toistuvien mainoskatkojen vuoksi. Monet purkivat turhautumistaan somessa ja ehdottivat, että BBC olisi ollut parempi valinta kaupallisten mainosten puuttuessa. TV-juontaja Phillip Schofield twiittasi: 'Rakastan tätä Paralympialaisten spektaakkelia, mutta mainokset tuntuvat tässä yhteydessä vähän oudolta vai olenko vain minä?' Katsojat olivat erityisen ärsyyntyneitä, kun Channel 4 siirtyi toiseen mainoskatkoon vain 20 minuuttia avajaisten alun jälkeen. Yhteensä puolentoista tunnin aikana esitettiin viisi mainoskatkoa, joissa mainostettiin muun muassa Toyotaa, Asdaa, Sainsbury'sia sekä Channel 4:n omaa paralympiakattausta. Tämän seurauksena monet jäivät paitsi tärkeistä hetkistä, kuten inspiroivasta videomontaasista ja joidenkin maiden urheilijoiden sisääntulosta. Channel 4:n sisäpiiriläinen totesi, että mainoksia näytettiin vähemmän kuin tavallisesti ja selitti Twitterissä: 'Näytämme tavallista vähemmän mainoksia, mutta koska olemme kaupallisesti rahoitettu kanava, mainokset mahdollistavat tällaisten tapahtumien lähettämisen.' Channel 4:n tiedottaja sanoi: 'Päätimme näyttää vähemmän mainontaa avajaisseremonian aikana kuin normaalisti parhaaseen katseluaikaan, mutta Channel 4 on kaupallisesti rahoitettu julkinen palvelukanava. Mainonta mahdollistaa investoinnit alkuperäisiin ohjelmiin ja tapahtumiin, kuten paralympialaisiin.' Vertailun vuoksi BBC:tä kehuttiin laajalti saumattomasta, mainoksettomasta olympialaisten lähetyksestään. Useat Twitter-käyttäjät kommentoivat, että lähetysoikeudet olisi pitänyt antaa BBC:lle. Abby kirjoitti: 'Vaikka Channel 4 tekee hyvää paralympialaisten lähetystä, mainoskatkot pilaavat sen.' Juontajat Jon Snow, Jonathan Edwards, Ade Adepitan ja Clare Balding johtivat Channel 4:n lähetystä. Sosiaalisen median reaktiot vaihtelivat pettymyksestä mainoksiin ja kiitoksiin itse tapahtumasta. Lontoon 2012 paralympialaisten avajaiset saavuttivat Isossa-Britanniassa huippuyleisön, 11,2 miljoonaa katsojaa – Channel 4:n suurin luku yli vuosikymmeneen – ja keskimäärin 7,6 miljoonaa katsojaa, mikä on 40 % osuus. Vertailun vuoksi Pekingin 2008 paralympialaisten avajaiset keräsivät Britanniassa enimmillään 2,8 miljoonaa katsojaa. Channel 4:n luova johtaja Jay Hunt kuvaili seremoniaa upeaksi aluksi ja iloitsi korkeasta katsojamäärästä. Osa katsojista huomautti, että Channel 4 oli aiemmin lähettänyt kuuden tunnin musiikkitapahtuman ilman mainoksia ja ihmetteli mainoskatkojen tarvetta paralympia-avajaisissa. Jotkut puolustivat Channel 4:n valintoja, sillä kanava sai lähetysoikeudet LOCOGilta ja sen toiminta rahoitetaan mainoksilla. Professori Stephen Hawking avasi seremonian inhimillisyyttä ja tiedettä käsittelevällä puheella. Tämän jälkeen nähtiin taiteellinen esitys ja urheilijoiden paraati, ja moni kehui spektaakkelia verkossa. Vaikka mainoskatkoista syntyi kiistaa, suurin osa arvosti paralympiaurheilijoiden saavutuksia ja tapahtuman laajuutta.

article_content: Shrikant Chouhan of Kotak Securities noted that the Nifty50 crossing the 15,800 mark surprised many in the market. Around midday on Friday, shares of Shriram Finance Ltd. rose 0.91% to Rs 1960.85, after closing at Rs 1943.15 the previous session. At the same time, the Sensex was down 76.32 points, at 64,755.88. Over the last year, Shriram Finance’s shares increased by 57.62%, far ahead of the Sensex’s 12.37% gain during the same period. The stock’s 52-week range is between Rs 1190.0 and Rs 2049.95. Trading volume by that point was 10,222 shares. Shriram Finance’s valuation figures include a price-to-earnings ratio of 11.12, earnings per share of 175.18, and a price-to-book value of 1.08. Within the Nifty50 group, 24 stocks were up and 25 were down. Data as of September 2023 shows promoters own 25.45% of Shriram Finance, foreign institutional investors (FIIs) hold 54.67%, and mutual funds own 9.57%. For the quarter ending September 2023, Shriram Finance reported consolidated sales of Rs 8,892.99 crore, a 7.24% rise from the prior quarter and 66.18% higher than a year ago. Net profit was Rs 1,786.11 crore. Technical indicators show a bullish trend for Shriram Finance, according to the MACD—a tool that tracks trend reversals by comparing moving averages. When the MACD crosses beneath the signal line, it signals a bearish outlook; crossing above signals bullishness. Public sector banks have reassured the finance ministry that small unsecured loans do not currently pose a systemic risk. Meanwhile, India is considering a move that would allow surplus funds in rupee vostro accounts to be invested in corporate bonds. Additionally, the Burman family, who are major shareholders in Religare Enterprises, have asked regulators to investigate share transactions by chairperson Rashmi Saluja.

article_content: More than 20 cannabis plants were unexpectedly found growing amongst decorative begonias and petunias in public flowerpots across Newport, South Wales. Passers-by and shoppers admired the displays, unaware that some of the greenery was actually marijuana. Dean Beddis, a local businessman, expressed surprise at seeing the cannabis, humorously likening the scene to Amsterdam and suggesting Newport was aiming for a win in the City in Bloom competition. Council gardeners, not realizing what they were watering and feeding, helped nurture the illegal plants. Police were alerted to the situation, but by the time they arrived, the cannabis had already been removed. The identity of whoever planted or harvested them remains unknown. Some of the plants reportedly grew less than half a mile from Newport’s main police station, and officers had unknowingly passed by every day. A spokesperson for Newport Council said the matter is being treated seriously, promising to consult CCTV evidence and keep the police informed. Gwent Police commented that with the plants no longer present, it's hard to determine exactly what species they were or if the planting was planned. While the incident amused some locals, authorities are taking it seriously.

Paikallinen yrittäjä Dean Beddis yllättyi nähdessään kannabista ja vitsaili, että Newport yrittää olla uusi Amsterdam ja voittaa City in Bloom -kilpailun. Kaupungin puutarhurit hoitivat laittomia kasveja tietämättään kastellen ja lannoittaen niitä. Poliisi kutsuttiin paikalle, mutta siihen mennessä kannabikset oli jo kerätty pois, eikä tekijä/tekijöitä ole saatu selville. Osa kasveista löytyi alle puolen mailin päästä Newportin poliisiasemasta, jonka ohi poliisitkin kulkivat päivittäin huomaamatta mitään poikkeavaa. Newportin kaupungin edustaja ilmoitti, että asiaan suhtaudutaan vakavasti: valvontakamerat tarkastetaan ja poliisia informoidaan. Gwentin poliisi totesi, että kasvien kadottua on vasin vaikeaa varmistaa olivatko ne varmasti kannabista tai oliko istuttaminen tahallista. Vaikka tapaus huvitti joitain paikallisia, viranomaiset suhtautuvat asiaan vakavasti.

article_content: BBC News' transition to an open-plan newsroom with a glass wall at Broadcasting House in London has resulted in unexpected on-air distractions. Viewers have started noticing staff in the background during live broadcasts engaging in activities such as eating, stretching, chatting, or joking, prompting online criticism about professionalism. Complaints about these background activities began when the team moved from Television Centre in March. Social media users have described situations—like staff playing with umbrellas or hugging—while serious topics are being discussed on air. Some viewers find these scenes visually distracting and believe they detract from important news coverage. BBC employees have also expressed embarrassment about being so visible, with remarks likening the experience to 'pandas in a zoo.' Staff have suggested making the glass wall opaque to minimize such incidents, but BBC management intended the open design to foster collaboration and transparency. Broadcasting House, now the main BBC headquarters, features a modern extension to its historic 1932 structure, following the closure of the White City site. The renovations were originally overseen by Sir Richard MacCormac, who left due to funding disputes; another firm completed the work. Responding to criticism, a BBC spokesperson said the newsroom was designed to showcase BBC journalism and promote collaboration, emphasizing that staff are expected to behave appropriately.

article_content: The Inter-Party Advisory Council (IPAC) has encouraged Kano State Governor Abba Yusuf to appoint individuals from different political parties to his cabinet to promote greater inclusivity in government. Ralphs Nwosu, the National Chairman of the African Democratic Congress, made this statement during a media briefing at Tahir Guest Palace Hotel, following a tour of several projects initiated by the governor. Nwosu emphasized that a more diverse cabinet would give various groups a chance to contribute to Kano’s growth and help ensure the democratic process benefits everyone. The IPAC delegation, which includes leaders from all Nigerian political parties, gave Governor Yusuf high marks for overseeing around 11 major projects spanning education, healthcare, agriculture, and infrastructure. Speaking on behalf of IPAC National Chairman Sani Yabagi, Nwosu explained that these project tours aim to promote accountable and effective governance across the country. He highlighted the importance of involving members of other parties to help resolve historic disagreements and foster further development. Nwosu also noted the current administration's achievements, including implementing significant projects over a six-month period without resorting to loans. The IPAC team plans to submit their recommendations and detailed findings to President Bola Tinubu and the National Assembly. The delegation praised Kano’s security environment and commended government employees for advancing the state’s socio-economic progress. They observed that the current policies align with IPAC’s principles and were impressed that the projects were executed without external borrowing. In summary, IPAC advocates for an inclusive approach in Kano’s governance, recognizing the government’s progress and intent to encourage similar practices nationwide.

article_content: Australia has signed what Prime Minister Anthony Albanese described as the most significant Pacific agreement in its history with the island nation of Tuvalu. The new treaty covers climate, economic, and security assistance. The Falepili Union agreement will establish an annual pathway for up to 280 Tuvalu citizens to live, work, or study in Australia, offering a response to the increasing threat of climate change. Albanese announced the deal on Friday during a press conference in the Cook Islands alongside Tuvalu’s Prime Minister, Kausea Natano. The treaty also commits Australia to support Tuvalu in the event of humanitarian disasters, health pandemics, or security challenges. According to a NASA study released in August, much of Tuvalu’s land and key infrastructure could be below average high tide by 2050 if climate change continues at the current rate. The Falepili Union is seen as a milestone for Australia’s recent diplomatic outreach in the Pacific, and the first agreement of its kind between Canberra and a Pacific nation. The United States and New Zealand have previously made similar treaties with Pacific nations. Australia and the United States intensified their engagement in the Pacific after the Solomon Islands signed a security agreement with China in early 2022. Tuvalu’s Prime Minister Natano stated his country had sought the partnership with Australia, calling it a ‘beacon of hope’ and a ‘giant leap forward’ for regional stability and sustainability. The agreement still requires approval by both the Australian and Tuvaluan governments before it takes effect. The announcement followed intense meetings between Pacific leaders on Aitutaki atoll, where topics included climate change, nuclear issues, and regional security.

Uusi sopimus kattaa ilmasto-, talous- ja turvallisuusavun. Falepili Union -sopimus tarjoaa vuosittain jopa 280 tuvalulaiselle mahdollisuuden muuttaa Australiaan asumaan, opiskelemaan tai työskentelemään – vastauksena kasvavaan ilmastonmuutoksen uhkaan. Albanese julkisti sopimuksen perjantaina lehdistötilaisuudessa Cookinsaarilla yhdessä Tuvalun pääministerin Kausea Natanon kanssa. Sopimus sitouttaa Australian myös tukemaan Tuvalua humanitaaristen katastrofien, terveyspandemioiden tai turvallisuushaasteiden sattuessa. NASAn elokuussa julkaistun tutkimuksen mukaan suuri osa Tuvalun maasta ja keskeisestä infrastruktuurista voi olla keskimääräisen yläveden alapuolella vuoteen 2050 mennessä, jos ilmastonmuutos jatkuu nykyisellä vauhdilla. Falepili Union nähdään merkittävänä saavutuksena Australian viimeaikaisessa Tyynenmeren diplomatiassa ja ensimmäisenä laatuaan Canberran ja Tyynenmeren valtion välillä. Yhdysvallat ja Uusi-Seelanti ovat aiemmin tehneet vastaavia sopimuksia alueen valtioiden kanssa. Australia ja Yhdysvallat tiivistivät toimintaansa Tyynellämerellä sen jälkeen, kun Salomonsaaret allekirjoittivat turvallisuussopimuksen Kiinan kanssa vuoden 2022 alussa. Tuvalun pääministeri Natano kertoi, että maa oli pyytänyt tätä kumppanuutta Australialta ja kutsui sitä toivon majakaksi sekä jättiaskeleeksi alueen vakauden ja kestävyyden edistämisessä. Sopimus tarvitsee vielä sekä Australian että Tuvalun hallitusten hyväksynnän ennen voimaantuloa. Sopimus julkistettiin intensiivisten Tyynenmeren alueen johtajien kokousten päätteeksi Aitutakin atollilla, jossa keskusteltiin muun muassa ilmastonmuutoksesta, ydinvoimasta ja alueellisesta turvallisuudesta.

Napoli striker Victor Osimhen has been named among the 12 finalists for The Best FIFA Men’s Player of the Year award, making him the only African still in contention. FIFA announced the shortlist on Thursday, noting Osimhen’s instrumental role between December 19, 2022, and August 10, 2023—during which he scored 29 goals and led Napoli to their first Serie A victory in more than 30 years, also earning him the league’s top scorer title and a place in Serie A’s Team of the Season.

Other shortlisted male players are Lionel Messi (Argentina), Kylian Mbappé (France), Erling Haaland (Norway/Manchester City), Kevin De Bruyne, Julian Alvarez, Marcelo Brozovic, Ilkay Gundogan, Rodrigo Cascante, Khvicha Kvaratskhelia, Declan Rice, and Bernardo Silva.

Nigerian star Asisat Oshoala was not included in the final women’s shortlist, but her Barcelona Femini teammates Jennifer Hermoso and Aitana Bonmati did make the list, along with Linda Caicedo, Rachel Daly, Kadidiatou Diani, Caitlin Foord, Mary Fowler, Alex Greenwood, Lindsey Horan, Amanda Ilestedt, Lauren James, Sam Kerr, Mapi León, Hinata Miyazawa, Salma Paralluelo, and Keira Walsh.

African goalkeepers Andre Onana (Cameroon) and Yassine Bounou (Morocco) are among the five finalists for Best FIFA Men’s Goalkeeper. Bounou secured the UEFA Europa League with Sevilla and was included in the Team of the Season, while Onana won both the Supercoppa Italiana and Coppa Italia with Inter Milan. Other goalkeeper nominees are Thibaut Courtois, Ederson Santana de Moraes, and Marc-André ter Stegen.

article_content: A new digital map from Twitter’s data team showcases how the shooting of Michael Brown in Ferguson, Missouri, quickly grew from a local event into a national topic. By analyzing tweets that mentioned Michael Brown and Ferguson, the team was able to track the viral spread of the story. Initially, just a few tweets surfaced from the Midwest, but the online conversation exploded in just three days—between August 9 and 11—lighting up the map as the story gained momentum across the country. Reporting by The Atlantic’s CityLab notes that Twitter activity surged most dramatically after police arrested journalists Wesley Lowery and Ryan Reilly on August 13, giving the story further traction. The rise in Twitter usage paralleled increasing tensions between protestors and law enforcement, particularly after key arrests and the circulation of graphic images. Outlets like the Huffington Post emphasized the importance of Twitter hashtags and images in shaping national awareness of the events. On that Friday, the conversation spiked anew when Ferguson police named Officer Darren Wilson as the officer who shot Michael Brown. That day, authorities also announced Brown was a robbery suspect, although Officer Wilson reportedly did not know of this at the time. According to USA Today, Wilson first stopped Brown for walking in the street before the situation escalated.

Tiimi analysoi tweettejä, joissa mainittiin Michael Brown ja Ferguson, ja pystyi seuraamaan tarinan leviämistä verkossa. Aluksi vain muutama viesti nousi esiin Keskilännestä, mutta keskustelu paisui kolmessa päivässä – 9.–11. elokuuta – ja kartta valaisi koko maan. The Atlanticin CityLab raportoi, että Twitterin aktiivisuus nousi jyrkästi sen jälkeen, kun poliisi pidätti toimittajat Wesley Loweryn ja Ryan Reillyn 13. elokuuta, mikä lisäsi tarinan kattavuutta. Samana päivänä viranomaiset ilmoittivat myös, että Brown oli ryöstöepäilty, vaikka uutisoitiin, ettei Wilson tiennyt tästä kohtaamisen hetkellä. USA Todayn mukaan Wilson pysäytti Brownin alun perin tämän kävellessä kadulla ennen kuin tilanne riistäytyi käsistä.

The U.S. dollar rebounded on Tuesday, partially reversing last week’s sharp decline, which many analysts considered excessive in the short term. The dollar's recovery came as the euro weakened due to disappointing economic data from Germany, while the Australian dollar fell sharply after the country's central bank raised interest rates but suggested further hikes are unlikely for now.

Last week, the dollar sold off after Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell struck a more dovish-than-expected tone at the conclusion of a policy meeting where interest rates were left unchanged. A weaker-than-anticipated U.S. jobs report on Friday added to the dollar's decline.

Marc Chandler, chief market strategist at Bannockburn Global Forex in New York, remarked, “This dollar bounce yesterday and today is really a correction of what happened last week—a one-two punch between the Fed's dovish stance and the soft jobs data.”

The dollar index, which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, climbed 0.37% to 105.64 after dropping 1.4% last week—its largest weekly loss since July. BCA Research's Chester Ntonifor pointed out that almost all currencies had declined against the dollar over the last 26 weeks, and that crowded long-dollar positions were reversed in reaction to the jobs report.

Markets now see only a slim chance of another Fed rate hike and are pricing in three 25-basis-point cuts by next November. Further weakness in the dollar could occur as the U.S. economy slows. Upcoming data are expected to show weaker consumer inflation and declining retail sales, with factors such as resuming student loan payments and high interest rates potentially slowing consumer activity, according to Chandler.

Chandler added, “The rally in the dollar since July owed much to divergence—now, we may see convergence, not due to strength elsewhere, but because the U.S. outlook is softening.”

Investors are also monitoring remarks from Federal Reserve officials this week, including Chair Powell, who is scheduled to speak Wednesday and Thursday. On Tuesday, Minneapolis Fed President Neel Kashkari suggested the central bank may need to do more to achieve its 2% inflation target, while Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee noted progress in curbing inflation and said future decisions would focus on how long to maintain current rates.

The euro fell 0.37% to $1.0677 after data showed a larger-than-expected drop in German industrial production in September. Fiona Cincotta at City Index said the data follows a sharp contraction in German manufacturing and highlights ongoing economic pressures.

The Australian dollar dropped 1.18% to $0.6415 after the Reserve Bank of Australia raised rates by 25 basis points to combat persistent inflation. However, the central bank’s guidance was interpreted as dovish, suggesting further tightening is unlikely. Carol Kong, currency strategist at the Commonwealth Bank of Australia, noted that the Australian dollar’s initial gains faded quickly as traders reacted to the RBA’s comments. The currency is on track for its biggest one-day drop in a month.

The U.S. dollar advanced 0.36% against the Japanese yen to 150.59, rebounding above the closely-watched 150 level. Last week, the yen softened to 151.74 per dollar, near lows that previously triggered Japanese government intervention.

Additional financial news included India’s accelerated efforts to approve Tesla’s entry by January 2024, a surge in luxury sales fueled by the Diwali festival, and slower wage growth for Indian technology professionals as major IT firms reduce hiring amid global headwinds.

Viime viikolla dollari heikkeni, kun keskuspankin pääjohtaja Jerome Powell antoi odotettua maltillisemman viestin kokouksen lopuksi, eikä korkotasoon tullut muutoksia. Lisäksi heikompi Yhdysvaltain työmarkkinaraportti laski dollaria entisestään.

Marc Chandler, Bannockburn Global Forexin päästrategi, sanoi: "Tämä dollarin palautuminen on oikeastaan korjaus viime viikon tapahtumiin – Fedin maltillisuus ja heikko työmarkkinadata olivat tuplaisku."

Dollari-indeksi, joka seuraa dollarin kehitystä kuuteen päävaluuttaan nähden, nousi 0,37% tasolle 105,64. Viime viikolla se oli laskenut 1,4%, eniten sitten heinäkuun. Markkinat arvioivat seuraavan Fedin koronnoston mahdollisuuden pieneksi ja odottavat kolmea 0,25 prosenttiyksikön koronlaskua ensi marraskuuhun mennessä. "Dollariralli heinäkuusta lähtien perustui kehityseroon – nyt voi tulla lähentymistä, ei siksi että muualla menisi paremmin, vaan koska Yhdysvalloista tulee heikompia uutisia," Chandler jatkoi.

Sijoittajat seuraavat Fedin edustajien puheita, etenkin Powellin keskiviikkona ja torstaina. Chicagon Fedin Austan Goolsbee totesi, että inflaatiota on saatu alas ja että huomio keskittyy korkotason säilyttämisen kestoon.

Carol Kong Commonwealth Bank of Australialta huomautti, että alkuperäinen nousu kääntyi nopeasti laskuksi. Kyseessä on suurin yhden päivän pudotus kuukauteen.

Yhdysvaltain dollari nousi 0,36% jeniä vastaan tasolle 150,59 ylittäen seurattavan 150 tason. Viime viikolla jeni oli 151,74 dollaria kohden, lähellä tason lokakuun 2022 lukuja, jotka johtivat Japanin valuuttainterventioihin.

From September to November 2023, Nigeria's Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC) secured more than 320 convictions of individuals involved in internet fraud, commonly referred to as 'Yahoo boys.' Prosecutions took place in courts across many Nigerian states, including Kano, Lagos, Kaduna, Benin, Ilorin, Anambra, Oyo, Ogun, Port Harcourt, Maiduguri, Makurdi, Calabar, and Abuja. Those found guilty were given various prison sentences, with many cases involving multiple offenders at once.

Among the most recent cases, Benjamin Udeagwu and Benjamin Olamide were each sentenced to three years imprisonment by a Kano State High Court. In another major conviction, Justice Nnamdi Dimkpa in Anambra State jailed 25 individuals who pleaded guilty to impersonation. Courts in Edo State, especially in Benin City, handed down several group sentences to offenders charged with impersonation and obtaining by false pretence.

Similar judgements were delivered in Rivers State, the Federal Capital Territory, Oyo State, and others. Convictions were typically issued after the accused admitted guilt, with many cases involving false identities used to defraud people of money.

Reacting to these developments, Dr. Kabir Adamu—Managing Director of Beacon Consulting Limited and security expert—urged the Nigerian government to address root causes of such crimes, including unemployment and the high cost of living, cautioning that these issues contribute to the persistence of internet fraud.

article_content: During a test flight of Virgin Galactic’s SpaceShipTwo rocket in the Mojave Desert on Friday, a serious anomaly caused the craft to crash, resulting in the death of co-pilot Michael Tyner Alsbury, 39. The pilot, Peter Siebold, 43, survived by parachuting to safety. Virgin Galactic’s founder, Sir Richard Branson, has faced criticism for allegedly distancing himself and his company from the tragedy. Some commentators, including blogger Douglas Messier, suggest Branson attempted to attribute responsibility for the crash solely to Scaled Composites, the aerospace company that developed and operated SpaceShipTwo. Branson initially stated he had not met Alsbury, but video footage shows the two celebrating a prior successful flight together in April 2013. Branson later clarified that he had briefly shaken Alsbury’s hand and congratulated him after that flight. Investigations into the crash are being led by the National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB), and officials warn that determining the exact cause could take up to a year. The crash has likely delayed plans for Virgin Galactic's commercial space tourism flights, which the company had initially hoped to launch as early as next spring. Virgin Galactic reports having received $90 million from about 700 prospective passengers, including prominent figures such as Stephen Hawking, Justin Bieber, Ashton Kutcher, and Russell Brand. Branson stated that none of these funds have been spent and that refunds are available upon request. Past test flights had been described as joint efforts between Virgin Galactic and Scaled Composites. Critics have questioned the delineation of responsibility in the wake of the accident. Branson affirmed the company's commitment to safety and expressed condolences to the affected families. SpaceShipTwo’s crash also follows a previous tragedy in 2007, when three people died testing a rocket motor for the program. The current investigation is analyzing flight data, video, and debris to determine the sequence of events leading up to the accident.

Virgin Galacticin perustajaa, Sir Richard Bransonia, on arvosteltu siitä, että hän olisi etäännyttänyt itsensä ja yrityksensä tapahtuneesta tragediasta. Kommentaattorit, kuten bloggaaja Douglas Messier, ovat syyttäneet Bransonia vastuun siirtämisestä kokonaan SpaceShipTwon kehittäneelle ja operoineelle Scaled Composites -yhtiölle. article_content: Nigeria’s Super Eagles drew 2-2 with Saudi Arabia in an international friendly played in Portugal on Friday. Coach Jose Peseiro said the team lacked a killer instinct up front after creating many chances and dominating possession but failing to win. Like their last meeting 13 years ago, the match ended even. Saudi Arabia, who were on a six-match losing run, scored first when Nigerian goalkeeper Francis Uzoho deflected a long-range free-kick from Salman Al Faraj into his own net. Peseiro said: 'We need to improve on our finishing. We played very well in the first half and could have scored three to five goals, and we also created more chances in the second half. This squad needs more killer instinct, but I’m happy with the result.' Victor Osimhen, Ademola Lookman, and Samuel Chukwueze all had chances in the first half but didn’t convert. Peseiro substituted Terem Moffi for the injured Osimhen and brought in Bright Osayi-Samuel, Kelechi Iheanacho, and Moses Simon. These changes helped Nigeria’s attack. Moses Simon assisted Victor Boniface for the equalizer (Boniface’s first goal for Nigeria) in the 73rd minute, and Kelechi Iheanacho scored eight minutes later after good work from Moffi and Simon. Saudi Arabia equalized late with a deflected free-kick, making it 2-2 at full time. The game came right after Nigeria learned they’ll face Cote d’Ivoire, Guinea Bissau, and Equatorial Guinea in the next Africa Cup of Nations group stage, and shortly after adopting 'Let’s Do It Again' as their tournament slogan. Next, the Super Eagles play Mozambique in another friendly, then prepare for 2026 World Cup qualifiers against Lesotho and Zimbabwe.

A new social media trend known as 'milking' is gaining popularity among UK university students. The trend features students and graduates pouring large amounts of milk over their heads in busy public places around Newcastle. Their original video, uploaded one Monday night, quickly gained traction online and reached about 30,000 views within a week.

The two-and-a-half-minute video shows participants performing 'milking' outside pubs, on traffic roundabouts, up trees, and in the streets. Tom Morris, 22, one of the organizers, said, "We were joking in the kitchen about trying it outside Starbucks in Jesmond, so we gave it a go and posted to Facebook. Since it was so popular, we decided to film a full video."

Fellow organizer George Hoyland added, "We didn't expect it to get this big—it started just for our friends. The puns people have shared have really made us laugh!"

Online, the reactions have been mixed. While many find the acts funny and creative, others consider them immature and criticize the waste of milk. Some local residents and councillors have raised concerns about how such stunts affect the reputation of students. Barbara Spicer, an online commenter, mocked the participants by calling them the ‘future leaders of our country,’ and local councillor Gregg Stone shared his doubts about the students' public image.

Despite criticism, the 'milking' trend has inspired similar videos at other universities, including Oxford, Edinburgh, Nottingham, and Cirencester, with many students reaching out to join in. The original group acknowledged that the trend has its downsides: the strong smell of milk lingers in their house and their laundry load has increased.

As 'milking' gains momentum, debate continues over whether it is harmless fun or simply a messy waste.

Nettikeskustelut ovat olleet ristiriitaisia. Monien mielestä tempaus on hauska ja luova, kun taas toiset pitävät sitä lapsellisena ja tuhlailevana. Tunde Oladunjoye, APC Publicity Secretary in Ogun State, addressed criticism over the distribution of relief supplies following fuel subsidy removal. He claimed Ogun’s methods are among Nigeria’s most efficient, involving traditional leaders, youth, religious bodies, market groups, and community representatives in both organization and delivery.

Responding to allegations that one rice bag was shared among over a hundred people, Oladunjoye described these as politically motivated falsehoods. He referenced videos from Obafemi Owode LGA leaders who later withdrew their allegations. Stakeholder representatives—not government or party officials—handled distribution, ensuring non-partisan, inclusive reach, particularly to the vulnerable. Recipients had their details listed in advance, received goods at their homes or polling units, and all items were labeled and branded by the state to avoid misuse. Distribution was fully financed by the state to all 236 Ogun wards.

Additional support in the state includes monthly transport stipends for workers and pensioners, a program recently extended by six months, and early adoption of compressed natural gas vehicles. 

Oladunjoye clarified that the APC was not involved in distributing palliatives, which were allocated solely based on need. He accused political opponents of spreading doubts following their failed court challenges against the government.

He praised new cabinet appointees and Governor Abiodun’s leadership, highlighting the recent federal approval for Ogun to manage the Lagos-Ota-Abeokuta highway. Though the government is expanding ministries, Oladunjoye argued these changes will enhance state revenues.

Separately, he launched a support fund for families of deceased Ogun journalists, inspired by similar acts in Lagos and encouraged by widespread donations and recognition—including from the Presidency. Oladunjoye advocated for more active support for bereaved journalists’ families across Nigeria.

Syytöksiin siitä, että yksi riisisäkki jaettiin yli sadalle ihmiselle, Oladunjoye suhtautuu poliittisesti motivoituina valheina. Hän viittasi Obafemi Owoden alueen johtajiin, jotka peruutivat myöhemmin omat syytöksensä. Avustusten jako hoidettiin yhteisöjen edustajien toimesta – ei virkamiesten tai puolueväen – jotta apu tavoittaisi aidosti haavoittuvimmat ja pysyisi puolueettomana. Vastaanottajien tiedot kerättiin ennakkoon ja jakelu tapahtui koteihin tai äänestyspaikoille. Kaikki paketit oli leimattu ja merkitty osavaltion toimesta väärinkäytösten estämiseksi. Jakelu kattoi kaikki 236 Ogunin vaalialuetta ja oli täysin osavaltion rahoittama.

Lisäksi työntekijöille ja eläkeläisille maksetaan kuukausittaista kuljetusavustusta, ohjelmaa jatkettiin juuri kuudella kuukaudella. Ogun oli edelläkävijä maakaasukäyttöisten ajoneuvojen käyttöönotossa. 

Oladunjoye korostaa, ettei puolue osallistunut jakeluun, vaan apua jaettiin yksin tarveperusteisesti. Hänen mukaansa epäilykset ovat poliittisten vastustajien lietsomia tappion jälkeen.

Lopuksi hän kiitti uusia hallituksen jäseniä sekä kuvernööri Abiodunin johtajuutta ja mainitsi liittovaltiolta saadun luvan ottaa Lagos-Ota-Abeokuta-tie Ogunin hallintaan. Oladunjoyen mukaan uusien ministeriöiden perustaminen lisää valtion tuloja.

Hän kertoi myös perustaneensa rahaston Ogunin kuolleiden toimittajien perheiden auttamiseksi. Esimerkkiä tähän hän sanoo saaneensa Lagosista – ja hän on saanut laajaa tukea ja lahjoituksia, myös presidentin kansliasta. Oladunjoye kannustaa tukemaan journalistien omaisia koko maassa.

article_content: Malala Yousafzai, a teenage advocate from Pakistan who championed girls’ education and survived a Taliban assassination attempt, is being treated at a hospital in Birmingham, UK. She was brought there after being targeted for speaking out about girls’ rights to schooling. Her mother and father joined her in Britain on Thursday, ten days after she was flown over for urgent medical care. Due to a tube in her throat to protect her airway, Malala cannot currently speak, but she communicates by writing and remains alert. Her father, Ziauddin Yousafzai, an educator who defied Taliban bans by keeping his girls’ school open in Swat Valley, has strongly influenced her activism. Ziauddin shared with Pakistani media that, though it was emotionally difficult to leave home under such circumstances, it was essential to be near Malala during her recovery. He also thanked Pakistanis for their prayers and support, expressing hope for her recovery. Malala’s brother, Khushal Khan, encouraged continued support and prayers from the public. Even in the hospital, Malala remains focused on her studies, asking for her schoolbooks. Pakistan's Interior Minister, Rehman Malik, commended her resolve and said the country should take pride in her efforts to promote education for girls. Officials have promised Malala full protection upon her return to Pakistan. The assault on her has been condemned as an attempt to stall the country's progress. President Asif Ali Zardari advised Malala’s father to stay in the UK as long as necessary for her treatment. Doctors report that Malala is making progress, though she requires a long recovery before she can undergo reconstructive surgery. She has overcome an infection, is able to move her arms and legs, and can stand with help. The bullet that struck her grazed her brain as it traveled from just above her eye to her shoulder, but she remains cognitively intact. Rallies and vigils in Pakistan and worldwide have supported Malala, whom the Taliban admitted to targeting, although the attack sparked much greater global condemnation than they expected. Malala rose to prominence in 2009 by blogging about life under Taliban rule in Swat and advocating resistance against strict Islamist policies. Police have arrested six men connected to the shooting, while the main suspect, Atta Ullah Khan, remains at large.

Hänet lennätettiin sinne sen jälkeen, kun häneen kohdistettiin väkivallanteko rohkean puheenvuoronsa vuoksi tyttöjen kouluoikeuksista. Hänen äitinsä ja isänsä saapuivat Britanniaan torstaina, kymmenen päivää Malalan kiireellistä siirtoa myöhemmin. Malala ei pysty tällä hetkellä puhumaan hengitysteitä suojaavan putken vuoksi, mutta kommunikoi kirjoittamalla ja on tajuissaan. Hänen isänsä, Ziauddin Yousafzai, opettaja, joka uhmasi Talibanin kieltoja pitämällä Swatin laaksossa tyttöjen koulun avoinna, on vahvasti vaikuttanut hänen aktivismiinsa. Ziauddin kertoi pakistanilaiselle medialle, että vaikka perheelle oli vaikeaa lähteä kotimaastaan tällaisissa olosuhteissa, Malalan luona oleminen tämän toipumisen aikana oli välttämätöntä. Hän kiitti pakistanilaisia rukouksista ja tuesta sekä ilmaisi toivonsa Malalan tervehtymisestä. Malalan veli, Khushal Khan, kehotti kansaa jatkamaan tukea ja rukouksia. Malala keskittyy yhä opiskeluun ja pyysi isäänsä tuomaan koulukirjansa sairaalaan. Sisäministeri Rehman Malik kiitti Malalan päättäväisyyttä ja sanoi koko maan olevan ylpeä hänen työstään tyttöjen koulutuksen puolesta. Viranomaisten mukaan Malalalle tarjotaan täydet turvatoimet hänen palatessaan Pakistaniin. Hyökkäystä on paheksuttu yrityksenä pysäyttää maan kehitys. Presidentti Asif Ali Zardari neuvoi Malalan isää jäämään Britanniaan niin pitkäksi aikaa kuin hoito vaatii. Lääkäreiden mukaan Malala toipuu vähitellen, mutta tarvitsee pitkän kuntoutuksen ennen korjausleikkausta. Hän on selvinnyt infektiosta, pystyy liikuttamaan raajojaan ja seisomaan tuettuna. Luoti sivusi aivoja kulkiessaan silmän yläpuolelta olkapäähän, mutta hänen kognitiiviset kykynsä ovat tallella. Malalaa tukevat mielenosoitukset ja kynttilävigilit Pakistanissa ja muualla maailmassa. Taliban on tunnustanut teon, vaikka hyökkäys sai aikaan laajaa kansainvälistä tuomitsemista. Malala nousi esiin blogatessaan Swatin laakson elämästä Talibanin vallan alla vuonna 2009 ja rohkaistessaan vastarintaan tiukkoja islamistisia sääntöjä vastaan. Poliisi on pidättänyt kuusi miestä hyökkäykseen liittyen, mutta pääepäilty Atta Ullah Khan on yhä etsintäkuulutettu.

article_content: In 2022, the New Zealand government implemented legislation establishing a progressively increasing smoking age, preventing anyone born after January 2008 from legally purchasing cigarettes. This law aimed to save the healthcare system significant costs by reducing smoking-related fatalities. However, the new government in New Zealand is set to repeal this widely praised smoking ban in order to fund tax cuts. The legislation, introduced under former Prime Minister Jacinda Ardern, would have permanently banned the sale of cigarettes to those born after 2008. As smoking is the leading preventable cause of death in New Zealand, the policy aimed to prevent future generations from taking up the habit. The sudden change in direction has received strong criticism from medical professionals. Professor Richard Edwards, a tobacco control researcher and public health expert at the University of Otago, stated that he and other health experts are 'appalled and disgusted.' 'Most health groups in New Zealand are appalled by what the government has done and are calling on them to reverse the decision,' he told the BBC. The legislation, passed last year, was supported by research models and received international praise. Key measures included reducing nicotine content in cigarettes and limiting the number of tobacco retailers. Models predicted that the 'Smokefree' laws could save up to 5,000 lives each year. The UK announced a similar plan to restrict youth smoking in September, reportedly inspired by New Zealand's approach. A spokesperson for UK Prime Minister Rishi Sunak said his position remains unchanged despite New Zealand's reversal. Despite widespread support among public health advocates, business groups in New Zealand, including small retailers and newsagents, opposed the Smokefree measures, citing concerns over lost revenue, even with government assistance. Some Members of Parliament, including newly appointed Prime Minister Chris Luxon, argued that a tobacco ban could encourage a black market. Nonetheless, his National Party did not mention the Smokefree policies during their recent election campaign. The National Party won 38% of the vote on October 14. Health professionals were surprised when the government announced on Saturday that it would abolish the legislation, as many assumed the law would remain. Finance Minister Nicola Willis revealed the repeal was strongly pushed by the coalition partners, the Act Party and New Zealand First. The Football Association is reviewing video footage after Chelsea’s narrow 1-0 victory over Everton on Wednesday, with attention centered on an altercation between Chelsea defender Branislav Ivanovic and Everton’s James McCarthy. Ivanovic appeared to make a head motion towards McCarthy and is also accused of attempting to bite him during the tense exchange late in the game. The FA has launched a thorough investigation into the incident and is awaiting the official match report from referee Jon Moss and his assistants, expected on Thursday.

Both Chelsea and Everton may face disciplinary action for losing control of their players during the heated moments at Stamford Bridge. Chelsea manager Jose Mourinho declined to comment on the incident after the match and is expected to be displeased if Ivanovic is sanctioned. Early reports indicate that Moss may not have witnessed the event and might not mention it in his report, giving the FA the opportunity to apply retrospective penalties. Should Ivanovic be banned for three matches, he would be ruled out of the Capital One Cup final against Tottenham.

Mourinho has expressed concern about what he believes is unequal treatment by referees and the media, particularly following Diego Costa’s retrospective three-match suspension for a previous incident. He contrasted this with Robin Van Persie’s avoidance of a ban for a similar clash, where on-field intervention by referee Mark Clattenburg prevented further sanction.

Pundits have varied opinions: Martin Keown thinks Ivanovic probably won’t be punished, Steve McManaman leaves the decision to the authorities, Robbie Savage suggests a red card would have been appropriate had officials seen the action, Michael Owen supports a yellow card, while Phil Neville doubts a lengthy ban will occur due to insufficient evidence.

Ivanovicin epäillään tehneen päänliikkeen kohti McCarthya, ja häntä syytetään myös yrityksestä purra McCarthya kiistan aikana ottelun loppuminuuteilla. Australia’s Civil Aviation Safety Authority (CASA) is preparing to introduce updated 'world-first' regulations on drone usage, following a rise in inappropriate drone activity. CASA spokesman Peter Gibson told Daily Mail Australia that the existing rules, first implemented in 2002, have become outdated due to changes in drone technology and usage.

Current regulations state that drones must stay at least 30 metres away from other people and cannot be flown over crowded public spaces such as beaches or sporting events. Drones, like quadcopters equipped with GPS and cameras, may only be flown during the day and within visual line of sight. Additionally, they must remain more than five kilometres from airports and cannot fly above 400 feet. Violations may result in fines or prosecution, especially if people are harmed.

Gibson noted that recreational drone use was virtually non-existent 12 years ago, necessitating an update of the rules to reflect current usage. He estimated there are 180 commercial operators and likely tens of thousands of recreational drones across Australia.

Australia was the first country to introduce drone regulations and aims to continue leading the way, with new rules expected next year. Gibson said a rise in drone-related incidents, such as a recent case in Melbourne where a drone struck a power line during a police operation, has highlighted the need for updated policies.

Though Gibson did not specify what the new rules would entail, he emphasized that they would be practical, allowing for recreational enjoyment while prioritizing safety. CASA plans to consult with the public and aims to strike a balance between accessibility for recreational users and robust safety measures for people and aircraft.

According to Gibson, the proposed changes will keep Australia at the forefront of global drone regulation, as other countries—like the United States—have yet to enact comparable rules.

Australian ilmailuviranomainen CASA on valmistelemassa päivitettyjä ja mahdollisesti maailman ensimmäisiä uusia sääntöjä dronejen käyttöön, koska sopimattomien lentojen määrä on kasvanut. CASA:n tiedottaja Peter Gibson kertoi Daily Mail Australialle, että nykyiset, vuonna 2002 käyttöön otetut säännöt eivät enää vastaa teknologian ja käytön muutoksia.

Nykyisen sääntelyn mukaan dronejen tulee olla vähintään 30 metrin päässä muista ihmisistä, eikä niitä saa lennättää vilkkaasti asutuilla alueilla, kuten rannoilla tai urheilutapahtumissa. Droneja, kuten GPS:llä ja kameroilla varustettuja nelikoptereita, saa lentää vain päiväsaikaan ja aina näkökentässä. Lisäksi niiden tulee olla yli viiden kilometrin päässä lentoasemilta eikä korkeuden saa ylittää 400 jalkaa. Sääntöjen rikkomisesta voi seurata sakkoja tai syyte, erityisesti jos ihmisille aiheutuu haittaa.

Gibson totesi, että 12 vuotta sitten harrastelijadroneja ei juuri ollut, joten sääntöjä pitää päivittää nykytilannetta vastaaviksi. Hän arvioi, että Australiassa on 180 kaupallista toimijaa ja todennäköisesti kymmeniä tuhansia harrastajakäyttäjiä.

Australia oli ensimmäinen maa, joka sääti droneista, ja haluaa jatkossakin olla edelläkävijä; uudet säädökset ovat tulossa ensi vuonna. Gibsonin mukaan droneihin liittyvien tapausten, kuten hiljattaisen Melbournessa, jossa drone osui voimalinjaan poliisioperaation aikana, lisääntyminen korostaa tarvetta päivityksille.

Gibson ei vielä täsmentänyt tulevia sääntöjä, mutta korosti, että niiden on oltava käytännöllisiä ja mahdollistettava harrastuskäyttö turvallisuudesta tinkimättä. CASA aikoo järjestää julkisen kuulemisen löytääkseen tasapainon harrastajien vapauksien ja turvallisuuden välillä.

Gibsonin mukaan nämä muutokset säilyttävät Australian etumatkan drone-sääntelyssä maailmanlaajuisesti, kun esimerkiksi Yhdysvalloilta puuttuvat vastaavat säännöt.

article_content: A couple from Glastonbury, Connecticut, came home unexpectedly after a weekend away to find their teenage daughters hosting a loud party in their house, where several underage guests were drinking alcohol. The event took place on Neipsic Road; police were called by the parents on October 13 after they found the scene. Officers found about 20 to 30 minors at the gathering, with many trying to run when police arrived. Authorities arrested the sisters, aged 15 and 16, who live at the residence. Both face charges for allowing minors to have alcohol in the home; because of their ages, their identities have not been released. Police say that the girls had already thrown parties on Friday and Saturday nights while their parents were out, and were planning another when the parents intervened. Glastonbury police have praised the parents for taking action immediately and confirmed that the investigation continues, asking the public for any additional information.

Tapaus sattui Neipsic Roadilla; vanhemmat soittivat poliisille 13. lokakuuta löydettyään tilanteen. Viranomaiset löysivät juhlasta noin 20–30 alaikäistä, joista monet yrittivät paeta, kun poliisit saapuivat paikalle. Viranomaiset pidättivät talossa asuvat siskokset, 15- ja 16-vuotiaat, jotka on nyt syytetty alaikäisten alkoholin sallimisesta kotonaan. Heidän henkilöllisyyttään ei ole julkistettu, sillä he ovat alaikäisiä. Poliisin mukaan tytöt olivat järjestäneet juhlia jo perjantai- ja lauantai-iltoina vanhempiensa ollessa poissa sekä suunnittelevat lisää, kunnes vanhemmat keskeyttivät tapahtumat. article_content: Jim Brisbane, Chief Operations Officer at the Crown Prosecution Service (CPS), received £88,000 in expenses for commuting and accommodation as he traveled to London from his home in Llanelli, Wales. With a base salary of £120,000, Brisbane's additional monthly expenses exceeded £3,000, which meant his total remuneration surpassed the civil service's pay ceiling of £142,500. This arrangement was flagged in an internal CPS audit, resulting in officials obtaining special approval from Chief Secretary to the Treasury Danny Alexander for the extra payments. Brisbane stated that he followed all regulations, explaining that he could have asked the government to purchase him a house due to the job’s requirements, but felt that would have been inappropriate. He emphasized that staying in London was necessary for his role and underlined the city’s high property costs. With over 35 years of experience in law, Brisbane previously worked as a solicitor in England and Wales, graduated from Glasgow University, and served in the Scottish Crown Office and Procurator Fiscal Service. He became Chief Crown Prosecutor for Dyfed Powys in 2008 before advancing to his current CPS role. A CPS spokesperson noted that Brisbane was specifically encouraged to apply for the critical role because of his outstanding record, even though it was clear he could not relocate full-time to London. Relocation support was given and approved in line with civil service policies, due to his expertise and the significant improvements he brought during a period of change. Despite official approval, the Taxpayers’ Alliance argued that these expenses represented a wasteful use of public funds.

Peruspalkallaan 120 000 puntaa Brisbanen ylimääräiset kuukausittaiset kustannukset ylittivät 3 000 puntaa, minkä vuoksi hänen kokonaispalkkionsa ylitti julkishallinnon palkkakaton 142 500 puntaa. Järjestely havaittiin sisäisessä tarkastuksessa, minkä jälkeen viranomaiset hakivat erityisluvan ylimääräisille maksuille valtiovarainministeri Danny Alexanderilta. Brisbane totesi noudattaneensa kaikkia sääntöjä ja selitti, että olisi voinut pyytää hallitusta ostamaan hänelle asunnon työn vaatimusten vuoksi, mutta piti sitä sopimattomana. Hän painotti, että Lontoossa asuminen oli työn hoitamisen kannalta välttämätöntä ja korosti kaupungin korkeita asuinkustannuksia. Yli 35 vuoden lakialan kokemuksella Brisbane on aiemmin toiminut lakimiehenä Englannissa ja Walesissa, valmistunut Glasgow’n yliopistosta ja työskennellyt Skotlannin syyttäjänvirastossa. Vuonna 2008 hänestä tuli Dyfed Powysin pääsyyttäjä ennen nykyistä rooliaan CPS:ssä. CPS:n tiedottaja kertoi, että Brisbanea kannustettiin hakemaan tähän tärkeään tehtävään hänen erinomaisen kokemuksensa vuoksi, vaikka oli selvää, ettei hän voinut muuttaa pysyvästi Lontooseen. Muutostukea annettiin ja hyväksyttiin virallisten sääntöjen mukaisesti hänen asiantuntemuksensa ja merkittävien kehitystoimenpiteidensä vuoksi muutoskaudella. article_content: The Russian military has reported a successful test launch of a Bulava intercontinental ballistic missile designed to carry nuclear warheads from a new nuclear submarine. This announcement comes as tensions rise between Russia and the West due to the ongoing conflict in Ukraine. Last week, President Vladimir Putin signed a bill revoking Russia’s ratification of a global nuclear test ban, a move Moscow claims is needed to establish parity with the United States. The Russian Defence Ministry stated that the Imperator Alexander III, a strategic missile submarine, fired the Bulava missile from an underwater position in the northern White Sea. The missile successfully struck a target in Russia’s far-eastern Kamchatka region. The statement did not specify when the launch occurred. The Imperator Alexander III is one of the new Borei-class nuclear submarines. Each submarine carries 16 Bulava missiles and is intended to be a key component of Russia’s naval nuclear forces in the coming decades. According to the Defence Ministry, a ballistic missile launch is the submarine's final test before it is inducted into the fleet. The Russian Navy currently operates three Borei-class submarines. Another is completing testing, and three more are under construction, according to the Defence Ministry.

Tämä uutinen tuli julki tilanteessa, jossa Venäjän ja länsimaiden väliset jännitteet ovat kasvaneet Ukrainan sodan vuoksi. Viime viikolla presidentti Vladimir Putin allekirjoitti lain, jolla Venäjä perui ratifiointinsa kansainväliseen ydinkokeiden kieltosopimukseen—Moskovan mukaan tarpeellinen toimenpide Yhdysvaltoihin nähden tasavertaisuuden saavuttamiseksi. Venäjän puolustusministeriön mukaan Imperator Alexander III -niminen strateginen ohjussukellusvene ampui Bulava-ohjuksen vedenalaisesta asemasta Pohjoisella Valkoisella merellä. article_content: As fantasy football drafts get underway, workplace productivity tends to drop as employees spend hours managing their rosters, all striving to land the next breakout star. But you don’t have to be a football fan to join the fantasy fun—there’s a wide range of alternative fantasy leagues to explore. For animal lovers, Showdog.com lets you choose a breed, allocate resources to train and groom your dog, and compete virtually for show champion status. If music is your passion, the Fantasy Music League allows you to sign artists to your fantasy label and earn points based on real-world chart movements and album sales. Currently, the top team—Jenny Baird Records—features acts like Fall Out Boy, Daughtry, Justin Timberlake, and Fergie. For thrill seekers, a fantasy water skiing league lets you draft professional skiers who earn you points according to their event performances, from slalom to trick jump distances. Pro wrestling enthusiasts can join web-based fantasy leagues and earn points based on their wrestlers’ in-ring success and TV appearances—The Undertaker reliably brings home solid points every year. Fans of bass fishing can test their predictive skills in ESPN.com’s Fantasy Fishing Challenge, creating teams of pro anglers under a set salary cap. Each angler earns points for their tournaments results in the Bassmaster Angler of the Year standings. Political buffs aren’t left out—FantasyCongress.com (launched in 2006) let participants draft legislators and score points for legislative activity, voting frequency, and crossing party lines. Fans of competitive eating can join Krystal Square Off’s fantasy eating leagues, tracking competitors like “Humble” Bob Shoudt (who once devoured 28 burgers in two minutes) to see whose team can eat the most. Finally, bowling lovers can participate in the Lumber Liquidators PBA Tour’s fantasy bowling league, scoring points based on their bowlers' tournament finishes. Rhino Page is among the top contenders. No matter your interest, there’s a fantasy league that fits—proving the fantasy mania is for everyone.

article_content: Oregon’s groundbreaking law decriminalizing possession of small amounts of drugs such as heroin and cocaine has faced mounting criticism after a surge in public drug use, fentanyl proliferation, and opioid-related deaths, including among children. Many city residents are troubled by frequent exposure to open drug use. John Horvick of DHM Research noted a shift in public perception of Measure 110. Approved by 58% of voters three years ago, the law aimed to reduce penalties for drug use and emphasize recovery instead. However, an increase in synthetic opioid deaths has led even supporting Democratic lawmakers to consider changes. In Portland, signs of fentanyl-driven addiction and homelessness are highly visible, with public drug use often seen in daylight. Democratic state Senator Kate Lieber, a legislative committee co-chair, said all possibilities are being considered to improve public safety and health. Measure 110 directed cannabis tax revenues toward addiction treatment services and decriminalized possession of 'personal use' amounts. For example, having less than a gram of heroin results in a $100 ticket, which can be dismissed after completing an addiction screening. Those who do not complete screening are not otherwise penalized. State audits found only 1% of those cited sought help through the hotline in the first year. Critics argue the current system does not sufficiently encourage treatment. Republican lawmakers have asked Governor Tina Kotek to call a special session and suggested tougher sanctions and mandatory treatment. Some law enforcement leaders have proposed making drug possession a misdemeanor with opportunities for diversion. Data indicates that decades of criminalization have not significantly reduced drug use. In 2022, around 25 million Americans (8% of the population) reported using illicit drugs other than marijuana. Some legislators propose focusing enforcement on public drug use rather than possession. Northern Kentucky University law professor Alex Kreit observes that similar public health and homelessness issues affect other states that haven’t decriminalized drugs. Supporters of Oregon’s approach contend that spikes in fentanyl deaths are part of wider national trends and that external factors—including the COVID-19 pandemic and shortages in the mental health workforce—have exacerbated the crisis. CDC data indicates Oregon saw the biggest increase in synthetic opioid deaths from 2019 to mid-2023—a 13-fold rise. Measure 110-funded Behavioral Health Resource Networks now operate statewide, supplying care regardless of the person’s ability to pay and doubling the number of people starting treatment between mid-2022 and early 2023. The steady funding created by the law has stabilized addiction services, according to Heather Jefferis of the Oregon Council for Behavioral Health. Pollster Horvick notes continued public support for treatment expansion despite ongoing debate over the law. Sen. Lieber maintains that repealing Measure 110 would not resolve Oregon’s drug issues, as similar challenges persist in states with stricter drug laws.

Monet kaupunkilaiset ovat huolissaan avoimen huumeidenkäytön arkipäiväistymisestä. DHM Researchin John Horvickin mukaan kansan suhtautuminen Measure 110:een on muuttunut. Kolme vuotta sitten 58 % äänestäjistä hyväksyi lain, jonka tavoitteena oli vähentää huumeiden käytöstä määrättyjä rangaistuksia ja painottaa toipumista. Lisääntyneet synteettisten opioidien kuolemat ovat kuitenkin saaneet jopa lain kannattajat pohtimaan muutoksia. Portlandissa fentanyylin aiheuttaman riippuvuuden ja kodittomuuden seuraukset näkyvät julkisesti – huumeiden käyttö on tavallista keskellä päivää. Demokraattisenaattori Kate Lieber, lakivaliokunnan puheenjohtaja, sanoo kaikkien mahdollisuuksien olevan harkinnassa turvallisuuden ja terveyden parantamiseksi. Measure 110 ohjaa kannabisverotulot päihdehoitoihin ja dekriminalisoi 'henkilökohtaiseen käyttöön' tarkoitetut määrät. Esimerkiksi alle gramman heroiinin hallussapito johtaa 100 dollarin sakkoon, jonka voi mitätöidä osallistumalla päihdearviointiin. Muilta rangaistuksilta välttyy, vaikka arviointia ei suorita. Tarkastuksissa vain 1 % saaneista haki apua puhelinpalvelun kautta ensimmäisen vuoden aikana. Kriitikoiden mielestä järjestelmä ei tarpeeksi kannusta hoitoon. Republikaanilainsäätäjät ovat pyytäneet kuvernööri Tina Kotekia koolle ylimääräiseen istuntoon ja esittäneet tiukempia sanktioita sekä pakollista hoitoa. Osa poliiseista haluaa palauttaa huumeiden hallussapidon rikokseksi, mutta samalla tarjota mahdollisuuksia hoitoon pääsyyn. Tilastojen mukaan vuosikymmenten kriminalisointi ei ole merkittävästi vähentänyt huumeiden käyttöä. Vuonna 2022 noin 25 miljoonaa amerikkalaista (8 % väestöstä) käytti muita laittomia huumeita kuin kannabista. Osa lainsäätäjistä haluaisi kohdistaa valvontaa erityisesti julkiseen huumeiden käyttöön. Pohjois-Kentuckyn yliopiston oikeustieteen professori Alex Kreit huomauttaa, että samankaltaisia ongelmia on myös dekriminalisoimattomissa osavaltioissa, erityisesti kodittomuuden kanssa. Oregonin mallin kannattajat uskovat, että fentanyylikuolemat liittyvät laajempiin valtakunnallisiin ilmiöihin, ja tilanteen on pahentanut koronapandemia ja mielenterveyspalvelujen työntekijäpula. CDC:n mukaan Oregonilla oli suurin synteettisten opioidikuolemien nousu 2019–2023 – 13-kertainen kasvu. Measure 110:n rahoittamia Behavioural Health Resource Networkeja on nyt kaikkialla Oregonissa, ja ne tarjoavat apua maksukyvystä riippumatta. Hoitoon hakeutuneiden määrä kaksinkertaistui vuoden 2022 puolivälin ja alkuvuoden 2023 välillä. Lain tuoma vakaa rahoitus on vakiinnuttanut päihdehoitopalvelut, kertoo Heather Jefferis Oregon Council for Behavioral Healthista. Kyselytutkija Horvickin mukaan julkinen tuki hoitomahdollisuuksien laajentamiselle jatkuu kiistojen keskellä. Sen. Lieberin mukaan Measure 110:n kumoaminen ei ratkaisisi Oregonin huumeongelmia, sillä samanlaisia haasteita on osavaltioissa, joissa lait ovat tiukempia.

article_content: Driving in thick fog can be unsettling due to reduced visibility and difficulty in identifying other vehicles. Researchers at Glasgow Caledonian University (GCU) have developed a new heads-up display (HUD) for cars that may address these issues by projecting the positions of nearby vehicles directly onto the windscreen. Inspired by fighter-jet technology, this HUD alerts drivers to the presence of other cars in extreme weather conditions such as dense fog, which could help prevent collisions. The innovation comes from Professor Vassilis Charissis and his team at GCU's Virtual Reality and Simulation Laboratory (VRS Lab). The display was evaluated using a 3D driving simulator featuring a photorealistic BMW 5 Series model and realistic recreations of the M8, M74, and M80 motorways. More than 150 user trials have assessed different versions of the interface, demonstrating that the HUD significantly improves driver response times and reduces the likelihood of rear collisions by an average of 70% under low visibility conditions. During simulation, drivers can experience both clear and foggy conditions. The HUD highlights nearby vehicles within a 400-meter (1,300-foot) range and indicates when it is safe to change lanes. Though currently being tested in simulators, it is hoped the technology will eventually be integrated into real vehicle windscreens to help drivers see other cars under poor visibility. Additional testing is required before public implementation. The display could be used in both personal and emergency vehicles in the future. Professor Charissis noted that adverse weather seriously impairs drivers' spatial awareness, making such technologies valuable for road safety. HUDs can present augmented information directly in the driver’s field of vision, allowing them to stay focused on the road while receiving critical updates. These displays may show road markings, proximity warnings for other vehicles, and alerts about traffic congestion, ultimately improving safety.

Hävittäjälentäjätekniikasta inspiroitu HUD varoittaa kuljettajia toisista autoista äärimmäisissä sääolosuhteissa, kuten tiheässä sumussa, mikä voi auttaa estämään onnettomuuksia. Innovaation ovat kehittäneet professori Vassilis Charissis ja hänen tiiminsä GCU:n Virtual Reality and Simulation Laboratory (VRS Lab) -laboratoriossa. Näyttöä on testattu 3D-ajosimulaattorilla, jossa on fotorealistinen BMW 5-sarjan malli ja realistiset M8-, M74- ja M80-moottoritien mallinnukset. Yli 150 käyttäjäkokeessa on arvioitu eri versioita käyttöliittymästä, ja tulokset osoittavat, että HUD parantaa merkittävästi kuljettajien reagointiaikaa ja vähentää peräänajon todennäköisyyttä keskimäärin 70 % huonon näkyvyyden olosuhteissa. Simulaatiossa kuljettajat voivat ajaa sekä selkeissä että sumuisissa olosuhteissa. HUD korostaa läheiset ajoneuvot 400 metrin (1 300 jalan) säteellä ja ilmoittaa, milloin kaistanvaihto on turvallista. Näytöt voivat näyttää kaistamerkinnät, varoitukset muista ajoneuvoista ja liikennetiedotteet, parantaen näin turvallisuutta.

Supporting a congressional campaign normally involves donations, canvassing, or making phone calls — rarely does it mean appearing to be nude on television. But the Kelly Kultala for Congress campaign broke with tradition, requesting just that from its supporters. Kultala, a Democrat seeking to unseat Kansas Republican Representative Kevin Yoder, released an ad on Thursday featuring several volunteers who appeared naked, using strategically placed objects to cover themselves, as they urged viewers to back Kultala in November's election.

Campaign manager Jacob Becklund clarified, “They are volunteers who agreed to participate because they support our campaign and its message. It should be noted that nobody was actually naked during filming.” Becklund explained that volunteers were easily convinced to take part. The ad, titled “Naked Truth,” will air on cable and broadcast TV in the Kansas City market starting Friday and carries a significant five-figure budget.

The (simulated) nudity serves as a reference to Congressman Yoder, who made headlines in 2011 for skinny dipping in the Sea of Galilee during a congressional trip to Israel, an incident for which he was later reprimanded by House Republicans. In the ad, Kultala asserts, “A while back, Congressman Yoder made news by skinny dipping on the job. But what he’s doing to Kansas is even more shameless.” The ad features the faux-nude volunteers highlighting aspects of Yoder’s record, such as, “Yoder lines the pockets of his millionaire donors with big tax cuts. And they line his, when he has pockets.” Becklund said, “We thought it was a humorous hook to get people to pay attention to the message.”

article_content: On Tuesday, authorities identified Jimmy Lee Dykes as the man who boarded a school bus in Alabama when it stopped to drop off children, demanding two students. Police report that bus driver Charles Albert Poland refused, and Dykes—who had previously been arrested after a dispute with neighbors—in turn, shot and killed Poland. At the time of writing, Dykes remains in an armed standoff with police, reportedly holding a five-year-old boy hostage in an underground bunker. Also on Tuesday, 15-year-old Hadiya Pendleton was fatally shot in Chicago. She and her friends were standing under a park shelter during the rain, and police believe the perpetrator may have mistaken them for members of a rival gang. The park is about a mile from President Obama's Chicago home. Just over a week earlier, Pendleton participated in Obama's inauguration events as part of her school's band. These tragic events reflect ongoing issues with gun violence in America. According to a Pew Research Center poll, 85% of Americans support universal background checks to prevent convicted felons and the mentally ill from obtaining firearms. Despite this, legislative action has stalled. On Wednesday, the NFL announced that the Super Bowl pregame show would feature a performance of 'America the Beautiful' by 26 Sandy Hook Elementary School students and faculty, honoring the victims of another major tragedy. Even with such gestures, more shootings have occurred, such as the incident in Phoenix where 70-year-old Arthur Harmon shot three people, killing one. Many, including the article's author, continue to call for changes to gun laws and express frustration over the lack of progress. The article criticizes the influence of the National Rifle Association over politicians and references historical figures John Adams and Thomas Jefferson, urging leaders to set aside partisan divisions to address the issue. The commentary reflects the author's personal opinions. LZ Granderson is the writer. For further coverage, viewers are directed to Anderson Cooper 360° weeknights at 10pm ET.

Nämä traagiset tapahtumat heijastavat jatkuvia ongelmia aserikollisuuden kanssa Yhdysvalloissa.
